name: Voice with the weight of a drum

gm.title: At the table
lines: The drinker's low voice carries through floorboards. A listener below can recognize the speaker even if the words remain unclear.

name: Wall flowers open where air circulates

gm.title: At the table
lines: Pale blooms open by a cracked lintel and stay folded in sealed rooms. Recognizing the difference gives explorers a way to find the only passage where several people can work safely for hours.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Wargs test one gate every night and break off when its bell sounds. The bell ringer has an offer to miss a shift.

name: Warm a building by unwinding one knot

gm.title: At the table
lines: A cloth stores a room's warmth in a row of knots. Unwind one to warm a new room for an hour and chill the corresponding area of the original building. Ask who still needs the old room before using the last knot.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A guard invites one member to answer a routine complaint. A court clerk offers to show the docket to the others while the officer is out.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Thick strands tie a door to its frame from both sides. One creature is inside with something that keeps moving the latch.

name: Who keeps the molds when the furnace cools

gm.title: At the table
lines: The departing tenant is allowed to break the old molds after turning off the furnace. A buyer needs their profiles for a licensed repair. Include the originals in the handoff, copy the profiles before shutoff, or find who still has the original drawings.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Unending twilight ends briefly around a transferred relic. Farmers, navigators, and nocturnal citizens each offer a use for those few minutes.

name: Why the harpies left their island

gm.title: At the table
lines: A flock nesting in harbor blocks safe passage. They will move if the party recovers eggs left on their old island. The harbormaster is willing to move shipping for a day if someone can prove the flock plans to leave.

name: Wild kin on a disputed trail

gm.title: At the table
lines: A band maintains a path outsiders claim was empty for decades. Old repairs in their distinctive style prove regular use.

name: Win the handoff without winning the whole race

gm.title: At the table
lines: Mark three points where different couriers can trade the parcel. A player can skip a segment by committing to a wrong-way risk now, or watch one transfer and use that information for the next.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A jar contains wind that blows in the direction it was bottled. Loose paper twists toward the coast printed on the seller's label.

name: Words of ownership pull at the ground

gm.title: At the table
lines: Saying that you own a parcel of land makes your next step on it heavy. Asking permission from anyone who lives there restores an easy stride until dawn. Try making a claim first with one foot across the boundary.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Describe the factions, debts, or locations that would carry forward under several plausible outcomes. Ask which survivors, obligations, or places the players want to spend another session with.

name: Yesterday's collateral needs to be used today

gm.title: At the table
lines: A pawnbroker has taken a ferry token as collateral and would lend it under supervision. Only the borrower knows how to seat it in the old ferry gate. The party can guarantee its return while the two travel together.

name: +1 All-Purpose Tool
summary: Change between artisan's tools and loan the artificer a cantrip.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required by an artificer.

name: A History of Dragons and Drakes
summary: Separates named specimens and their habitats from sailors' tales.

name: Accordion-fold music stand
summary: A wooden stand collapses into a narrow bundle between two leather straps.

name: Acid (vial)
summary: One dose sold in its throw-ready container.

name: Adamantine ore
summary: Unrefined stock for a smith who can work adamantine.

name: Adjustable cuff bands (pair)
summary: Hold sleeves in place for a fitting without stitches.

name: Adjustable shelf index strips
summary: Short tags slide into one long rail to mark the current contents of a shared shelf.

name: Afterrain sugar stems
summary: The stems have a crisp sweet center. Buy them cut and sealed for the morning market.

name: Airing peg
summary: Fasten it to wet fabric and it rings once when that fold is dry all the way through. It dries nothing by itself.

name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
summary: A single-use flask of persistent flame.

name: Alchemy Jug
summary: Produce one of its listed liquids each day.

name: Alexandrite
summary: A cut gem that can appear a different color under different light.

name: Amber piece
summary: A small piece of hardened golden resin.

name: Ambersprout
summary: A sweet root whose rind releases tacky sap useful on a torn bandage.

name: Amulet of the Drunkard
summary: Once a day, drinking alcohol can restore some hit points.

name: An Advocate's Phrasebook
summary: Summarizes common objections and the documents a hearing clerk asks to see.

name: Anchor patch tattoo
summary: Touch a clean cloth to the fresh mark to copy its outline once. Compare that outline to the skin later to check whether the tattoo stretched during a transformation.

name: Apple cider
summary: A drink pressed from apples.

name: Apples (three)
summary: Three apples sold as a small bundle.

name: Apricot hand tart
summary: Small folded pastry with an apricot center and a firm seam.

name: Arcane focus orb
summary: A polished sphere a spellcaster can hold as an arcane focus.

name: Arcane focus rod
summary: A short rigid rod made to serve as an arcane focus.

name: Arcane focus wand
summary: A narrow hand-held wand made to serve as an arcane focus.

name: Arctic tracks handbook
summary: Shows tracks in fresh snow and common changes after a thaw.

name: Arrow-Catching Shield
summary: Protect nearby allies from some ranged weapon attacks.

name: Atomizer bulb and bottle
summary: Dispenses a mist from a thin liquid. A spare bulb fits the same neck.

name: Attar blending kit
summary: Four single-note sample oils plus separate empty bottles for trying combinations.

name: Attic key
summary: Turns only when the person carrying it has climbed higher than everyone else in the building.

name: Awl sleeve
summary: A leather guard keeps a sharp awl from piercing the tool roll.

name: Azurite
summary: A low-cost deep-blue stone.

name: Backstamp book press
summary: Press one volume without opening its cover to get an impression of the binder's most recent mark from inside the spine.

name: Backward quill
summary: Writes legibly only on the reverse of a sheet.

player.title: Capacity and handling
lines: The bag can carry up to 500 pounds and 64 cubic feet. It weighs 15 pounds regardless of what it holds.
Taking an item out requires an action. Overloading, piercing, or tearing the bag destroys it and scatters its contents into the Astral Plane.

name: Bagpipes
summary: Suited to marching and performances outdoors.

name: Bailing scoop with deck hook
summary: A bent lip rests its handle over a rail so the scoop stays easy to reach.

name: Banquet place setting
summary: A meal for one person at a prepared feast.

name: Barley bread
summary: A plain, dense bread made with barley.

name: Barn owl face
summary: Hear a whisper through a single thin partition while both feet remain planted.

name: Barnacle face
summary: Walk across still water for one minute. Each footfall leaves a visible ring even in darkness.

name: Barrelstalk
summary: A hollow fungus sold sealed with a wax plug. A fresh one holds a day's water for two travelers.

name: Barrier Tattoo (Small)
summary: While attuned and unarmored, use AC 12 plus Dexterity modifier. A shield still works.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Barter bakewell
summary: A tart is baked with a second empty shell inside. A buyer can tuck in their own tiny gift before passing it along.

name: Basket
summary: Open carry basket for produce, pottery, or loose supplies.

name: Bat guano (1 lb)
summary: A pound of dried bat droppings sold as a spell component.

name: Battering Shield
summary: Turn a successful shove into a stronger displacement.

name: Bean flour (1 lb)
summary: Thickens stew and travels well in a dry sack.

name: Beeswax bowl covers (set)
summary: Cloth covers seal three different sizes of bowl.

name: Bell with two clappers
summary: Either clapper can be pinned independently, making two recognizable signals with the same bell.

name: Belt
summary: An adjustable waist strap that can carry a pouch or sheath.

name: Bench vise
summary: Clamps to the side of a sturdy worktable.

name: Bent seam ruler
summary: A fixed curve is convenient for tracing the same rounded shape many times.

name: Binding thread bobbin
summary: Strong, smooth cotton thread to rebind a small book.

name: Bismuth crystal
summary: A stepped, metallic-looking crystal with shifting surface colors.

name: Black pearl
summary: A 100 gp specimen for component shopping. Check the spell’s minimum value.

name: Blackberry fruit leather
summary: Tart strips rolled in wax paper.

name: Blank appointment oval
summary: A recipient can press a handwritten appointment slip against the oval to move the entry onto their skin. A second slip replaces it, and soap clears the oval.

name: Blood sausage links
summary: A string of dark sausages made with blood and seasoning.

name: Bloodroot
summary: A portion of reddish plant root stocked by the apothecary.

name: Blue agate worry bead
summary: One side is polished smooth. The other preserves the curve of the raw stone.

name: Bluecap flour (1 lb)
summary: A blue flour for making bread where grain is scarce.

name: Boneknob
summary: Its hard rind can be carved like a low-grade piece of horn.

name: Boots
summary: Ankle-covering footwear for road and field work.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
summary: Quiet the wearer's footsteps.

name: Boots of False Tracks
summary: Leave prints belonging to a different humanoid of the same size.

player.title: Description
lines: A common wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Boots of the Winterlands
summary: Footwear for cold environments and snowy travel.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Borrowed-key gauge
summary: A loose scale and small clamps preserve a key's profile for comparison while leaving the key usable.

name: Bottled melody
summary: Plays the tune held inside when uncorked and empties after use.

name: Bracket drip tray
summary: Hooks under a wall bracket and slides out for cleaning without moving the candle.

name: Brass wind chimes
summary: Suspended brass pieces that ring when moved by the wind.

name: Breathing Bubble
summary: Maintain breathable air around the wearer's head.

player.title: References
lines: Critical Role: Call of the Netherdeep, p. 213 · https://5e.tools/items.html#breathing%20bubble_crcotn

name: Brimstone (1 lb)
summary: A pound of yellow sulfur sold as a component.

name: Broken sweet sack
summary: An affordable paper bag filled from pieces chipped at the counter that day.

name: Brooch of Shielding
summary: Protect against force damage and magic missile.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Broom
summary: A bundle of stiff sweeping fibers secured to a long handle.

name: Brown ale
summary: A darker ale with a malt-forward taste.

name: Brown bream string
summary: Five small bony fish for stock and pickling.

name: Brushes for long and short winter coats
summary: Two brushes have different bristle lengths and distinct handles.

name: Bubble wand
summary: Makes one bubble large enough to carry a sealed written note over water.

name: Bucket
summary: Useful for drawing water, bailing, or carrying rubble.

name: Burglar's Pack
summary: Ready-packed supplies for a break-in. Check the source for contents.

name: Burial index
summary: Newly written names point to graves with a location recorded in the book. Unrecorded burials leave the page blank.

name: Butter biscuits
summary: Crumbly biscuits flavored with butter.

name: Butter-braised leeks
summary: Soft leeks served cold in a shallow plate with a bread end.

name: Cabbage head
summary: One firm head of cabbage.

name: Calibrated scale weights
summary: Spare weights from one ounce to one pound, stamped to verify a scale with a known load.

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
summary: Tools for professional lettering and inscription.

name: Camel
summary: A pack or riding mount suited to dry routes.

name: Camp water dipper
summary: A long hooked handle can reach inside a barrel and hang on its rim.

name: Candied fennel envelope
summary: Tiny sugar-coated seeds served after a heavy meal.

name: Candle of the Deep
summary: Gives light while submerged instead of going out.

name: Canted water jar
summary: Its ceramic foot rights itself to stand on a tilting bench while the jar is half full or less.

name: Canvas (1 sq. yd.)
summary: Heavy cloth for bags, awnings, and sail repairs.

name: Canvas roll
summary: A roll of heavy woven cloth for coverings, sacks, or patching.

name: Canvas shade sling
summary: Four loops and a shallow cut let a pair of travelers pitch shade without using a whole tent.

name: Cap of Water Breathing
summary: Breathe underwater while wearing the cap.

name: Cape
summary: A sleeveless outer layer that hangs from the shoulders.

name: Caravan muster ribbon
summary: Long ribbon with hand loops for keeping a caravan together in poor visibility.

name: Care and Feeding of Familiars
summary: Explains ordinary feeding and rest for common familiar shapes.

name: Carriage
summary: Enclosed passenger transport with seating and shelter.

name: Carrot bunch
summary: A tied bunch of fresh carrots.

name: Carved drinking cup
summary: A drinking cup with a carved exterior and a firm grip.

name: Celestial blood (vial)
summary: A sealed vial of blood from a celestial creature.

name: Censer
summary: A bowl or hanging vessel for burning incense.

name: Chalcedony
summary: A pale, translucent carving stone.

name: Chalk marking string
summary: Snaps a straight line onto cloth, stone, or timber.

name: Chalk trace wallet
summary: Stiff sleeves keep four labeled rubbings apart and catch the dust from friable marks.

name: Charcoal (1 lb)
summary: A pound of charred wood for drawing, fuel, or mixing.

name: Chariot
summary: A light, open vehicle for fast travel on level ground.

player.title: References
lines: Mythic Odysseys of Theros, p. 196 · https://5e.tools/items.html#chariot_mot

name: Charlatan's Die
summary: The attuned holder can choose how it lands.

player.title: Description
lines: A common wondrous item. Attunement required.

player.title: Description

name: Chime of Opening

name: Collapsible sawhorse

name: Cooking utensils

name: Copper ingot (1 lb)

name: Coralsprout
summary: Grows near hot vents. Cuts of the chilled root go soft and pink.

name: Corner crease clip
summary: Closes on two folded pages without piercing either one.

name: Cotton candy ration

name: Cotton Cloth (1 sq. yd.)

name: Counterweight clasp
summary: Clasp it to both ends of a strap. The ends feel equally heavy in your hands. The heavier side can still pull the strap and whatever it carries off balance.

name: Courgette pie
summary: A savory pastry filled with sliced courgettes.

name: Courgettes (three)

name: Courtship sachets (pair)

name: Covered wagon

name: Cow

name: Crab hamper with double lid

name: Crate
summary: A sturdy slatted box for stacking or carrying goods.

name: Creamed parsnip crocks (two)
summary: Two small hot earthenware bowls meant to be shared.

name: Credit chalk and slate

name: Creel divider
summary: Keeps bait and catch in separate parts of one basket.

name: Crossbow Bolt Case
summary: Holds crossbow ammunition separately from an arrow quiver.

name: Crucible sling
summary: A loose metal cradle lets two people walk a cool crucible down stairs without tilting it.

name: Crystalheart
summary: A slice clouds in contact with fouled water.

name: Cucumbers (three)
summary: Three cucumbers sold together.

name: Cushioned tracing pad
summary: A washable pad collects pressure marks on soft chalk so a harness can be adjusted before the next day's ride.

name: Darts (10)
summary: Ten small weighted throwing darts packed together.

name: Deadline-release clip
summary: Agree on an hour with a second person. Attach the clip to the flap of a document wallet. After that hour, the clip opens for either participant. Before then, both must hold it.

name: Debtwitness seal box
summary: Press one document against the bottom to record its outline and total number of seals. The next document can be checked against both. The box displays no words.

name: Decanter of Endless Water
summary: Issue a stream or a forceful jet of water by command.

name: Deck creel rack
summary: A board with pegs and a drain slot holds fish baskets off the deck.

name: Deck tally sliders
summary: Ten painted beads run on a wire fixed to the rail for counting baskets as they come aboard.

name: Delivery crock with a witness groove

name: Dew catch for a feed rack

name: Diamond

name: Diamond dust
summary: A packet of finely powdered diamond sold by the component merchant.

name: Dinner with a Mimic

name: Directing a Witness
summary: A clerk's handbook with diagrams for placing observers where they can reconstruct the same event.

name: Disguise Kit
summary: Supplies for changing a person's outward appearance.

name: Dishcloth of clear water

name: Double-mouth serving pitcher

name: Dovetail tapers (pair)

name: Draft threads

name: Dragon blood (vial)

name: Dragon scale shard
summary: A broken piece of a large dragon scale.

name: Drawknife saddle
summary: Light clamping board catches a workpiece against a bench while a drawknife is pulled.

name: Dream admission ticket
summary: Lets one willing sleeper follow a companion into the same dream.

name: Dream biscuit
summary: The taste recalls the last meal you shared with someone.

name: Dreamweaver root
summary: Eat a cooked piece alongside an unfamiliar dish and that night you dream of the last ingredient added to the dish.

name: Dressed chicken
summary: A plucked, cleaned chicken ready for cooking.

name: Dried beans (sack)
summary: A sack of dry beans for soaking and cooking.

name: Dried moss (1 lb)
summary: A pound of dried moss packed loose for the component bench.

name: Dried mushroom assortment
summary: Three edible sorts in separate paper sleeves.

name: Dried peas (sack)
summary: A sack of dried peas for soups, stews, and storage.

name: Dried plums (packet)
summary: Enough fruit for two breakfasts.

name: Dried scallop fan
summary: Four scallops wrapped separately to keep them from sticking.

name: Dried smelt pouch
summary: A handful of thin preserved fish. Good for a trail snack or bait.

name: Driftglobe
summary: Carry a light that can float beside the party.

name: Drip clock flask

name: Drowsy shield
summary: Softens sound when set upright between a sleeper and a doorway.

name: Dry cedar shaving oil
summary: Sold with a scrap of the same wood so soap and shaving oil can be matched.

name: Dusk cabbage
summary: Outer leaves darken as the light drops.

name: Dust of Deliciousness
summary: Flavors up to six servings. Gives diners disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saves for 1 hour.

name: Dust of Disappearance

name: Dust of Dryness

name: Eagle feather

name: Echo crystal

name: Eel stew

name: Efficient Quiver

name: Folded chalk tray

name: Folding Boat

name: Forgery Kit

name: Fossil rib

name: Fossil shell

name: Four-person tent

name: Gloomtide tuber

lines: Attunement · Required by a creature with the Mark of Warding

player.title: Description
lines: A small key-shaped charm used by House Kundarak. An attuned bearer with the Mark of Warding can bind up to three castings of Alarm, Arcane Lock, or Glyph of Warding to it.

player.title: How it works
lines: The holder receives the Alarm alert, can bypass the Arcane Lock, or can pass the warded spot without setting off the glyph.
A holder who knows the command word can spend an action to end one bound spell. The holder does not need to be attuned.

name: Luminous moss
summary: A living patch that gives enough light to make out nearby steps.

name: Mackerel icefish slab
summary: Firm meat packed in coarse snow. The vendor can cut it into narrow steaks on request.

name: Magnetite
summary: A natural lodestone for testing iron.

name: Maize flour (1 lb)
summary: A pound of finely ground maize for cooking and baking.

name: Malachite
summary: A banded green stone for carving or small inlays.

name: Mandrake root
summary: A dried, branching root sold by the apothecary.

name: Margin bridge bookmark
summary: Put one end in each of two copies of the same book. A pencil mark written over one end transfers to the other margin once, even when one edition has different page numbers.

name: Margin knife with guard
summary: A blunt guide edge holds the page above the cut while a narrow blade removes a margin.

name: Marked shelf stop
summary: A tapered wooden block records how far a delicate jar can sit forward without touching a closing door.

name: Masquerade Tattoo
summary: Restyle the tattoo or use it to change your appearance briefly.

player.title: Description
lines: A common wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Mast perch
summary: A wide lightweight perch straps beneath a horizontal spar. The end bends if bumped by a sail.

name: Mastiff
summary: A large dog for guarding loads or carrying small riders.

name: Mead
summary: A fermented honey drink.

name: Measuring slate with string holes
summary: Draw the room on the slate and knot each measurement cord through the hole marked for its wall. The cords keep their order when you move the slate.

name: Meat hand pie
summary: A pastry parcel filled with meat and sized to eat without a plate.

name: Melting clock
summary: Softens as the room approaches the hour set on its dial.

name: Memory soot lantern
summary: A pale outline remains in its beam for one hour after it returns to full brightness. It matches the last object to fully block the opening.

name: Merchant wagon
summary: A wagon made for hauling a trader’s goods along roads.

name: Mesh coin strainer
summary: Screens dirt and coarse grit from coins and small fittings.

name: Mess kit
summary: An individual eating set for one traveler.

name: Migrant swallow tattoo
summary: The swallow shifts between two fixed positions each day. The artist sets both positions and the time of the shift when applying it.

name: Milled oat griddle cakes (six)
summary: Thin cakes sold still warm and wrapped together with paper dividers.

name: Minted curd pocket
summary: A warm pastry sealed around fresh curds and chopped mint.

name: Mirror of echoes
summary: Reflects the empty room as it appeared a minute ago.

name: Mithral ingot (1 lb)
summary: A one-pound bar of lightweight mithral for specialist metalwork.

name: Mixed offal
summary: A butcher’s assortment of edible organ cuts.

name: Mixed peppers (basket)
summary: A basket of peppers in assorted colors and shapes.

name: Moonbulb
summary: Its juice briefly sharpens the contrast between dim shapes.

name: Moorbounder
summary: A powerful jumping mount for buyers who can handle a large predator.

name: Moth in a jar
summary: Its wings stay still near cold light and flutter near open flame.

name: Mulling spice pouch
summary: A packet of spices for warming in wine, ale, or cider.

name: Muroosa Balm
summary: Apply over 1 minute to gain fire resistance for 1 hour.

name: Mushroom and chestnut skewer
summary: Cooked chestnuts separate the mushrooms for an even char.

name: Mushroom and leek pie
summary: A savory pie filled with mushrooms and leeks.

name: Mute wedge for a stage drum
summary: A soft wedge slides under a drumhead to take out a sharp ring in a small room.

name: Mutton chops
summary: Small cuts of sheep meat taken across the ribs or loin.

name: Mutton joint
summary: A large cut of sheep meat suitable for slow cooking or roasting.

name: Mutton stew
summary: Slow-cooked mutton served in broth with vegetables.

name: Mystery Key
summary: Test it on a lock that lacks its key. It vanishes once it opens one.

name: Narrow latch shim set
summary: Thin wood shims lift a sagging door to sort out the position of a catch during fitting.

name: Navigator's Tools
summary: Equipment for finding a course and tracking position.

name: Nectar tuning pod
summary: After air flows steadily into the wide end for a minute, the pod hums. Point it the other way and the sound stops.

name: Needle of Mending
summary: Repair a torn object using the needle.

player.title: Description
lines: A rare melee weapon. Attunement required.

name: Nelma fillet
summary: One fillet of brackish-water whitefish, sold skin on.

name: Nested storage crocks (three)
summary: Interchangeable lids fit three different depths.

name: Net drying pins (bundle)
summary: Hardwood clips hold a wet net up during a wash without pinching through the mesh.

name: Night parfait
summary: Its layers separate again if the cup is left in darkness.

name: Nightlight stem
summary: It loses its glow when pinched, so a traveler can extinguish it without opening a shutter.

name: Nightmare hook
summary: Pulls a sleeping creature out of a nightmare without waking others nearby.

name: Nightshirt
summary: A loose shirt intended for sleeping.

name: Northern pike steaks
summary: Each paper packet holds two large cuts and a bag for the bones.

name: Northern squid ink pot
summary: Dark cooking ink. This pot comes with enough for a large batch of dough.

name: Northern squid mantle
summary: A cleaned cut for thin strips or stuffing.

name: Number stencil strip
summary: The ten decimal digits perforated in a thin strip of horn.

name: Oat pottage
summary: A warm, thick bowl of cooked oats.

name: Oatcake
summary: A flat oat cake sturdy enough to pack for travel.

name: Obsidian shard
summary: A dark glassy fragment with a sharp broken edge.

name: Offset rod flags (bundle)
summary: Color flags identify corners a surveyor measured indirectly.

name: Olisuba Leaf
summary: A prepared infusion for a night spent recovering from exhaustion.

name: Onion bunch
summary: Several fresh onions tied together for sale.

name: Opinion pebble
summary: Pass it around once among people who agree to answer a yes-or-no question. It counts each consenting holder’s first spoken yes or no and shows only the total number of yes votes. Silence does not affect the total.

name: Orange peel curls
summary: Bitter at first, with crystallized syrup in the creases.

name: Orb of Direction
summary: Check which way is north while on the Material Plane.

name: Orb of Time
summary: Check the time of day on the Material Plane.

name: Orichalcum ore
summary: An unrefined sample of ore sold as a source of orichalcum.

name: Ox
summary: A draft animal for heavy loads.

name: Oysters (dozen)
summary: Twelve oysters in their shells.

name: Pace-marked wick
summary: Touch the wick before walking. It burns through one stripe for every hundred paces you take while the candle remains lit.

name: Page pricking wheel
summary: A small wheel marks repeatable margins and fold locations without applying ink.

name: Painted porcelain cameo
summary: The jeweler can replace the miniature from a sitter or an existing sketch.

name: Paired dish rests
summary: Put two matching vessels on the ceramic rests. They tap once if the amounts of liquid become equal. Lifting either vessel resets them.

name: Paired sevens
summary: These dice always total seven together. Rolled apart, they behave normally.

name: Pannier rain cuff
summary: An oiled flap keeps rain out when a pannier lid must stay open around a tall bundle.

name: Paper (one sheet)
summary: A sheet for letters or notes.

name: Paper Bird
summary: Send up to 50 words to a named recipient on the same plane.

name: Paper glider
summary: Follows the draft through a room and lands at the strongest exit.

name: Parade jelly star
summary: Break the star into its five points. Each point whistles a different note when the eater breathes out within ten seconds of swallowing it.

name: Parsnip bundle
summary: Several parsnips bundled together.

name: Patched courier pannier
summary: A split side pocket has been stitched shut. The inside is still deep enough for two rolled maps.

name: Pattern roller for wet clay
summary: A repeatable leaf shape helps a buyer match decorative tiles.

name: Pear and sorrel relish jar
summary: A sweet-sour preserve for a cheese or meat plate.

name: Pegged lid blank
summary: Unfinished top with a peg to grip while fitting it to an old pot.

name: Pepper
summary: Sold by the pound.

name: Perforated pollinator hood
summary: Mesh and a stiff brim keep insects out of the wearer's face while they watch a plant from close by.

name: Perfume blotter pack
summary: Plain paper slips with space to mark which sample is on each.

name: Perfume of Bewitching
summary: A short-lived social aid when dealing with humanoids of low challenge.

name: Periapt of Health
summary: Protect against disease while wearing it.

player.title: Description
lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure
summary: Stabilize more reliably and recover more from spent Hit Dice.

lines: An uncommon wondrous item. Attunement required.

name: Perry
summary: Cider made from pears.

name: Pet collar
summary: An adjustable collar sized for a small household animal.

name: Petrified wood
summary: A polished sample showing rings in stone.

name: Phoenix ash (1 oz)
summary: An ounce of ash gathered from a phoenix’s remains.

name: Phosphor rock
summary: Shines weakly for an hour after exposure to daylight.

name: Pie vent bird
summary: The hollow bird lets steam through a covered pie while it bakes.

name: Pig
summary: One live pig.

name: Pigment swatch booklet
summary: Includes the fresh and healed appearance of twelve inks on painted paper samples.

name: Pin punches (set)
summary: Drives small pins in or out without widening their holes.

name: Pipe of Smoke Monsters
summary: Make a short-lived smoke outline for a story or demonstration.

name: Pitcher
summary: A wide-mouthed serving vessel.

name: Pitchfork
summary: A long-handled fork for moving hay, straw, and other loose material.

name: Pivot proof pin
summary: Slide the pin through two adjacent threaded parts. It turns amber if they are assembled with opposing threads. It does not reveal how to remove either part.

name: Plain silver witness ring
summary: A broad flat band leaves room for two sets of initials.

name: Plan-reader lamp
summary: On a correctly scaled plan of a real building, its flame winks at added or relocated doors. It indicates a renovation and leaves the current location for the party to find.

name: Plane table
summary: A leveled board with a rotating sight for plotting bearings in the field.

name: Platinum ore
summary: Unrefined ore sold for its platinum content.

name: Plum-sour braised cabbage
summary: Dark cabbage with dried plums and brown bread.

name: Pocket calendar
summary: A small calendar that fits into a coat pocket or satchel.

name: Pocket crown
summary: Leaves a readable imprint of its maker's mark in wax.

name: Pocket paper level
summary: A folded paper triangle with thread and bead gives a rough level on furniture.

name: Pocket stove
summary: A small camp stove that folds into its lid after cooling.

name: Poisoner's Kit
summary: Tools for handling fictional toxins in an alchemy scene.

name: Pole of Angling
summary: Carry a short pole that can change into a fishing rod.

name: Pole of Collapsing
summary: Carry a long probing pole in a much shorter form.

name: Porcelain heart
summary: Beats once when its paired doll is moved.

name: Pot of Awakening
summary: Raise a mundane shrub into a small awakened companion over time.

name: Potion of Diminution
summary: Temporarily shrink for an infiltration or escape.

name: Potion of Flying
summary: A single-use flight option. Stock it at shops capable of sourcing exceptional potions.

name: Potion of Invisibility
summary: Grants invisibility for up to 1 hour. Attacking or casting a spell ends it early.

name: Potion of Resistance
summary: A potion keyed to a particular damage type. The bottle’s type determines the resistance it grants.

name: Potion of Speed
summary: A limited burst of haste without tying up a caster.

name: Potion of Vitality
summary: A recovery potion for exhaustion and other ailments.

name: Potpourri sachet
summary: A small cloth packet of scented dried flowers and herbs.

name: Pouch of sand
summary: A small pouch of dry grit for spell components or workshop use.

name: Pressed barley loaf
summary: Baked in a rectangular mold for even slices that pack flat.

name: Pressed flower pastilles
summary: Each box contains a dozen translucent sweets with an edible petal visible inside.

name: Pressed mustard pot
summary: The seller takes back the glazed pot for a copper.

name: Priest's Pack
summary: Field supplies for a traveling priest.

name: Prismatic crystal
summary: A faceted crystal that separates light into bands of color.

name: Prosthetic Limb
summary: A wearable replacement limb that functions for ordinary tasks.

name: Pull-apart saffron ring
summary: A circle of joined buns with scored separations.

name: Pull-out stove shelf
summary: A short ceramic rack can be withdrawn with a gloved hand.

name: Pumpkin and ginger soup
summary: A warm bowl of pumpkin soup seasoned with ginger.

name: Pumpkin language biscuit
summary: For ten minutes, understand the literal meaning of an unfamiliar spoken language. Complex figures of speech still need a speaker to explain them.

name: Quick-release shoulder cape
summary: Its stitched loop can be pulled free if a worker catches the hem in a moving door.

name: Quiet rivet sleeves
summary: Leather-lined collars quiet loose fittings long enough to test which one is knocking.

name: Quiet-check door wedge
summary: Push under an open door. It stays wedged until its owner speaks at their normal volume within the same room.

name: Quire tally clips (six)
summary: Removable grips count sets of pages without folding them.

name: Ragebloom
summary: Peppery enough to provoke tears for a minute after a bite.

name: Rain spout tile
summary: A shallow half-pipe diverts drips away from a doorstep.

name: Rapid sprouting tonic
summary: Poured over a dormant seed, it makes first growth visible before the end of the scene. It cannot sustain the plant afterward.

name: Raven throat mask
summary: Repeat one sound you heard since dawn in its original voice. It can be used once per dawn.

name: Reading a Trapped Room
summary: Lists everyday clues to spring plates, disguised holes, and worn hinges.

name: Rebored tin drinking mug
summary: The handle was moved for a left-handed buyer. Old mounting holes are plugged.

name: Receipt bowl of first choice
summary: Have one willing participant put three folded price slips into the bowl one at a time. When someone stirs them, the first slip that went in rises to the top.

name: Recessed sounding cup
summary: A small sample cup rides flush in the base of a sounding weight.

name: Recipe testing spoons (set)
summary: Five shallow spoons with stamped volumes for scaling a large batch.

name: Refinished writing slope
summary: A scratched hinged board props up on a set of pegs and fits onto a lap.

name: Reindeer-hide boots
summary: Thick lining keeps out snow at the cost of a bulky fit.

name: Removable bench apron rail
summary: Hooks into two bench holes to move a hanging tool apron from one workbench to another.

name: Rendered fish fat tin
summary: A salty cooking fat in a small tin with a broad lip.

name: Rendered goose fat pot
summary: A lidded pot of cooking fat with a wide mouth for a cold spoon.

name: Repaired leather apron
summary: The pockets face sideways. One shows where its old owner kept a burnisher.

name: Replacement oven brick
summary: Sold with the shape and kiln mark written on its wrapping.

name: Reversible bilge mat
summary: A slatted mat catches loose cargo on one side and sits above shallow water on the other.

name: Reversible watch chain
summary: A swivel lets the wearer turn an engraved face toward their waistcoat.

name: Rhodochrosite
summary: A pink ornamental stone.

name: Riding crop
summary: A short, flexible riding aid with a looped grip.

name: Ring of Feather Falling
summary: Fall more slowly when the wearer drops.

name: Ring of Jumping
summary: Use a magic-assisted jump when climbing alone will not do.

name: Ring of Mind Shielding
summary: Screen thoughts and certain magical attempts to identify the wearer.

name: Ring of Obscuring
summary: Raise a patch of fog for concealment.

name: Ring of Swimming
summary: Gain a swim speed without using a spell.

name: Ring of Water Walking
summary: Cross supported liquids on foot.

name: Ring sizing ribbon
summary: A paper ribbon marked in local sizes. The jeweler includes one with a commission.

name: Ripplebark skewer
summary: Looks unappetizing raw. Roasted, it has the chew of a fresh mushroom.

name: River sounding pole
summary: Marked at one-foot intervals. Its flat disk touches silt without immediately sinking through it.

name: Roast mutton
summary: A serving of sliced roast sheep meat.

name: Roasted coffee beans
summary: Whole roasted coffee beans sold for grinding and brewing.

name: Roasted onion with barley filling
summary: Served with a spoon and a small jug of broth.

name: Room-tone tuning fork
summary: Strike it and hold it still to hear the strongest resonant pitch in the room. It makes no reading outdoors.

name: Rope of Climbing
summary: Send one end of the rope toward an anchor by command.

name: Rope of Mending
summary: Rejoin its severed pieces by command.

name: Rosemary sprigs
summary: Several aromatic rosemary sprigs for cooking or drying.

name: Rosewater splash
summary: A mild scent that fades in about an hour.

name: Round spectacles
summary: Round corrective lenses held in a small frame.

name: Rowboat
summary: Good for short crossings and bringing a few people ashore.

name: Rye flour (1 lb)
summary: A pound of ground rye for dense loaves and cakes.

name: Rye loaf
summary: A dense loaf made with rye flour.

name: Saddlebag divider set
summary: Stiff dividers keep tools from shifting under a fragile load and unlatch without removing the bag.

name: Saffron
summary: Sold by the pound.

name: Sailing ship
summary: A wind-driven merchant vessel for cargo and passengers.

name: Salt (1 lb)
summary: A pound of coarse salt for cooking, preserving food, or components.

name: Salted bacon slab
summary: An uncut piece of salt-cured bacon.

name: Salted herring
summary: Herring preserved in salt for storage and travel.

name: Sardonyx
summary: Layered stone suited to engraving a cameo.

name: Satchel
summary: A shoulder bag with a flap to keep papers and small supplies together.

name: Scented candle
summary: A wax candle that releases fragrance as it burns.

name: Scented lamp oil
summary: Burns in an ordinary lamp with a pronounced flower scent.

name: Screw sorting strip
summary: Slotted card holds small screws in removal order without needing separate dishes.

name: Scribe's Pen
summary: Write without carrying ink.

lines: A common wondrous item. Attunement required by a creature with the Mark of Scribing.

name: Scrimshaw pendant
summary: An engraved bone or ivory ornament worn on a cord.

name: Scroll of a Patient Reply
summary: Read it to give one willing recipient time to write an answer on it. Until the recipient writes, the sheet shows exactly when they agreed to answer. The inscription ends at the next sunrise.

name: Scroll of a Silent Appointment
summary: Write two times and places on the sheet. Two willing readers learn silently and at the same time which appointment their shared ward can admit them to. The ink vanishes once that time passes.

name: Scroll of Brief Magnitude
summary: Speak the name of one object you can touch. It projects a one-minute scale drawing of the longest edge, even if the far end is hidden. Afterward the sheet burns away harmlessly.

name: Scroll of Common Ground
summary: Two willing people read three proposed terms aloud while touching the page. It underlines the terms they both intend to honor as worded. The underlines fade as soon as either leaves.

name: Scroll of One Decisive Amendment
summary: Hold it behind a document that has been edited at least once and read. The most recent deliberate alteration is highlighted for ten seconds. An entire replacement page counts as one alteration.

name: Scroll of the Walked Boundary
summary: Read it and walk the loop it describes continuously. The paper draws each spot where the named fence, shore, or road diverges from your path. The next rain destroys the new marks.

name: Scrying orb
summary: A polished sphere for a diviner’s kit. Its name gives it no spellcasting property on its own.

name: Sea bream with rice
summary: Cooked sea bream served with a portion of rice.

name: Seal sample envelope
summary: A rigid split envelope holds the two halves of a broken wax seal without letting the edges rub together.

name: Seasonal coat hanger
summary: After a coat hangs here for a day, the tag writes the month when it was hung. It updates each time the same coat is hung again.

name: Secondhand snow globe
summary: Shows the room where the globe last spent a whole winter. Move it closer to your face to find people in the windows.

name: Secondhand stage cloak
summary: Two contrasting linings can be pulled out to show at a cue.

name: Secondhand theater hood
summary: Anyone wearing it can hear a person breathing behind a cloth curtain within arm's reach. Solid walls and doors block the effect.

name: Secret diary
summary: Ink vanishes unless its writer opens the clasp.

name: Seed pearl
summary: A very small pearl suitable for fine work or spell components.

name: Settling jar with side spout
summary: Draw clear liquid above the sediment without tipping the jar or clouding a sample again.

name: Shabby border frame
summary: Insert a paper drawing. While it stays there, copies slipped into other frames hang flat without backing, pins, or glue.

name: Shadow length notch
summary: A notch inside the mark records the length of the wearer's shadow when tapped. The next tap erases and replaces the record.

name: Shadowfang root
summary: A spiral inside the bulb shows the oldest growth first.

name: Shallow print tray
summary: A tray of damp fine sand takes an imprint from a suspect shoe for comparison with tracks.

name: Shallow sea-pet basin
summary: A glazed basin fits in a larger box so it can be carried level.

name: Shed carapace
summary: The intact shell can be fitted over a lantern as a directional shade.

name: Sheepskin coat
summary: A heavy coat lined with its own fleece.

name: Sheet ghost charm
summary: A harmless ghost shape hangs in the air where the charm is pinned.

name: Sheet of first folds
summary: Place it under an already folded letter, then unfold the letter over it. The sheet keeps a diagram of the creases with the oldest fold marked.

name: Shelf cheese wheel
summary: A palm-sized waxed wheel intended for travel.

name: Shell bead necklace
summary: A necklace strung with polished shell beads.

name: Shield of Expression
summary: A shield face with an expression the bearer can change.

name: Shift-change armband set
summary: Three washable bands can mark an agreed duty or signal whose watch is next without a badge.

name: Shiftweave
summary: Switch between several outfits stored in one garment.

printings.label: Eberron: Rising from the Last War

name: Shoes
summary: Low everyday footwear for dry floors and streets.

name: Shoulder sun flap
summary: Clips to either side of a hat to shade the neck when walking across open ground.

name: Shrimp skewer
summary: Several shrimp threaded onto a stick for grilling or serving.

name: Shrinking cordial
summary: For ten minutes the drinker and their worn gear shrink enough to pass through a gap made for a house cat.

name: Side of pork
summary: A large butcher’s cut for portioning into smaller joints.

name: Sightline wax pellets (pair)
summary: Stick one pellet at a destination within a hundred paces. The other softens when pressed to a lit directional lantern that points directly at its mate.

name: Signal horn
summary: A hollow horn that carries a call across a camp, field, or stretch of road.

name: Signet Ring
summary: A personal seal for stamped correspondence.

name: Silk (1 sq. yd.)
summary: Fine cloth for dressmaking and decorative work.

name: Silk Rope (50 feet)
summary: A lighter alternative to the store's hemp rope.

name: Silk shirt
summary: A lightweight shirt of smooth woven silk.

name: Sill marker charm
summary: Mark a window latch and hold the charm. It makes the sound of the latch if the window opens before dawn within the same building.

name: Silver ingot (1 lb)
summary: A one-pound cast bar of silver for metalwork or trade.

name: Silver mirror
summary: A small mirror with a polished silver reflecting surface.

name: Skate stock block
summary: A compressed block flavored with skate and browned onion. Dissolve it in a pot of hot water.

name: Skinned rabbit
summary: A cleaned rabbit with the hide removed, ready for a stew or roast.

name: Sky jigsaw
summary: Holds one glimpse of the weather above the roof.

name: Slate brood marker
summary: A short foot stands on rough ground and the chalk face records the last turning.

name: Slate route tile
summary: Mark bearings and distances on a hand-sized tile, then wipe it clean for the next leg.

name: Sleepwalk slippers
summary: Track the wearer's route in faint chalk dust until dawn.

name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
summary: Free both hands while moving across suitable walls or ceilings.

name: Small ale
summary: A light, low-strength ale served as a table drink.

name: Small Doors and Narrow Halls

name: Small object sample rig
summary: Holds a sample near the edge of a table for testing under different angles of light.

name: Smoked paprika tin
summary: The tight lid keeps the powder from perfuming the whole pack.

name: Smoky quartz
summary: A translucent quartz stone with a brown or gray tint.

name: Soap
summary: A bar for cleaning hands, clothing, or gear.

name: Soft aftercare wrap
summary: A washable cloth band with a loose weave and flat fastener.

name: Soft fence flag set
summary: Pale strips mark a temporary enclosure without a low wire.

name: Soft vise jaws
summary: Padded inserts grip finished wood or metal without marking it.

name: Sounding bobbin
summary: A weighted spool with color bands every five feet for measuring depth without committing a long rope.

name: Sour pickle crock
summary: Eight small cucumbers in brine. Repack them for travel to leave the crock in town.

name: Spare cog blanks (six)
summary: Uncut circular blanks match common small axle sizes.

name: Spare lute peg
summary: Rough-shaped hardwood with room for the buyer to fit the taper.

name: Spark drops (dozen)
summary: Crackling lights flash at the lips. Different flavors create different colors.

name: Spellshard
summary: Store writing in a crystal instead of on paper.

name: Spiced bun
summary: A soft bakery roll scented with warm spices.

name: Spider silk (1 oz)
summary: An ounce of fine spider thread wound together for storage.

name: Spinach tart
summary: An open savory tart filled with spinach.

name: Spinel
summary: A cut gem for jewelry or trade.

name: Spirit stone
summary: Warms within arm's reach of an incorporeal creature.

name: Splinter apron
summary: Dense felt along the pockets catches stray wood chips before they work into a worker's cuffs.

name: Split heir ring
summary: Two distinct rings interlock around a single stone. A buyer can wear either half separately.

name: Split hourglass
summary: Sand runs only while both halves are held by different people.

name: Split pea hand pie
summary: A baked folded crust with peas and pickled onion.

name: Split-rope turnout lead
summary: A forked last length attaches on both sides of a halter to spread pressure.

name: Spyglass
summary: Study an object, shoreline, or sail from a distance.

name: Stabling (per day)
summary: A night's berth and care for one mount.

name: Stacking water tins (three)
summary: Three square tins each hold a half gallon. They strap together on a pack frame without rolling.

name: Staff of Birdcalls
summary: Reproduce selected bird sounds to cue a friend or entertain a crowd.

name: Staff of Flowers
summary: Grow a flower from suitable ground using a charge.

name: Stage chime chain
summary: Three metal bars hang at different lengths and sound across a hall.

name: Star compass
summary: Points toward the last unobstructed view of the night sky.

name: Steel ingot (1 lb)
summary: A one-pound bar of steel stock for the forge.

name: Stern mooring pad
summary: A leather pad straps to a rope where it rubs over the back of a boat.

name: Stone of Good Luck
summary: A carried charm that improves checks and saves.

summary: Two arms extend just far enough to support the shoulders of an ordinary garment, then retract when it is lifted.

name: Tally dots
summary: Tap one of five dots in sequence to darken it. A long press on the first dot clears all five.

name: Tally floats
summary: Small numbered corks mark which containers drifted through a sluice or crossed a flood channel.

name: Tankard of Sobriety
summary: Drink alcohol from this vessel without getting drunk.

name: Tare washer
summary: Place it on the loaded pan of an ordinary balance beside an empty container and tap it once. It cancels its own weight and the weight of that container until it is lifted, so the balance measures anything added afterward.

name: Temporary hinge pin
summary: A stepped peg covers three common diameters for test-hanging a door.

name: Tent seam brush
summary: Pushes dust out of a fold before it can abrade stitched fabric.

name: Thank-you cake
summary: An inscription written in icing stays legible on every slice, even a slice cut before the message was added.

name: The Dark Below the Old Road
summary: A journal of a descent with notes on where the author turned back.

name: Theki Root
summary: Chew before an encounter where poison is expected.

name: Thickness gauge
summary: Transfers one measurement to multiple parts without reading a scale.

name: Thieves' Tools
summary: Fine tools for locks and mechanical traps.

name: Thread of opposite seams
summary: Split the length in half, sew a seam with each half, then tug one free. The other seam loosens at the same time. Useful for temporary fitting and stage clothes.

name: Three-Dragon Ante Set

name: Three-generation mourning locket

name: Throat-rest mouthpiece

name: Thunderstone
summary: A single-use signal stone that cracks with a thunderclap if dropped.

name: Tide reading slip board
summary: A float leaves a drawn maximum water level on a replaceable paper slip.

name: Tidewort
summary: A crisp cave vegetable that loses its briny flavor when dried.

name: Tile of two temperatures

name: Tin chorus mark

name: Tin fuel funnel

name: Titanium ore

name: Tomatoes (basket)

name: Tongs

name: Transfer paper folio

name: Translucent plan folio

name: Travel candle tube

name: Travel jewel roll
summary: Divided suede pockets keep hard stones from scratching softer ones.

name: Travel stencil tube

name: Traveler's Clothes

name: Treble chocolate

name: Trial-fit price tag

name: Trillimac cap sheet

name: Tuning hammer
summary: The shallow square socket grips a common zither or hammered-dulcimer peg.

name: Turned copper ear cuffs

name: Turned-cuff tool wrap

name: Turnips (sack)

name: Turnover copying board

name: Twineleaf splint leaf (pair)

name: Twohorn sculpin belly

name: Unbleached dancer's gloves

name: Uncertain egg

name: Undecided forecast

name: Unicorn hair

name: Unicorn horn

name: Unmeltable ice bonbon
summary: Snap apart the two halves. For a minute, each half tastes of the food or drink touching its counterpart.

name: Unscented wash powder
summary: Cleans clothes without leaving a fragrance.

name: Unspun wool (bag)

name: Used rolltop document case

name: Veilroot
summary: Steam from a cooked slice catches faint drafts at ground level.

name: Velvet vapor mask

name: Vinegar jug
summary: Pickling vinegar in a stoppered earthenware jug.

name: Vinegar mussel jar

name: Viol

name: Violin

name: Volunteer number panel

name: Wading staff grip

name: Wool hose

name: Work apron
summary: A protective apron for a shopkeeper or craftsperson.

name: Zinc dust (1 oz)

name: Zurkhwood plank

gm.title: Description
lines: This winged scout watches for elemental incursions. An aarakocra can attack in a dive or throw a javelin from the air.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A feathered humanoid with a bird’s beak, talons and broad wings.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Perception +5, passive Perception 15. Aarakocra and Auran.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dive Attack. A melee weapon attack deals 3 (1d6) extra damage if the aarakocra hits after flying at least 30 ft. in a straight dive toward the target.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Talon. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Summon Air Elemental. Five aarakocra within 30 ft. of one another can perform an aerial dance. Each spends its action and movement on three successive turns and maintains Concentration during the dance. After the last dancer finishes its third turn, an Air Elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the group. It is friendly to the summoners and follows their spoken commands. It stays for 1 hour, until it dies, until all five summoners die, or until any summoner dismisses it as a bonus action. Each summoner must finish a Short Rest before it can perform the dance again. When the air elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, aarakocra within 5 ft. of it may go with it.

lines: Monster Manual (2014), p. 12, with official errata.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Amphibious. The aboleth can breathe air and water. Mucous Cloud. While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater. Probing Telepathy. If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks. Tentacle. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature’s skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can’t regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Enslave (3/Day). The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth’s control and can’t take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The aboleth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The aboleth regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Detect. The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. Tail Swipe. The aboleth makes one tail attack. Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions). One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Skills History +12, Perception +10 Senses Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 20 Languages Deep Speech; telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Amphibious. The aboleth can breathe air and water. Eldritch Restoration. If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM. Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Mucus Cloud. While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target’s skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can’t regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed. Probing Telepathy. If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available. Tentacle. Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles. Consume Memories. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The aboleth gains the target’s memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this action. Dominate Mind (2/Day). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the aboleth can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The aboleth regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns. Lash. The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack. Psychic Drain. If the aboleth has at least one creature Charmed or Grappled, it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points.

gm.title: Description
lines: Aboleths live in deep waters and remember their kind’s ancient rule. They use telepathy to learn what intruders want and bargain for obedience.

gm.title: DM tactics
lines:
Opening move. If the party approaches the water together, use Enslave on a visible creature within 30 feet. If they close to melee, use Multiattack.
Between turns. A charmed target gives the aboleth a choice between healing with Psychic Drain and spending one legendary action on Tail Swipe.
Player options. The shoreline matters. A character with reach can strike from 10 feet away to avoid Mucous Cloud. Damage gives an enslaved ally another save.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The aboleth breathes in air and water.
Mucous Cloud. While the aboleth is underwater, a creature that touches it or hits it in melee from 5 ft. or closer makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it can only breathe underwater for 1d4 hours due to disease.
Probing Telepathy. If a creature telepathically communicates with the aboleth and the aboleth can see it, the aboleth learns its greatest desires.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning. A creature must also make a DC 14 Constitution save or contract a disease. For the first minute it has no effect and any magic that cures disease can remove it. After that minute the skin turns slimy and translucent, the creature can regain HP only while underwater, and only heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher removes it. Outside a body of water it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless its skin is moistened before that interval elapses.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning.
Enslave (3/day). One creature the aboleth can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure it is magically Charmed and controlled, loses reactions, and can communicate telepathically with the aboleth at any distance. The charm ends if the aboleth dies or they are on different planes. The target can repeat the save when damaged and, at most once in 24 hours, whenever at least 1 mile away. A success ends the charm.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three actions per round, regained at the start of the aboleth’s turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. The aboleth cannot use these while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Swipe (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Psychic Drain (2 actions). One creature Charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The aboleth regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. The aboleth cannot use a lair action when incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Phantasmal Force. Cast phantasmal force without components on any number of visible creatures within 60 ft. The aboleth takes no other lair actions while maintaining Concentration on it. Any creature whose save succeeds or whose effect ends is immune to this lair action for 24 hours unless it chooses to be affected.
Grasping Tide. A pool within 90 ft. surges. Each creature on the ground within 20 ft. of such a pool makes a DC 14 Strength save. Failure pulls it up to 20 ft. into the water and knocks it Prone. Wait until a different lair action has been used before choosing this again.
Psychic Water. Choose any number of visible creatures in the lair’s water within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage. Wait until a different lair action has been used before choosing this again.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Underground surfaces within 1 mile of the lair are slick difficult terrain. Enemies who drink water from a source within 1 mile vomit it back up within minutes. Both effects fade over 3d10 days after the aboleth dies.
Projected Image. As an action, create an intangible likeness within 1 mile of the lair, either at a spot the aboleth has seen or at one a creature it has Charmed can currently see. The likeness looks, sounds, and moves like the aboleth for as long as it maintains Concentration. It can perceive, speak, and use telepathy from the likeness’s position. Any damage to the likeness ends it.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The lair action does not specify a save DC for phantasmal force. Use DC 14 for its Intelligence save and Investigation check as a table ruling, matching the other lair actions.

gm.title: Description
lines: The aboleth spreads slime pox through close contact and uses ancient memories as a psychic weapon.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 20, Stealth 9. Resists acid. Immune to psychic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Deep Speech and telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +5, Dex −1, Con +6, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +4.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Aberrant Resilience. Resistance to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed and Stunned. Advantage on saves against effects that alter its form.
Amphibious. The aboleth breathes in air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, it can choose to succeed.
Probing Telepathy. It learns the greatest desires of a creature it can see if that creature communicates with it telepathically.
Slime Pox. The infected creature can breathe in air and water, can regain HP only underwater, and takes 6 (1d12) acid damage for every hour it stays out of water or its skin goes without added moisture. Every 24 hours, make a DC 16 Charisma save. After three failures it becomes the aboleth’s protective thrall. After three successes it remains infected and autonomous. The results need not be consecutive. Stop making saves when one outcome is reached. Only heal or similar magic cures the disease.
Slimy Skin. Touching the aboleth or hitting it in melee from 5 ft. or closer requires a DC 16 Constitution save against Slime Pox.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Tentacle and Psychic Bolt. If two tentacle attacks hit the same target, it makes a DC 16 Constitution save against Slime Pox.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic.
Psychic Torrent (recharge 5–6). Up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. each make a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, take 49 (14d6) psychic damage and become Incapacitated through the end of the target’s next turn. A success halves the damage and prevents the condition.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three actions per round, regained at the start of the aboleth’s turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. The aboleth cannot use these while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Detect (1 action). Pinpoint every creature and trap within 60 ft. automatically.
Swim (1 action). Swim up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Description
lines: This amphibious aberration gathers servants in sunken ruins and preserves memories of long-dead worlds.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Eldritch Restoration. When destroyed, the aboleth returns in a new body at full HP after 5d10 days. It reappears in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, 4/day in its lair). It can turn a failed save into a success.
Mucus Cloud. While the aboleth is underwater, each creature within a 5-ft. Emanation from it makes a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure curses the creature. Its skin becomes slimy, it can breathe air and water, and it can regain HP only underwater. Outside a body of water it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless its skin is moistened before that interval is up.
Probing Telepathy. When a creature the aboleth can see talks to it telepathically, it learns that creature’s greatest desires.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks, then use Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.
Tentacle. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. One of the four tentacles also Grapples a target that is Large or smaller (escape DC 14).
Consume Memories. One creature within 30 ft. that the aboleth has Charmed or Grappled makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage and success halves it. The aboleth learns the memories of a Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this action.
Dominate Mind (2/day). One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Charmed until the aboleth dies, the two are on different planes, or the creature succeeds on a repeat save. While Charmed it acts as the aboleth’s ally, obeys its control within 60 ft., and can communicate telepathically with it at any distance. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage and after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses (4 in its lair). Spend one use immediately after another creature’s turn. Recover all uses at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Lash. Make one Tentacle attack.
Psychic Drain. If the aboleth has a creature Charmed or Grappled, use Consume Memories and regain 5 (1d10) HP.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Foul Water. Water sources within 1 mile of the lair are befouled. Anyone other than the aboleth or its allies who drinks this water must make a DC 15 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 hour.
Psionic Projection. In its lair the aboleth can cast Project Image without components. It uses Intelligence (save DC 16), the spell reaches 1 mile, and its telepathy can originate in the image’s space.
Both effects end immediately if the aboleth dies or its lair moves.

gm.title: In its lair
lines: 7,200 XP. The traits and Legendary actions sections give the increased resource limits.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Give the players a reason to leave dry ground. Put the captive or the only exit across the water and show what happened to someone who crossed first.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Special Equipment. Acererak carries the Staff of the Forgotten One, wears the Talisman of the Sphere, and controls a Sphere of Annihilation. The staff has 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 spent charges at dawn. Undead of CR 2 or lower leave its bearer alone unless the bearer harms them.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Rejuvenation. At 0 HP, Acererak crumbles and leaves his equipment behind. After 1d10 days he re-forms at full HP within 5 feet of his hidden phylactery.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Paralyzing Touch. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must pass a DC 20 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect for itself on a success.
Staff (+3 Quarterstaff). Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage one-handed or 8 (1d8 + 4) with two hands. Both grips deal another 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
Invoke Curse. Spend 1 charge from the held Staff of the Forgotten One and choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 23 Constitution save, the creature is cursed. It cannot regain HP and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. Greater Restoration, Remove Curse, or similar magic ends the curse.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Acererak prepares wizard spells as a 20th-level caster, using Intelligence (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips at will. Mage Hand, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level at will. Ray of Sickness, Shield.
2nd level at will. Arcane Lock, Knock.
3rd level at will. Animate Dead, Counterspell.
4th level, 3 slots. Blight, Ice Storm, Phantasmal Killer.
5th level, 3 slots. Cloudkill, Hold Monster, Wall of Force.
6th level, 3 slots. Chain Lightning, Circle of Death, Disintegrate.
7th level, 3 slots. Finger of Death, Plane Shift, Teleport.
8th level, 2 slots. Maze, Mind Blank.
9th level, 2 slots. Power Word Kill, Time Stop.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Acererak has 3 legendary actions. He can choose one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains expended uses at the start of his turn.
At-Will Spell (1 action). Cast one of the spells listed as at will.
Melee Attack (1 action). Use Paralyzing Touch or make a staff attack.
Frightening Gaze (2 actions). Choose one creature Acererak can see within 10 ft. A failed DC 20 Wisdom save against this magic makes it frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once the creature succeeds or the fear ends, this gaze cannot affect it for 24 hours.
Talisman of the Sphere (2 actions). Move Acererak’s Sphere of Annihilation up to 90 ft.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save against this magic, taking 42 (12d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Tomb encounter
lines:
Area 77, the Death God’s Nursery (p. 186). Acererak arrives when the party kills the Atropal. He has no lair actions in this encounter. If reduced below 100 HP, he tries to escape with Teleport on his next turn.
Wrath of the Trickster Gods. While a character hosting a trickster god can see Acererak, they gain 50 temporary HP at the start of each of their turns and deal an extra 3d6 psychic damage whenever they hit him with an attack roll.

Advanced Tracking (once per long rest). When a creature fails its Force Bolts save, it may mark the creature for 24 hours. On the same plane, the adranach knows the direction to the creature and which way it is moving.
Arcane Bond. Its creator can speak with it telepathically within 1 mile. The creator may spend an action to use the adranach’s hearing and sight, including its special senses, until the creator’s next turn starts. The creator is Blinded and Deafened to their own surroundings during that time.
Slipstream. It can cast Invisibility on itself at will. Double its speed while Invisible.
Master only · Astral Form (once per long rest). Cast Astral Projection on itself.
Master only · Truesight. It has Truesight to 30 ft. It can spend an action to extend that range to 120 ft. through the end of its next turn.
