gm.title: Description
lines: Traces of the greatwyrm’s many lives across the Material Plane come together in a body that gleams like cut crystal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Gem Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). When the greatwyrm would drop to 0 hit points, it instead resets to 400 hit points, recharges Breath Weapon and recovers all spent Legendary Resistance uses. It can use Mass Telekinesis for the next hour. Defeating it after Gem Awakening grants an extra 90,000 XP, or 180,000 XP total.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). The greatwyrm can turn a failed save into a success.
Unusual Nature. The greatwyrm needs no food or drink.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d8 + 9) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 19) and restrained until the grapple ends. The greatwyrm can grapple only one creature this way at a time.
Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. A failure deals 71 (11d12) force damage and knocks the creature prone. A success halves the damage. The creature’s speed is 0 until the end of its next turn on either result.
Mass Telekinesis (Gem Awakening Only, Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Choose any number of visible creatures or objects within 120 ft., each weighing at most 4,000 lb. Worn or carried objects are ineligible. Each chosen creature must pass a DC 26 Strength save or be restrained in the greatwyrm’s grip. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, escaping on a success. At the end of each of the greatwyrm’s turns, it can move each target still in its grip up to 60 ft. in any direction, within 120 ft. of itself. It can also deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each restrained creature it chooses.
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 26, +18 to hit) and requiring no components. Dispel Magic, Forcecage, Plane Shift, Reverse Gravity and Time Stop are each usable once per day.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Change Shape. Magically take the shape of a Small or Medium creature. Only size changes. The transformation ends when the greatwyrm drops to 0 hit points or spends a bonus action to end it.
Psychic Step. Magically teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The greatwyrm has three legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.
Psychic Beam (3 actions). Each creature in a 90-ft. line 10 ft. wide makes a DC 26 Intelligence save, taking 27 (5d10) psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: A keen-sighted dreg whose shriek can frighten creatures nearby.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Immune to psychic damage and the Frightened condition. Truesight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.

gm.title: Base stat block
lines: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Cyclopean mutation.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Spectral Vision. The dreg gains truesight out to 60 ft. and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Mad Certainty. The dreg is immune to psychic damage and the Frightened condition.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Psychic Shriek (Recharge 6). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is Frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

gm.title: Haze-native creatures
lines:
Printed source. Appendix A, pp. 196–197. These traits leave the creature’s CR as printed. They apply to Haze natives and exclude creatures recruited or summoned by the party.
Fully Contaminated. Immune to contamination and has advantage on saves against contaminated spells.
Haze Adaptation. Can benefit from a long rest in the Haze. It can see twice as far through the Haze and Deep Haze.
Haze Dependence. Gains one Exhaustion level for each 24 hours outside the Haze. It can remove those levels only in the Haze.
Delerium Healing. As an action, touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) HP. That shard cannot heal this way again for 24 hours.

lines: Natural armor. Saves Dex +3, Wis +7. Vulnerable to fire. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Flanked, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 120 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 13. Understands Druidic and Sylvan and cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dancing Flowers. The Dancing Lady has three flowers that look like life-sized dancers. Track each separately at AC 16 and 5 HP, with fire vulnerability, psychic immunity, and disadvantage on attacks against it. Destroying a flower leaves the Dancing Lady’s HP intact. Destroyed flowers regrow at the end of the Dancing Lady’s turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning.
Blood-Red Waltz. For each remaining flower, choose up to one visible creature within 60 ft. of the Dancing Lady. Each target makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the Dancing Lady moves it to an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of itself. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place.
Disarming Quickstep. For each remaining flower, choose up to one visible creature within 60 ft. of the Dancing Lady. Each target makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage and is Dazed until the start of the Dancing Lady’s next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids Dazed.
Ballet of Terror (1/day). Each enemy within 120 ft. that can smell the flowers’ mist makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the Dancing Lady for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Somber Dirge. When a visible attacker hits the Dancing Lady, redirect the hit to one of its flowers.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed on its own turn, that turn ends. Extra actions such as those from Haste or Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

gm.title: Description
lines: This death giant inscribes its magic on a fallen giant’s skull. With the skull in hand, it can give its staff a spectral blade or wrap itself in a shroud of souls.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Death Rune. The giant can use Reaping Scythe and Shroud of Souls while holding or wearing the skull marked with this rune. The skull has AC 18, 35 HP, and immunity to necrotic, poison and psychic damage. It returns to full HP at the end of every turn. It crumbles to dust if it reaches 0 HP or the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can mark another skull it possesses when it finishes a short or long rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Soul Burst attacks. If the giant has its death rune, it can make three Reaping Scythe attacks instead.
Soul Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) necrotic damage. If the target is frightened, the giant gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
Reaping Scythe (Requires Death Rune). Melee spell attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 38 (7d10) necrotic damage. The creature cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn and dies if this attack reduces it to 0 HP.
Spellcasting. The giant casts one spell from this list using Intelligence. At will, Detect Magic and Mage Armor. Three times per day each, Speak with Dead and Tenser’s Floating Disk. Mage Armor raises AC to 15.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Frightening Teleport (Recharge 4–6). Magically teleport the giant and its worn or carried equipment up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space the giant left must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom save or become frightened until the end of that creature’s next turn.
Shroud of Souls (Requires Death Rune). The giant surrounds itself with a torrent of souls. A creature starting its turn within 5 ft. of the shrouded giant must pass a DC 19 Wisdom save or have disadvantage on saving throws until the end of its next turn. The shroud ends after 1 minute or sooner if the giant dies, uses Shroud of Souls again, or loses its death rune to destruction.

lines:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The slaad’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Control Gem. The slaad has a magical gem in its brain. It must obey the creature that possesses the gem and is immune to being Charmed for as long as the gem controls it. Destroying the gem ends this means of control.
Spell extraction. If the slaad fails a save against Imprisonment, the caster can have the spell move the gem to their open hand instead of imprisoning the slaad. Wish can retrieve the gem if cast in the slaad's presence with that wording. Greater Restoration cast on the slaad destroys the gem without injuring it.
Surgical extraction. A creature proficient in Wisdom (Medicine) can remove the gem while the slaad is Incapacitated. Each attempt takes 1 minute of uninterrupted work and a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. A failure deals 22 (4d10) psychic damage to the slaad.

gm.title: Slaad Control Gem
lines: A slaad created by a Spawning Stone has a control gem. A slaad that was born another way develops one on contact with the stone. Whoever holds the extracted gem can command the slaad, which is immune to being Charmed while under that control.

Wish can recover a gem, Imprisonment can transfer it on a failed save, and Greater Restoration destroys it harmlessly. A trained healer can spend 1 minute attempting extraction from an Incapacitated slaad with a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. On failure the slaad takes 4d10 psychic damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: This undead beholder surrounds its floating skull with spectral eyes and uses its former victims as guards.

gm.title: Defenses and senses
lines: Natural armor. Perception +12, passive Perception 22. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Deep Speech and Undercommon.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
Negative Energy Cone. At the start of its turn, choose whether its central eye projects an invisible magical 150-ft. cone and which direction it faces. Creatures in the cone cannot regain HP. A humanoid that dies there keeps its initiative and rises at the start of its next turn as a Zombie under the tyrant’s command if its body has not been entirely destroyed.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Roll three distinct d10 results, rerolling duplicates. Shoot the matching rays at one to three targets it can see within 120 ft.

gm.title: Eye rays
lines:
1. Charm Ray. Wisdom DC 17 or Charmed by the eye tyrant for 1 hour. If it harms the target, the charm ends.
2. Paralyzing Ray. Constitution DC 17 or Paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the condition on a success.
3. Fear Ray. Wisdom DC 17 or Frightened for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the condition on a success.
4. Slowing Ray. Dexterity DC 17 or speed is halved for 1 minute. While slowed, the target cannot take reactions and can take only one of an action and a bonus action on its turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
5. Enervation Ray. Constitution DC 17. Failure deals 36 (8d8) necrotic damage. Success halves it.
6. Telekinetic Ray. A creature makes a DC 17 Strength save. On failure, move it up to 30 ft. in any direction. It is Restrained until the start of the eye tyrant’s next turn or until the eye tyrant becomes Incapacitated. An object weighing 300 lb. or less, neither worn nor carried, can move up to 30 ft. in any direction without a save. The ray can also work a simple tool or open a door or container.
7. Sleep Ray. Wisdom DC 17 or Unconscious for 1 minute. Damage or another creature spending an action to wake the target ends the sleep. Constructs and Undead are unaffected.
8. Petrification Ray. Dexterity DC 17 or Restrained and beginning to turn to stone. Repeat the save at the end of the target’s next turn. Success ends the effect. Failure leaves the target Petrified until Greater Restoration or other magic frees it.
9. Disintegration Ray. A creature makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or takes 45 (10d8) force damage. If that damage leaves it at 0 HP, its body turns to fine gray dust. A Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force is destroyed without a save. For a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, destroy one 10-ft. cube of it.
10. Death Ray. Dexterity DC 17 or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. If this leaves the target at 0 HP, it dies.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three legendary actions. Spend one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Eye Ray (1 action). Use one randomly rolled eye ray.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
In its lair, the death tyrant is CR 15 (13,000 XP). Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. No lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the first turn if surprised.
Spectral Obstruction. Choose a 50-ft. cube within 120 ft. Spectral eyes and tentacles make it Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain for creatures other than the tyrant until initiative count 20 next round.
Spectral Grasp. Walls sprout spectral limbs until initiative count 20 on the round after next. A hostile creature, even on the Ethereal Plane, that starts its turn within 10 ft. of a wall makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or becomes Grappled. Escape with a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Spectral Eye. An eye appears in the air at a point within 50 ft. and fires one random eye ray at a target the tyrant chooses. The ray comes from an ethereal source. The eye then disappears.
Use all three effects before repeating one, and never repeat on consecutive rounds.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Creatures within 1 mile of the lair sometimes feel watched. Whenever a creature that knows about the tyrant and is hostile to it finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile, roll a d20 for that creature. On a 10 or lower it is subjected to one random eye ray.
After the tyrant dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: In Charm Ray, the book says “beholder” once in the death tyrant’s rules. Treat that reference as the death tyrant.

gm.title: Description
lines: A beholder can pursue its designs after death as an immense floating skull orbited by ten magical eyes.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/day, 4/day in its lair). It can turn a failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Eye Rays three times.
Bite. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose a visible target within 120 ft. and roll 1d10 for its magical ray. Reroll a ray the death tyrant has already used during this turn. All saves below are DC 17.
1. Charm Ray. Wisdom save. Failure deals 13 (3d8) psychic damage and leaves the target Charmed for 1 hour or until it takes damage. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
2. Paralyzing Ray. Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Paralyzed. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on success. It automatically succeeds after 1 minute.
3. Fear Ray. Wisdom save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage and leaves the target Frightened until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
4. Slowing Ray. Constitution save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target has half Speed, cannot take Reactions, and has to choose between taking an action and taking a Bonus Action on its turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the other effects.
5. Enervation Ray. Constitution save. Failure deals 16 (3d10) poison damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned this way, it cannot regain HP. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
6. Telekinetic Ray. Strength save. A Gargantuan target succeeds automatically. On failure the death tyrant moves the target up to 30 ft. in any direction and Restrains it until the start of the death tyrant’s next turn or until the death tyrant is Incapacitated. This ray can also manipulate objects precisely, for example to open a door or operate a tool.
7. Sleep Ray. Wisdom save. Constructs and Undead succeed automatically. On failure the target is Unconscious for 1 minute. Damage ends the effect. A creature within 5 ft. can also use an action to wake the target.
8. Petrification Ray. Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. Failure changes Restrained to Petrified.
9. Disintegration Ray. Dexterity save. Failure deals 36 (8d8) force damage and disintegrates a 10-ft. cube of a targeted nonmagical object or magical force creation. Success halves the damage. Either way, a creature reduced to 0 HP by the ray turns to dust.
10. Death Ray. Dexterity save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and success halves it. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the ray dies.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Negative Energy Cone. An imperceptible magical wave from its central eye covers a 150-ft. Cone. Creatures in the cone cannot regain HP until its next turn starts. Any intact Humanoid corpse in the cone immediately rises as its controlled Zombie and acts right after it on the same initiative count.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses (4 in its lair). Spend one use immediately after another creature’s turn. Recover all uses at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Chomp. Make two Bite attacks.
Glare. Use Eye Rays.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Negative Energy Suffusion. Whenever a spell restores a creature’s HP within 1 mile of the lair, subtract 1d10 from the amount healed.
Scopophobia. Creatures within 1 mile feel watched. A creature other than the death tyrant or its allies that finishes a Short Rest within that area makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure the rest grants no benefit.
Both effects end immediately if the death tyrant dies or its lair moves.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A levitating skull guards the tomb where a lich’s remaining power and phylactery lie.

gm.title: Defenses and senses
lines: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from magic weapons. Immune to necrotic, poison and psychic damage and to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks (per the 2014 edition errata). Immune to Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 13. No languages listed.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Avoidance. If a saving throw would normally halve damage on a success, the demilich takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Turn Immunity. Immune to effects that turn Undead.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep. Its HP use the maximum result of its Hit Dice.
Enduring Existence. An intact phylactery restores the destroyed skull in 1d10 days. A demilich that still has the will to feed a soul to its phylactery can return to lich form by doing so.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Howl (Recharge 5–6). Every creature within 30 ft. that can hear the howl makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure drops it to 0 HP. Success leaves it Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Life Drain. Choose up to three visible creatures within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 19 Constitution save or takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The demilich heals HP equal to the total damage dealt.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three legendary actions. Spend one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Flight (1 action). Fly up to half its flying speed.
Cloud of Dust (1 action). Each creature within 10 ft., even around a corner, makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of the demilich’s next turn. On a success that creature is immune to this effect until the end of the demilich’s next turn.
Energy Drain (2 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce maximum HP by 10 (3d6). A target dies if its maximum falls to 0. Greater Restoration or similar magic can restore the lost maximum.
Vile Curse (3 actions). One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure it is magically cursed and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saves. It repeats the save at the end of each turn and ends the curse on success.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
In its lair, the demilich is CR 20 (24,500 XP). Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. No lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the first turn if surprised. Roll a d20. On 11 or higher, choose an effect. Never repeat the same effect on consecutive rounds.
Tremor. Each creature on the tomb floor makes a DC 19 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
Antimagic. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Antimagic Field fills its space and moves with it until initiative count 20 next round.
Seal Healing. Choose any number of visible creatures within 30 ft. They cannot regain HP until initiative count 20 next round.

gm.title: Lair traits
lines:
Use any of these optional tomb traits. A non-evil creature takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage the first time it enters. Monsters in the tomb have advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened and turning. A ward prevents unauthorized creatures from using teleportation or planar travel to enter or leave, but allows such movement entirely within the tomb.
After the demilich is destroyed, these effects fade over 10 days.

gm.title: Variant. Acererak and his disciples
lines:
Use the base stat block and add Trap Soul. CR 21 (33,000 XP), or CR 23 (50,000 XP) in the lair.
Trap Soul. Choose one creature the demilich can see within 30 ft. DC 19 Charisma save. Failure traps its soul in a gem, causing its body and gear to cease to exist. On a success it takes 24 (7d6) necrotic damage, and if that leaves it at 0 HP, trap its soul as on failure. After 24 hours in a gem, the soul is devoured and ceases to exist. At 0 HP this demilich is destroyed, leaving the gems behind. Crush a gem to free the soul still inside. Its body re-forms in the nearest unoccupied space, in the state it was in when trapped.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Howl, recharge 5–6: hearers within 30 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save or fall to 0 HP. A success still frightens them through the end of their next turn.
Life Drain: up to three creatures it can see within 10 feet make DC 19 Constitution saves or take 6d6 necrotic each. The demilich heals for the damage dealt.
It can force three failed saves to succeed daily. Against effects that deal half on a save, it takes none on success and half on failure. It has separate legendary and lair options.
The lair introduction mentions extra uses for legendary actions, but this printing does not specify a different action budget. The stat block gives three each round.

gm.title: Description
lines: Demogorgon's two heads, Aameul and Hathradiah, scheme from Abysm in the Gaping Maw. The palace has twin towers above water and caverns below.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Demogorgon fails a save, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Demogorgon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Two Heads. Demogorgon has advantage on saves against being blinded, deafened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks. Demogorgon can replace one attack with Gaze.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) force damage. A creature hit must make a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its hit point maximum by the damage it took until it finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its maximum reaches 0.
Gaze. Choose one creature Demogorgon can see within 120 ft. Demogorgon's magical gaze forces a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, choose one result or roll 1d6.
1–2, Beguiling Gaze. The target is stunned until the start of Demogorgon's next turn or until he leaves its line of sight.
3–4, Confusing Gaze. The target is affected by Confusion until the start of Demogorgon's next turn. It makes no saving throw against the spell, and Demogorgon doesn't concentrate on it.
5–6, Hypnotic Gaze. The target is charmed by Demogorgon until the start of his next turn. He chooses how it uses its action, reaction, and movement.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic, Major Image.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Project Image.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Demogorgon has 2 legendary actions. Immediately after another creature's turn, spend the stated cost to use one option. He regains spent uses at the start of his turn. He cannot spend any while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Gaze (1 action). Use Gaze and choose Beguiling Gaze or Confusing Gaze.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
In his lair, Demogorgon can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. He cannot select the same option on consecutive rounds. He must be able to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Darkness. Cast Darkness four times in different areas, with no concentration needed. Each ends on initiative count 20 of the next round.
Illusory Duplicate. A double appears in Demogorgon's space and lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. On his turn, Demogorgon can move it a distance equal to his walking speed without spending an action. On the first physical interaction with Demogorgon by a creature or object, roll a 50 percent chance that the double takes the effect instead. If it does, it disappears.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects for the area around Abysm.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.
Frenzied Animals. Beasts within 1 mile become violent, including usually docile animals. Checks involving Animal Handling in that area have disadvantage.
Venomous Beasts. Poisonous snakes and other venomous Beasts proliferate within 6 miles.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Demogorgon dies.

lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 90.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Prince of Demons is a two-headed lord of the Abyss. The rival heads Aameul and Hathradiah share an apelike torso, a reptilian lower body and tentacles.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Demogorgon uses Charisma (save DC 23) and needs no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Major Image.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Project Image.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Demogorgon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Demogorgon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Demogorgon’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Two Heads. Demogorgon has advantage on saving throws to avoid being blinded, deafened, stunned or knocked unconscious.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its hit point maximum by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. It dies if this drops its maximum to 0.
Gaze. Choose one creature Demogorgon can see within 120 ft. It makes a DC 23 Wisdom save against his magical gaze. A target that is not incapacitated can avert its eyes and pass the save automatically. It then cannot see Demogorgon until the start of his next turn. If it looks at him before then, it must immediately make the save. On a failed save, Demogorgon chooses one of the three effects or determines it at random.
Beguiling Gaze. The target is stunned until the start of Demogorgon’s next turn or until he is out of its line of sight.
Hypnotic Gaze. The target is charmed until the start of Demogorgon’s next turn. He chooses how it spends its actions, reactions and movement. Both heads are occupied, so Demogorgon cannot use Maddening Gaze until the start of his next turn.
Insanity Gaze. Apply Confusion without an extra save or concentration until the start of Demogorgon’s next turn.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Demogorgon has two legendary actions and regains spent uses at the start of his turn. He can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Each option costs one use.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Maddening Gaze. Use Gaze with either the Beguiling or Insanity effect.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, Demogorgon may use either option. He cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Illusory duplicate. An illusion of Demogorgon appears in his space and lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. On his turn, he can move the duplicate up to his walking speed without using an action. The first time a creature or object physically interacts with him, there is a 50% chance it affects the duplicate. The duplicate vanishes if affected.
Darkness. Cast Darkness at its lowest level in four different areas without concentration. All four effects end on initiative count 20 of the next round.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The following effects can occur around Abysm, his palace in the Gaping Maw.
Venomous beasts. Lizards, venomous snakes and other venomous beasts overpopulate the area within 6 miles.
Violent beasts. Within 1 mile, beasts grow violent even if normally docile.
Madness. After at least an hour within 1 mile, a Humanoid makes a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on Madness of Demogorgon. A success makes the creature immune to this regional effect for 24 hours.
The effects fade over 1d10 days if Demogorgon dies.

gm.title: Madness of Demogorgon
lines:
When a creature goes mad in Demogorgon’s lair or within sight of him, roll d100. The flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature believes someone plans to kill it and must be attacked first.
21–40. The creature believes killing everyone involved will solve its problems.
41–60. The creature believes it shares its head with another mind.
61–80. The creature tries to force anyone who disagrees to submit through violence.
81–00. The creature fears theft and refuses to let others touch its belongings.

lines: A fiendish spider that can pull prey into its web and spray venom when badly wounded.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Dexterity saves +7. Perception +3, Stealth +7. Resists cold, fire and lightning. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13. No languages.

lines:

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Stinger attack, or use Web Spinner and then make one melee attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7 within 5 ft. Hit for 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing. The target then makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On failure it takes 27 (6d8) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. Success halves the poison damage and avoids the condition. If the poison damage drops it to 0 HP, it stabilizes and is Poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains HP. It is Paralyzed while that longer poison lasts.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack +7 within 5 ft. Hit for 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing. The target must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be Paralyzed for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition on a success.
Web Spinner. Ranged weapon attack +7 with a 40-ft. range. On a hit, pull the target 40 ft. toward the spider and Grapple it (escape DC 14). Only one creature at a time can be held by Web Spinner. The spider can spend an action to cocoon that creature. The cocoon leaves it Restrained and ends the grapple.

gm.title: Reactions

9. Puts a hand on anyone they talk to.
10. Sees spirits rise from the newly dead.
11. Passes out at their first exposure to bright light.
12. Licks their palms repeatedly.

15. Tastes whatever they pick up.
16. Crowds people when they speak.
17. Breathes noisily.
18. Drools all the time.
19. Speaks under their breath.
20. Gets around by hopping.

gm.title: Description
lines: Senmet’s undead servants swim beneath the sands of Har’Akir, leaving shallow furrows when they travel near the surface.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC 15, touch 10, flat-footed 15. The listed armor component is +3 natural. Base attack +1, grapple +2. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +1, Will +3. Swim (sand) +5. Improved Natural Armor.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +2 melee for 1d8 + 1 damage. The prose gives the same damage for weapons or other attacks.
Grab from Beneath (Ex). From under the sand, make an attack against AC that includes the victim’s Dexterity bonus but excludes natural armor and worn armor. A hit grabs the victim. The victim can break free with an opposed Strength check. After 3 rounds of being pulled down, the victim is completely buried. They survive the first round underground and die at the end of the second unless freed.
Spell Use. A zombie that cast spells in life still casts them, using the sorcerer class regardless of its previous casting class.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft., damage reduction 5/slashing, undead traits. Sandswim (Ex) lets it travel beneath the sand to set up a grab. The print supplies no separate sand movement speed. It understands simple commands and rarely speaks.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Deserts of Har’Akir, commonly in packs of 6–10. Usually neutral evil. No treasure. The prose says it retains its former skills and abilities. The printed stat block presents an ordinary specimen.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Preserve the listed AC and saves where the components and ability scores disagree. The grab gives a custom defense and escape check but prints no separate attack bonus. Use the printed slam bonus for the initial grab as a table default.

lines: An agile horned devil in fitted studded leather and court robes, wielding an obsidian kris and an infernal knife.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Saves Dex +10, Wis +7, Cha +8. Acrobatics +10, Deception +8, Insight +7, Persuasion +8, Stealth +10. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Fire damage immunity. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13. Common and Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines: True Name. If the devil hears a creature within 60 ft. say its true name aloud, it loses its damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Infernal Knife attacks and one Obsidian Kris attack.
Infernal Knife. Melee or ranged weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. The target becomes Frightened of its own allies until the end of the target’s next turn.
Obsidian Kris. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is Frightened, it cannot take reactions until that condition ends.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Devilish Charm (2/day). When a visible creature within 60 ft. targets the devil with an attack, spell, power or other supernatural effect, that creature makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, the creature is Charmed by the devil until the start of that creature’s next turn, and the devil redirects the effect to a new target it can see within the effect’s range.

Lazivos calls a magistrate and eight notaries to his side as soon as the fight starts in his office.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A wiry horned devil clerk in a blue-gray coat carrying an open ledger and quill.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Chain shirt. Fire damage immunity. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12. Common and Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Importunity. At the start of its turn, the notary can bless a visible non-minion ally within 60 ft. without spending an action. The ally can add +1 to its next attack roll or saving throw before the start of the notary’s next turn. Blessings from multiple notaries stack to a maximum bonus of +5.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the notary to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if it deals at least 13 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from those other effects.
True Name. If the notary hears someone within 60 ft. speak its true name, it loses its damage immunity and Importunity for 24 hours.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Brimstone (Group Attack). Melee or ranged spell attack +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 4 fire damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five notaries on the same turn can each spend an action to attack a target in reach or range of every participant. Make one roll at +6 plus the number joining. A hit deals 4 fire damage per participant. A solo notary attacks at +6. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. When cover or concealment differs, roll separately for each group. The target chooses which participant is affected by a response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If a target provokes from multiple notaries at once, each can spend its reaction to join the melee Brimstone attack. Notaries have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 13 damage leaves surplus that can drop an eligible additional notary to 0 HP for each 13 points of surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, each must be within reach of the weapon. At range, each must lie on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. This rule excludes opportunity attacks.

name: Devil, Arch-Devil, Abizeth, Servitor of Abizeth

gm.title: Description
lines: An infernal salvage worker with a body full of gears. Gear devils strip metal for prison and factory machinery and prize magical alloys.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 14. Stealth 11. Vulnerable to acid damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Infernal.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +3 · INT +0 · WIS +2 · CHA +2

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impair its darkvision.
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make four Claw attacks. The devil can trade two of those attacks for one Tail Stab.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Tail Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. A Prone creature hit this way becomes Restrained. The restraint ends if the devil dies, makes another Tail Stab, uses Tail Whip, or moves more than 15 ft. away. Any creature, including the target, can spend an action and pass a DC 13 Strength check to free the target.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Tail Whip. One creature the devil can see within 15 ft. falls Prone on a failed DC 13 Strength save.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Gear Screech. When a creature the devil can see within 15 ft. attacks it, the devil can make its gears screech. The attacker rolls with disadvantage if it can hear the screech.

gm.title: Description
lines: A failed bid for promotion leaves this devil with a green lantern fused into its chest. Lantern devils lead lesser fiends through caverns and on night raids.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Perception 12. Stealth 15. Resists Blinded. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common and Infernal.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +0 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT −1 · WIS +2 · CHA +3

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Chest Lantern. Its magic lantern stays lit while the devil lives and crumbles to dust when it dies. It sheds bright light out to a radius of 5 to 30 ft. and dim light for the same distance beyond that.
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impair its darkvision.
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Onyx Club or Lantern Bolt attacks. If two Lantern Bolts hit the same creature, it makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Onyx Club. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 2 (1d4) piercing damage. A creature marked by the devil loses 20 ft. of speed until the end of its next turn.
Lantern Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) fire damage and 4 (1d8) radiant damage. For 1 minute after taking this damage, the target gains no benefit from being Invisible.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Adjust Lantern. Choose a new radius for the Chest Lantern.
Stoke the Heart (Recharge 5–6). Gain 5 (2d4) temporary HP. This automatically recharges if the devil starts its turn with 17 HP or fewer.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged infernal scout that tracks fugitives and finds hidden portals. Maze imps prefer to escape a fight and return with reinforcements.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Perception 14. Stealth 15. Truesight 60 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common and Infernal.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR −2 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT +1 · WIS +4 · CHA +2

Labyrinth Tracker. At the end of a long rest, the imp can name a creature it knows or has seen as its quarry. While both are in the Labyrinth, the imp knows the direction and distance to the quarry. If the quarry leaves through a portal, the imp knows the direction and distance to that portal.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and one Sting attack.

Sting. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Invisibility. The imp and its worn or carried gear magically turn Invisible. This ends when the imp attacks or loses concentration, as if concentrating on a spell.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Escape to Report. Take the Dash or Disengage action.

gm.title: Reactions

gm.title: Description
lines: A goat-headed devil that thrives in mortal courts. Risolans broker trade and alliances for the Hells and resort to mental magic when diplomacy fails.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Perception 17. Stealth 14. Resists psychic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common, Druidic (Elder Speech), and Infernal. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +1 · DEX +4 · CON +4 · INT +2 · WIS +7 · CHA +8

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impair its darkvision.
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Infernal Diplomacy. Before targeting the risolan with an attack or harmful spell, a creature must pass a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, it must pick another target or lose the attack or spell. When the risolan attacks or casts a spell that affects a creature, that creature and its allies ignore this trait for the next 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Silver Tongue. Has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Wisdom (Insight) checks.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Scepter or Psychic Bolt attacks. The risolan can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage.
Mind Snare (Recharge 5–6). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. A failure deals 27 (6d8) psychic damage and inflicts an infernal wound until the start of the risolan’s next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the wound. A creature with the wound subtracts a separate 1d6 from each attack roll, ability check, and save.
Spellcasting. Charisma, spell save DC 16. Three times per day each: detect thoughts, hold, suggestion. Once per day each: confusion, greater invisibility.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Change Shape. Magically take the shape of a Medium or smaller Humanoid or return to its true Fiend form. Its statistics stay the same apart from size. Its worn and carried gear changes with it. It reverts on death.

gm.title: Description
lines: A Golgari elf that has prolonged its life through undeath. Fungi help hold its decaying body together.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
Regeneration. The lich recovers 10 HP at the start of its turn. Fire or radiant damage disables the next start-of-turn recovery. The lich dies only when it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Turn Resistance. The lich makes saves against effects that turn undead with advantage.
Undead Fortitude. If damage drops the lich to 0 HP, roll a Constitution save with DC 5 plus the damage taken. Skip this save for radiant damage or damage from a critical hit. On a success, the lich drops to 1 HP.
Undead Nature. The lich needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The lich is a 14th-level Golgari spellcaster with wizard spells prepared. It uses Intelligence (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots). Chromatic Orb, Magic Missile, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots). Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spider Climb, Web.
3rd level (3 slots). Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Fear, Vampiric Touch.
4th level (3 slots). Blight, Evard's Black Tentacles.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Insect Plague.
6th level (1 slot). Circle of Death, Create Undead.
7th level (1 slot). Finger of Death.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Noxious Touch. Melee spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (4d6) poison damage. The creature must also succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The lich has 3 legendary actions. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The lich regains spent actions when its turn begins.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast one of the lich's cantrips.
Noxious Touch (2 actions). Use Noxious Touch.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. Success halves the damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: Orcus sends devourers to trap souls and raise undead servants. Their hollow ribcages hold the dying.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unusual Nature. The devourer needs no air, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The devourer can also use one available option, Imprison Soul or Soul Rend.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
Imprison Soul. Choose a living Humanoid the devourer can see within 30 ft. that has 0 hit points. The target teleports into the devourer's ribcage and stays imprisoned there. It is restrained and has disadvantage on death saving throws while imprisoned. If it dies there, the devourer regains 25 hit points and immediately recharges Soul Rend. At the start of its next turn, the devourer uses a bonus action to spit out the dead victim as an Undead. A victim with up to 2 Hit Dice becomes a Zombie. A victim with 3–5 Hit Dice becomes a Ghoul. A victim with 6 or more Hit Dice becomes a Wight. Only one creature can be imprisoned at a time.
Soul Rend (recharge 6). Each creature in a 20-ft. radius centered on the devourer makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 93.

gm.title: References
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 93 · https://5e.tools/bestiary.html#devourer_mpmm

gm.title: Description
lines: A creation of Orcus that traps dying humanoids in its ribcage and turns those who die there into undead.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Fiendish Nature. It needs souls for food and can go without air, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The devourer can also use either Imprison Soul or Soul Rend if available.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
Imprison Soul. Pick one living Humanoid at 0 hit points that the devourer can see within 30 ft. The target teleports into the devourer's ribcage and is imprisoned there. It has disadvantage on death saving throws. Only one creature can be imprisoned at a time. If the captive dies, the devourer regains 25 hit points, immediately recharges Soul Rend, and gains an extra action on its next turn. At the start of that turn, it regurgitates the victim as a bonus action. A victim with 2 or fewer Hit Dice becomes a Zombie. A victim with 3 to 5 Hit Dice becomes a Ghoul. A victim with 6 or more Hit Dice becomes a Wight.
Soul Rend (Recharge 6). Each Humanoid within 20 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failed save, it takes 44 (8d10) necrotic damage, plus 10 damage for each living Humanoid at 0 hit points in the area. Halve the total on a successful save.

gm.title: Description
lines: The printed example is a fighter whose supernatural gifts falter in daylight and when he goes too long without humanoid blood.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium augmented monstrous humanoid, 8th-level human fighter example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +13 melee for 1d6 + 5 or +1 rapier +14 melee for 1d6 + 8. Full attack uses slam +13 or rapier +14/+3, as printed. Slam counts as magic for overcoming damage reduction.
Domination (Su). Standard action. Meet a creature's gaze within 30 ft. and force a DC 17 Will save against dominate person at caster level 12. Mere eye contact does not trigger it.
Blood Drain (Ex). While pinning a living target, drain 1d4 Constitution damage each round the grapple is maintained.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to summon 4d8 dire rats, 10d10 bats or 3d6 wolves. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to one hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 10/magic, cold and electricity resistance 10, and spider climb as the spell at CL 12. Fast healing 1 until reduced to −10 HP. Supernatural special attacks and qualities stop in natural daylight or after a week without humanoid blood.
Restless (Su). The printed fighter rises as a vampire 1d4 days after burial. Destroy the body as for a vampire to prevent it. A dhampir with fewer than 5 original Hit Dice instead rises as vampire spawn.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +8. AC from +4 Dex, +4 natural and +5 +1 chain shirt. Touch 14, flat-footed 19. BAB/grapple +8/+13, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +4.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +9, Climb +15, Hide +10, Jump +13, Listen +10, Move Silently +12, Ride +12, Swim +15, Search +8, Sense Motive +8, Spot +10. Alertness, Athletic, Combat Reflexes, Combat Expertise, Dodge, Improved Critical (rapier), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Quick Draw, Spring Attack, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (rapier), Whirlwind Attack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Solitary, any land. Dust of appearance, double standard treasure.

gm.title: Table notes

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Magic Resistance. The dhergoloth has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dire troll lashes out with several arms. Even at 0 hit points it can regenerate unless an attack delivers enough acid or fire to kill it.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the troll regains 10 hit points. After taking acid or fire damage, the troll regains 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. The troll dies only when an attack hits it while it has 0 hit points and deals at least 10 acid or fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and four Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Whirlwind of Claws (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 10 ft. of the troll makes a DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 44 (8d10) slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dire troll grows by feeding on other trolls and grafting stolen flesh onto its wounds. Its regeneration can incorporate extra eyes and arms, leaving it with more claws than its prey can fend off.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Keen Senses. The troll makes Wisdom (Perception) checks using smell or sight with advantage.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire damage, it regains 5 HP at the start of its next turn instead. It dies only if an attack deals at least 10 acid or fire damage to it while it has 0 HP.

gm.title: Actions

gm.title: Description
lines: This outsized worg unnerves prey with a supernatural howl. Dire worgs often hunt with ettins, ogres, and trolls, and can teleport with a willing ally.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Magic Resistance. The worg has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the start of the worg's next turn. The target can't regain HP while Poisoned by this bite.
Dreadful Howl (Recharge 5–6). Each creature other than a worg within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature takes 36 (8d8) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the start of the dire worg's next turn. On a success it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Warp Step. The worg and one willing creature of its choice within 5 ft. of it teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the worg can see.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., climb 40 ft.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +12, Con +11, Cha +6. Athletics +12, Perception +7. Immune to cold, fire, and poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Anguish Unleashed. When the mournling dies, each creature within 30 ft. that can hear it makes a DC 19 Wisdom save, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
Immutable Form. Spells, powers, and other effects cannot change the mournling's form.
Puddle of Mud. When the mournling leaves a space, the ground there is difficult terrain for its enemies for 10 minutes.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Slam and Mudslide. The mournling can also use Dust Storm if available.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and Grappled, escape DC 20. The target is Restrained while Grappled this way.
Mudslide. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit by it is pulled up to 30 ft. toward the mournling, as is each Huge or smaller creature the mournling chooses within 5 ft. of that target.
Dust Storm (1/day). Each creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Constitution save or becomes Blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Break and Reform. Teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft.

lines: Stuck Fast. When a melee weapon attack hits the mournling, it can trap the striking weapon in mud and disarm the attacker. lines: A dreg that is hard to strike and can attack as it teleports.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.

gm.title: Base stat block
lines: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Displaced mutation.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Displacement. Attacks against the dreg have disadvantage. A hit suppresses this trait until the end of its next turn. The trait also stops while the dreg is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Teleport (Recharge 4–6). The dreg and its worn or carried equipment teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It can make one melee attack before or after teleporting. A hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

gm.title: Haze-native creatures
lines:
Printed source. Appendix A, pp. 196–197. These traits leave the creature’s CR as printed. They apply to Haze natives and exclude creatures recruited or summoned by the party.
Fully Contaminated. Immune to contamination and has advantage on saves against contaminated spells.
Haze Adaptation. Can benefit from a long rest in the Haze. It can see twice as far through the Haze and Deep Haze.
Haze Dependence. Gains one Exhaustion level for each 24 hours outside the Haze. It can remove those levels only in the Haze.
Delerium Healing. As an action, touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) HP. That shard cannot heal this way again for 24 hours.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Elemental Demise. If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying. Innate Spellcasting. The djinni’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, thunderwave 3/day each: create food and water (can create wine instead of water), tongues, wind walk 1/day each: conjure elemental (air elemental only), creation, gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The djinni makes three scimitar attacks. Scimitar. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning or thunder damage (djinni’s choice). Create Whirlwind. A 5-foot-radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder of swirling air magically forms on a point the djinni can see within 120 feet of it. The whirlwind lasts as long as the djinni maintains concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). Any creature but the djinni that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained by it. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 60 feet as an action, and creatures restrained by the whirlwind move with it. The whirlwind ends if the djinni loses sight of it. A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the whirlwind, including itself, by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. If the check succeeds, the creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the whirlwind.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Immunities Lightning, Thunder Senses Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 13 Languages Primordial (Auran)

gm.title: Traits
lines: Elemental Restoration. If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air. Magic Resistance. The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Wishes. The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell’s stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can’t do so again for 365 days.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination. Storm Blade. Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 feet. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage. Storm Bolt. Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 feet. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Create Whirlwind. The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni’s Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature’s space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Ivory Throne’s mercenary commander calls in reinforcements and drives his troops into grappling range.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Chain shirt. Saves Str +6, Con +7, Wis +5. Skills Athletics +6, Deception +6, Insight +5, Intimidation +6, Perception +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common and Orc.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Adrenaline Rush. After failing a save, Raskovar can succeed by spending one use of Dohma Rally without receiving its benefits. This takes no action.
Relentless (1/turn). If Raskovar would fall to 0 HP without dying outright and is not Incapacitated, he can attack an enemy before the loss of HP resolves, without an action. If the attack hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, Raskovar drops to 1 HP instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Repeating Crossbow attacks or two War Mace attacks.
War Mace. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and Daze the target until the end of its next turn.
Repeating Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d12 + 1) piercing damage and reduce the target's speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Reinforcements (1/day). Take the Dodge action. Ten Orc Blitzers appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. of Raskovar.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Dohma Rally (3/day). Regain 20 HP and gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of Raskovar's next turn.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: On the House. After a visible creature within 30 ft. fails a check or misses with an attack roll, that creature can reroll and choose either result.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each villain action is available once per encounter. Use one at most per round, in any order, immediately after an enemy's turn.
1. Close In. Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Raskovar can move up to its speed. Afterward, each enemy within 5 ft. of at least one ally who moved makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the enemy is Frightened of Raskovar for 1 minute, with an end-of-turn save.
2. Lockdown. Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Raskovar can attempt a Strength (Athletics) check with advantage to grapple an enemy it can reach, without an action. Raskovar can then move up to his speed.
3. Do It Myself. Move up to Raskovar's speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then make up to five War Mace attacks with advantage.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC +2 size, +4 Dex, +2 natural. Touch AC 16, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +5. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +2.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee for 1d6 − 2 and Biting Laughter.
Biting Laughter (Su). A bite hit calls for a DC 13 Will save. On failure, the victim falls prone and cannot act as with Tasha's hideous laughter. The laughter lasts until dispelled at DC 17 or until the victim dies. It deals one negative level per round. After the effect is dispelled, remove one negative level per round.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Damage reduction 10/magic.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, with named exceptions. Fire effects deal half damage on a failed save and none on a successful save. Warp wood slows it as the slow spell. Mending restores full HP. A targeted dispel magic at DC 15 disables it for a number of rounds equal to the caster's dispel check result minus 10. A result at least 10 above the DC destroys it. Detect magic reveals its aura returning while it is disabled.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.

gm.title: Dread golem commands
lines: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral, no treasure. Advances to 8–10 HD (Small) or 11–14 HD (Medium).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The source gives only +5 on the base attack/grapple line. A standard 3.5 grapple calculation yields −5 from base attack +5, Strength −2 and Tiny size −8. Initiative is printed as +2 despite Dexterity 19.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any terrain and activity cycle. Very rare. Solitary, appearing alone. No diet or treasure. Neutral, or matches the bearer. Intelligence Genius (17–18). Size Medium, 5 ft. long. Morale Fearless (19–20). Magic resistance 15%.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Ram. In natural form, make one attack for 2d4 damage.
Humanoid weapons. Use any weapon available to a wizard at the listed THAC0.
Spellcasting. Cast as an 8th-level wizard in either active form. In natural form, dolphin speech and flipper gestures supply verbal and somatic components, but spells with material components are unavailable. The humanoid form can carry materials and often has two minor magic items. The bearer can supply a spellbook, which the servant absorbs on returning to natural form.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Saving throws. Use the saves of an 8th-level wizard.
Air movement. A magical field supports the natural form a few feet above the ground, where it moves as if swimming.
Speech. The humanoid form can still communicate with dolphins.

gm.title: Bearer benefits
lines: While in contact or personally carrying its arms, use the servant’s saving throws whenever they are better. While telepathically linked, the bearer can breathe water and cast any 1st-level spell known to the servant. The Baroness of Savaria is the known bearer.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printing leaves the spell selection to the referee. Prepare the available spells as for an 8th-level wizard.

lines: Shapechanger. The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. gm.title: Doppelganger deceptions
lines:
Roll 1d6 or choose an agenda.
1. Sow chaos in the temple of the deity that took away its true form.
2. Hide evidence of a widespread conspiracy.
3. Pose as a local bogeyman and rule by fear.
4. Usurp a noble to live in luxury.
5. Spy on wizards for a way to finish the magic that created it.
6. Infiltrate a position of power ahead of an invasion.
