gm.title: Description
lines: A tangle of vines grows pods large enough to hold a person. Victims can return to their companions with familiar memories and an allegiance to the plant.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Warm or temperate land. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure of its own. Podlings have standard treasure. Advancement 11–14 HD (Gargantuan), 15–20 HD (Colossal).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +0. Vines AC 8 (−2 size), touch 10, flat-footed 8. Pods AC 16 (+6 natural), touch 10, flat-footed 16. Base attack and grapple are both +7. Space one 10-ft. square per HD, reach 0 ft. Fort +4, Will +4. Reflex is unlisted. Bluff +20, Diplomacy +18, Gather Information +18, Sense Motive +18. No feats.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Plant traits, DR 10/bludgeoning or slashing, electricity resistance 20 and fire resistance 20. Has no physical attacks. Each HD supplies one pod. The plant perceives and communicates through its continuous telepathic link to its podlings. The plant and all podlings share their languages and can use the highest available Int-, Wis-, and Cha-based skill bonus among them.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Mind Bondage (Su). Once per round, as a standard action, randomly select a sleeping or unconscious humanoid within 1 mile per plant HD. Will DC 14 + half the plant’s HD (DC 19 for the sample). Failure traps the soul in a vacant pod and gives the victim the podling quality. The attack is mind-affecting. Stop attempts for one day after a success. Each pod holds one soul, and no attempt is possible if all pods are occupied.
Dominate and duplicate. The combat text gives a separate on-site procedure. A humanoid entering the plant’s area must make a DC 25 Will save against its domination. On a failure the plant lures the victim into a pod that traps the soul, consumes the body at 1 HP per round, then releases a duplicate with the victim’s memories. The plant can use this domination through its clones to lure more victims.

gm.title: Podlings
lines: The plant controls a podling completely. The podling is otherwise immune to mind-affecting effects, retains its statistics and abilities except divinely granted powers, and acts as chaotic evil. Animal companions and similar bonds may detect the change. Starting 24 hours after capture, the podling loses 1d4 HP daily and cannot heal naturally. After piercing or slashing damage, it must make a Reflex save at DC 10 + damage or reveal its hollow interior. Witnesses may make a DC 15 Horror save. A podling that dies while enslaved has its life energy consumed, and only true resurrection can restore it.

gm.title: Dispersed Vines (Ex)
lines: Track HP per Hit Die. Put two HP from each HD into a shared vine and root pool and assign the rest of each die to its own pod. Area attacks deal full damage to each section in range. At 0 HP a pod deals nonlethal damage equal to its podling’s total HP + 10. At −10 HP the pod breaks, frees the soul, removes podling status, and costs the plant one HD. At 0 HP the vine pool stops pod communication and knocks out all podlings in the same way. At −10 HP the vines free every soul. The plant can also free all souls to feign destruction. Kill it by destroying the vine pool and every pod.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The combat paragraph gives DC 25 for dominating people in the patch. Mind Bondage has a separate range, target requirement, and DC formula. Both procedures are retained as printed.
For the listed 50 HP, use a 20-HP vine pool and ten 3-HP pods as a quick distribution. Per-HD rolls can vary individual pod HP.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged, many-tailed hydra made in an attempt to reproduce Tiamat’s power. Its five heads feed constantly and can pour their breath into a single cone.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Multiple Heads. The dracohydra starts with five heads. While it has more than one, it has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious. Whenever it takes 30 or more damage in one turn, one head dies. It dies if it loses all its heads. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each one that died since its last turn and regains 10 hit points per head grown. Radiant damage taken since its last turn prevents this regrowth.
Reactive Heads. For each head beyond the first, it has an extra reaction usable only for opportunity attacks.
Wakeful. At least one head stays awake while the dracohydra sleeps.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack per living head.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) damage. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison.
Prismatic Breath (Recharge 4–6). All heads exhale together in a 60-ft. cone. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 33 (6d10) damage of that type on a failure or half as much on a success.

lines: An undead dragon bound to a soul gem. If the body is destroyed, the gem can give it a new one.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Huge or Gargantuan undead, lawful evil

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a save, the creature can spend a use to succeed instead.
Life Suppression. Creatures within 60 ft. of the dracolich cannot regain HP.
Magic Resistance. The dracolich has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Gem. If the dracolich is destroyed while its gem is on the same plane, it reforms with full HP in 1d20 days within 5 ft. of the gem. The gem is a Tiny object with AC 20 and 50 HP. Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage cannot harm it. At the end of every turn it returns to full HP, but it crumbles to dust at 0 HP. If the gem is destroyed, the dracolich can make a new one with an 8-hour ritual, a gem worth at least 1,000 gp, and an additional 5,000 gp that the ritual consumes.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dracolich can replace one with Spellcasting to cast the level 2 version of Ray of Sickness.
Rend. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing damage and 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure the creature takes 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage. On a success it takes half damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 19, +11 to hit). These spells require no Material components. At will, Detect Magic and Ray of Sickness (level 2). Once per day each, Create Undead (level 8) and Finger of Death.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one use just after another creature's turn ends. All uses return at the start of the creature's turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Sickening Ray. Use Spellcasting to cast Ray of Sickness at level 2. This option is then unavailable until the start of the dracolich's next turn.
Terrifying Presence. Every creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the dracolich makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn. After using this option, the dracolich cannot use it again until its next turn starts.

gm.title: In its lair
lines: 20,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Sapping Mist. Pale fog makes the area within 1 mile of the lair Lightly Obscured. A creature that finishes a Long Rest in that area must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level. The dracolich and its allies are exempt from this save.
Soul Drain. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair make Death Saving Throws with Disadvantage.
Both effects end immediately if the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair. They resume if it gains a new body.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 80 ft.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A skeletal dragon with weathered bones, ragged wings, and traces of its former scales.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +12 (22). Saves Dex +6, Wis +8. Skills Perception +14, Stealth +6. Damage immunities: necrotic, poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 24. Languages: Common, Draconic. XP in lair 20,000.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dracolich fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.
Life Suppression. Creatures within 60 ft. of the dracolich cannot regain hit points.
Magic Resistance. The dracolich has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Gem. If destroyed while its gem is on the same plane, the dracolich reforms at full hit points in 1d20 days within 5 ft. of the gem. The gem is a Tiny object with AC 20 and 50 HP and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. It returns to full HP at the end of every turn, but turns to dust at 0 HP. Making a replacement takes an 8-hour ritual, a gem worth at least 1,000 GP, and 5,000 GP that the ritual consumes.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dracolich can replace one of them with the 2nd-level version of Ray of Sickness.
Rend. Melee attack +13, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 52 (8d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma, save DC 19 and +11 to hit with spell attacks. The spells require no material components.
At will · Detect Magic, Ray of Sickness (2nd level).
1/day each · Create Undead (8th level), Finger of Death.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The dracolich has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one immediately after another creature's turn and regains all uses at the start of its own turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make a Rend attack.
Sickening Ray. Cast the 2nd-level version of Ray of Sickness. The dracolich can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.
Terrifying Presence. Each creature in a 30-ft. emanation from the dracolich makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and becomes Frightened until the end of that creature's next turn. The dracolich can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
Sapping Mist. Pale fog Lightly Obscures the region within 1 mile of the lair. Creatures other than the dracolich and its allies who finish a Long Rest there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
Soul Drain. Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.
The effects end immediately if the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair. They resume if it gains a new body through the soul gem.

gm.title: Encounter
lines: A dracolich often occupies a corrupted version of the lair it held in life. Its soul gem allows it to return after defeat and can be hidden away from its hoard.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Huge and Gargantuan dracoliches use the same printed hit points and Hit Dice.

gm.title: Description
lines: A powerful draconian born from a magically warped dragon egg. It fights with a serrated blade and can take the shape of a slain humanoid.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Death Throes. At 0 hit points, the dreadnought burns to ash. Each creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.
Serrated Sword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shape Theft. After killing a Medium or smaller humanoid, the dreadnought can magically take on that creature’s look and feel. It retains its statistics except size. The change lasts until the dreadnought dies or spends an action to end it.

gm.title: Description
lines: A rank-and-file draconian bred from a corrupted dragon egg. Its corpse hardens into stone and gives off a gas that can petrify nearby creatures.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Controlled Fall. When the draconian falls without being incapacitated, reduce the distance used to calculate its falling damage by up to 100 ft.
Death Throes. At 0 HP, the draconian turns to stone and releases petrifying gas. Each creature within 5 ft. must pass a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be restrained. A restrained creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success ends the effect. A failure petrifies it for 1 minute. The draconian’s body crumbles to dust after 1 minute.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: A draconian scout and spy that scales walls and glides from heights. Two hits from its envenomed daggers can paralyze the same target.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Death Throes. At 0 HP, the draconian dissolves into acid. Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, acid coats it for 1 minute and deals 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.
Glide. While falling and not incapacitated, subtract up to 100 ft. from the distance used to calculate falling damage. For each foot of descent, the draconian can also move up to 2 ft. horizontally.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks. If both hit the same creature, it must pass a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned by this attack it is also paralyzed.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged draconian spellcaster that fights with a trident or a ray of necrotic energy. Its bones explode when it dies.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Death Throes. At 0 HP, the draconian’s flesh and scales wither immediately and its bones explode. Each creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.
Glide. While falling and not incapacitated, subtract up to 100 ft. from the distance used to calculate falling damage. For each foot of descent, the draconian can also move up to 2 ft. horizontally.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Trident or Necrotic Ray for each.
Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage on a melee hit made with two hands.
Necrotic Ray. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
Spellcasting. Cast Enlarge/Reduce, Invisibility, or Stinking Cloud, each once per day. Spellcasting uses Charisma (save DC 12) and requires no material components.

gm.title: Description
lines: A cunning draconian that uses illusion and mobility to direct a fight. Its magic arcs between nearby creatures when it falls.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Death Throes. At 0 HP, lightning strikes the nearest creature within 30 ft., then arcs to up to two other creatures within 15 ft. of the first. Each target makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half the damage and avoids the stun.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Rend or Energy Ray for each.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Energy Ray. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.
Noxious Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and gains one level of exhaustion. On a success, it takes half damage, avoids exhaustion, and is immune to Noxious Breath from all draconians for 24 hours.
Spellcasting. Cast Invisibility or Mage Hand at will, or Dimension Door, Disguise Self, or Sending twice per day each. Spellcasting uses Charisma (save DC 14) and requires no material components.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Magic Shield (3/day). When an attack roll hits the draconian, it can raise its AC by 5 against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss.

gm.title: Description
lines: The psychic remnant of a gem dragon. It can appear as a spectral dragon or inhabit a treasure as an intelligent magic item, steering its bearer toward unfinished business.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid and fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Deflection. The listed AC already includes the shard’s Intelligence modifier.
Incorporeal Movement. The shard treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the shard fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Rejuvenation. At 0 HP, the shard disappears and leaves a Tiny cracked gemstone in its space. The gem matches the kind of dragon the shard once was. The gem has AC 20, 15 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force. After 1d20 days, an intact gem dissipates and the shard returns at full HP in that space or the nearest unoccupied space. Destroying the gem prevents its return.
Unusual Nature. The shard requires no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Telekinetic Rend attacks.
Telekinetic Rend. Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage.
Inhabit Object. The shard disappears into a visible, nonsentient object of Medium size or smaller within 30 ft. Use the shard’s AC for the object and apply damage to the shard’s HP. Possession ends if the shard uses an action to leave, is turned, reaches 0 HP, or an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good ends the possession. The shard reappears in the nearest unoccupied space when it leaves. The inhabited object becomes a magic item if it was not one already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone of the shard’s ancestral kind appears on it. The shard can fly the object at its own flying speed, use its senses, speak aloud or telepathically, cast spells, and use legendary actions. If a creature wears or carries the object, the shard can give that creature resistance to psychic damage and an extra 1d8 force damage each time an attack hits.
Psychic Crush (Recharge 5–6). Each creature the shard chooses in a 60-ft.-radius sphere centered on the shard makes a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the stun.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Cast Detect Thoughts, Invisibility, or Telekinesis at will. Spellcasting uses Intelligence (save DC 20) and requires no components.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The shard gets three legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn.
Rend (1 action). Make one Telekinetic Rend attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
Commanding Thought (2 actions). One creature the shard can see within 30 ft. must pass a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn. While charmed, it moves and acts as the shard directs telepathically. On its turn, its only action options are Dash and Attack, and the shard chooses the target of any Attack.

gm.title: Description
lines: A six-foot green dragon. Its humanoid form keeps the scales, claws, and teeth and loses its wings and tail.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any terrain and activity cycle. Very rare. Solitary, appearing alone. No diet or treasure. Neutral, or matches the bearer. Intelligence High (13–14). Size Medium, 6 ft. tall. Morale Champion (15–16). Magic resistance 15%.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Claws and bite. In dragon form, make two claw attacks for 1d10 each and a bite for 3d6. Its tail can also strike a creature behind it for 2d6.

Humanoid weapons. Fight as an 8th-level fighter using two claws for 1d6 each and a bite for 2d6, or a two-handed sword. If desired, the servant arrives with a +1/+3 two-handed sword, which is absorbed when it returns to dragon form.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The servant’s fire breath lists damage and uses but gives no area or save details. The sword’s +1/+3 notation is retained as printed.

gm.title: Description
lines: Once a dwarf, Fafnir turned on his family over the cursed ring Andvaranaut. He now guards his hoard in secluded hillside or cliff caves, moving whenever he suspects someone might find it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 16. Darkvision 60 ft. and keensense 60 ft. Languages Common, Draconic, Dwarven, and Northern Tongue.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +5, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha -1

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Armor of Greed (3/day). Fafnir can turn a hit against him into a miss. A critical hit costs two uses. Each use grants advantage on attacks against Fafnir through the end of his next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Fafnir fails a save, he can succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks, replacing one with Constrict if desired.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 18) and Restrained while the grapple lasts. Fafnir cannot use Constrict on another target while holding it.
Misfortune Breath (recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure deals 31 (7d8) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of Fafnir’s next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
Fafnir can spend 3 legendary actions per round, one option at the end of another creature’s turn. He regains them at the start of his turn.
Entrap. Move up to half speed and make one Constrict attack.
Toxic Blood Spray (costs 2 actions; 241 HP or fewer). Each creature within 20 ft. of Fafnir makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 10 (4d4) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of its next turn.
Inflame Greed (costs 2 actions). Cast Compel Avarice (Wisdom, DC 13) with verbal and somatic components, without material components or concentration. Choose a visible object and target one creature within 30 ft. On a failed save it tries to steal the object, fights its holder if theft fails, or flees the others to guard it once acquired. The effect lasts up to 1 minute. A creature immune to Charmed automatically succeeds.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option. Fafnir cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Distracting Gleam. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of the point makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. A failure bars reactions and bonus actions for up to 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies. Affected creatures repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it.
Grasping Tentacles. Target up to three creatures Fafnir can see within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or becomes Restrained by tentacles. Any creature, including a target, can spend an action and pass a DC 15 Strength check to free a target.
Treasure Whirlwind. A visible point within 120 ft. becomes the center of a 15-ft.-diameter whirlwind. Each creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting a turn there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. It lasts 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
The region can have any of these effects. They fade 1d10 days after Fafnir leaves or dies.
Avariciousness. Within 1 mile, creatures guard their things, covet others’ belongings, and have disadvantage on saves against effects that compel theft or taking an object.
Familial Strife. Within 5 miles, creatures become hostile toward relatives. Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks to get someone to harm a relative have advantage.
Increased Mishaps. Within 1 mile, checks and saves to avoid injury while climbing, jumping pits, or otherwise risking an accident have disadvantage.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: A saurial swordsman who helps Artus Cimber search Chult. He communicates his feelings through scents and willingly puts himself in danger to help a friend.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common but cannot speak it. His native clicks and whistles are above the human hearing range.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Divine Health. Dragonbait is immune to disease.
Magic Resistance Aura. While Dragonbait holds his Holy Avenger Longsword, he and friendly creatures within 10 feet of him have advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two melee weapon attacks.
Holy Avenger (+3 Longsword). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage when wielded in one hand, or 10 (1d10 + 5) in two hands. Against a fiend or undead, the hit also deals 11 (2d10) radiant damage.
Sense Alignment. Choose a visible creature within 60 feet and learn its alignment. This fails if magic shields that creature from divination.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines:
Dragonbait met Artus Cimber in Port Nyanzaru and helps him look for his wife, Alisanda. If Artus agrees to destroy the Soulmonger, Dragonbait joins him. He has never been to Omu and cannot guide the party there.
Scent cues. Brimstone signals confusion, roses sadness, lemon joy, bread anger, violets fear or danger, honeysuckle concern, wood smoke devotion, tar triumph, and ham worry.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, Appendix D, pp. 217–218. The stat block is on p. 218.

gm.title: Description

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Blindsight 120 ft. The ooze is blind beyond that radius.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Draconic and its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. The ooze fits through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The ooze can climb difficult surfaces and cross ceilings upside down without a check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks, or replace one with Slime Breath when available.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends.
Slime Breath (Recharge 6). The ooze ejects part of its body in a 30-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) acid damage and is pulled up to 30 ft. straight toward the ooze. On a success, it takes half damage and stays where it is.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dragon animates the etched bones of defeated rivals and binds them with adamantine wire to make a lair guardian.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Draconic and its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fear Aura. When a creature of the golem’s choice starts its turn within 20 ft., it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save unless the golem is incapacitated. A failure leaves it frightened until the start of its next turn. A success grants 24 hours of immunity to this golem’s aura.
Magic Resistance. The golem makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Unusual Nature. The golem needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Pinion attack and two Rend attacks.
Pinion. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is pinned and restrained. Each of the golem’s two pinions can restrain one creature. An occupied pinion cannot attack. At the start of its turn, the restrained creature can free itself with a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. A failure deals 35 (10d6) poison damage and restrains the creature while it starts to turn to stone. The restrained creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. The effect ends on a success and petrifies it on a failure.

gm.title: Description
lines: A halberd-bearing dragonborn who channels the element of a dragon ancestor. Dragonborn may guard their communities or act as emissaries for true dragons.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Chain shirt. Perception 11. Stealth 10. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Draconic.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +3 · DEX +0 · CON +1 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +2

gm.title: Traits
lines: Draconic Ancestry. Choose an ancestor and use its damage type for both resistance and Breath Weapon. Black or copper gives acid, silver or white gives cold, brass, gold, or red gives fire, blue or bronze gives lightning, green gives poison, void gives necrotic, and yellow gives radiant.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Halberd. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6). Choose a 15-ft. cone or a 30-ft. line 5 ft. wide. Each creature in the area makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) damage of the ancestry type on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Tail Lash. A visible creature within 5 ft. falls Prone on a failed DC 13 Strength save.

gm.title: Shared dread cloaker rules
lines:
Printed source. Cloaker, Dread, p. 51.
Damage reduction (Su). A cloaker draped around its host shares its damage reduction against physical attacks other than area attacks.
Engulf (Ex). As a standard action, the cloaker envelops a creature at least one size category smaller. Its host is engulfed automatically. Any other target requires a successful grapple check without provoking an attack of opportunity. The target is pinned. A cloaker without a host gains +4 to bite the engulfed creature.
Split damage from attacks that hit an engulfing cloaker equally between it and its victim. Area spells deal full damage to both. A shadow or undead cloaker can still strike other targets with its tail while engulfing a creature.

lines: Ravenloft produces corrupted elementals of blood, grave earth, mist, and pyre fire. Each has six printed size tiers.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Choose the kind of elemental and its size tier, then use that profile. All four use elemental traits and the Mists subtype. They understand speech but never speak. Free-willed dread elementals resent their conjurers and look for a chance to turn on them.

gm.title: Dread elemental rules
lines:
Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.
In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.
Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

gm.title: Description
lines: A succubus has taken control of the printed fighter. It can imitate the host’s ordinary life until its wings and infernal features give it away.

gm.title: Classification

lines:

Smite Good (Su, 1/day). Add 6 damage to a normal melee attack against a good foe.
Spell-like abilities. Charm person at will. Darkness 3/day. Desecrate and unholy blight 1/day each. CL 6, Charisma-based saves.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/magic, darkvision 60 ft., immune to poison, acid/cold/electricity/fire resistance 10, SR 16. Dread fiends summoned into Ravenloft cannot return to their plane when the spell ends.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC +5 Dex, +1 natural, +4 chain shirt. Touch 15, flat-footed 15. BAB/grapple +6/+11, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +10, Ref +7, Will +2.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +7, Craft (woodworking) +2, Handle Animal +2, Intimidate +7, Jump +7, Ride +8, Swim +7. Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Mounted Combat, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (longsword). Solitary, always evil, double standard treasure.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: A complete transposition replaces the host’s agency and changes the host to outsider. The host must be living, corporeal, nongood and Int 4+. Keep size, Hit Dice, BAB and saves. Add +1 natural armor, two claws and a bite, magical natural weapons, and flight at land speed (average) only if wings function. Smite adds HD damage (max +20). DR increases to 10/magic at 12 HD, SR is HD +10 (max 35). Modifiers Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +4, Cha +2. Increase CR by 1 at up to 4 HD, by 2 at 5–10 HD, or by 3 at 11+ HD.

gm.title: Template powers
lines: If Int or Wis is at least 8, gain cumulative Charisma-based abilities at CL equal to HD. At 1 HD darkness 3/day; 3 desecrate; 5 unholy blight; 7 poison 3/day; 9 contagion; 11 blasphemy; 13 unholy aura 3/day and unhallow; 15 horrid wilting; 17 summon monster IX (fiends only); 19 destruction. Default is 1/day.

gm.title: Possessing fiend options
lines: Balor grants see invisibility at will and fire that deals 2d6 per round to anyone touching it, with −4 Cha. Erinyes grants cause fear at will and +4 Cha. Pit fiend grants +2 Str and injury poison at Fortitude DC 27, initially 1d6 Con and then death. Succubus grants charm person at will and +4 Cha.

gm.title: Natural attack damage by size
lines: Bite/claw: Fine 1/none; Diminutive 1d2/1; Tiny 1d3/1d2; Small 1d4/1d3; Medium 1d6/1d4; Large 1d8/1d6; Huge 2d6/1d8; Gargantuan 3d6/2d6; Colossal 4d6/3d6. The full attack can use two claws and a secondary bite, or a weapon and secondary bite plus a claw if it has a free hand.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book supplies Hit Dice but does not print a fixed HP total. Roll 6d10 + 24. The printed HP dice and initiative do not follow directly from the listed abilities and feats.

lines:
Damage reduction 5/adamantine or magic. Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision and disease immunity. Its own stat block specifically lists vulnerability to poison, level drain and gases.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance. Magical cold or fire slows the golem for 2d6 rounds. Electrical magic clears this slowing effect and restores 1 HP for every 3 damage the spell would have dealt. It can gain temporary HP this way and makes no electricity save. Only acid or fire can destroy it permanently.
Regeneration (Ex). It regains 1 HP per hour even while active. Below 0 HP it goes dormant and stops recovering. A strong electrical shock can wake it after its flesh is repaired.
Fear of fire. It tries to stay 10 ft. away from small fires and 25 ft. from larger ones. It takes a −4 penalty on Fear saves involving fire.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.

gm.title: Dread golem commands
lines: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.

gm.title: Description
lines: The maker shapes a body, but the dark desires behind the work bring the construct to life. Some dread golems develop wills of their own.

gm.title: Running the encounter

gm.title: Construct defenses
lines: Dread golems are immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease, and similar effects. They ignore critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain, and death from massive damage. Their magic immunity blocks spells except where the chosen golem's profile lists an exception.

gm.title: Description
lines: These shapeshifters feed on fear in the Veil of Sleep and use a dreamer's memories to decide what shape to take.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: A gray morph plays a minor part in the nightmare and flees when challenged. A shadow morph directs the dream and uses its howl to paralyze foes. An ennui stalks vivid nightmares and can turn invisible. Use the chosen form's profile. If a dream spawn kills a dreamer in the dreamscape, the dreamer makes a Madness save on waking. The DC is 10 + half the spawn's Hit Dice + its Wisdom modifier.

gm.title: Shared actions
lines: Alternate Form works as polymorph on itself at caster level 8 and takes a standard action. It lasts indefinitely, and the spawn can return to its own form as a free action. In its dreamscape, it reads surface thoughts as if it had studied each creature for three rounds with detect thoughts. Caster level equals its Hit Dice and the save DC is Wisdom-based. Once per day, Memory Drain inflicts 1d4 Intelligence damage with a touch. Until the victim recovers all the lost Intelligence, the spawn can mimic creatures from their memories.

gm.title: Lullaby and Fear Eater
lines: Lullaby is a standard action. Foes within 20 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or become fatigued for 1d4 rounds, or for as long as the spawn stays within 20 ft. and maintains its chant as a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion. Dream spawn are immune to fear, horror, and madness. A spell that would cause one of these effects heals the spawn 1 HP per spell level. If the spawn makes a dreamer fail one of these saves, it heals 2 HP for a minor effect, 4 HP for a moderate effect, or 8 HP for a major effect.

gm.title: Nightmares
lines: The victim is shaken for 5d6 rounds. Each attempt to sleep ends after 5d6 minutes, preventing rest, natural healing, and recovery of arcane spells. Each full day without rest adds a cumulative −1 morale penalty to attack rolls, saves, skill checks, and ability checks, up to −4. A sleep spell allows dreamless rest and clears the accumulated penalties, but the nightmares return on nights without it. Elves are normally immune. The optional waking dream during meditation instead works like major image and permits a Will save to disbelieve. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, p. 81.

gm.title: Description
lines: A devotee of Lolth who draws magic from the Demonweb Pits and can take the form of a large spider.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Elvish, Undercommon, can speak with spiders.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The creature has advantage on saves to avoid being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. The drow climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without making an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict the drow’s movement.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any combination of Bite, Poisonous Touch, and Web that the current form allows. Spellcasting can replace one of those attacks.
Bite (spider form only). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If this poison damage drops the target to 0 hit points, it is stable and poisoned for 1 hour, even if it regains hit points. While poisoned this way, it is also paralyzed.
Poisonous Touch (humanoid form only). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 35 (10d6) poison damage.
Web (spider form only, recharge 5–6). Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. A hit restrains the target in webbing. The target can spend an action to break the webbing with a successful DC 15 Strength check. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hit points, vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell without material components using Intelligence (spell save DC 17).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Darkness, Dispel Magic, Etherealness, Faerie Fire, Fly, Insect Plague, Invisibility.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Change Shape (recharges after a short or long rest). Magically become a Large spider for up to 1 hour or return to true form. Only size changes. The drow can speak and cast spells as a spider. Anything worn or carried in humanoid form merges into the spider, and the drow cannot use or benefit from it in that form. Death restores the drow’s humanoid form.

gm.title: Description
lines: A priestess of Lolth who leads a noble drow house. A Drow Favored Consort and Drow House Captain usually accompany her.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium humanoid (drow elf, cleric), typically neutral evil

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The drow has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic can't put the drow to sleep.
Special Equipment. The matron mother wields a Tentacle Rod.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Demon Staff attacks, or one Demon Staff attack and three Tentacle Rod attacks.
Demon Staff. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage with one hand or 8 (1d8 + 4) with two. Add 14 (4d6) psychic damage either way. The target must pass a DC 19 Wisdom save or be frightened of the matron mother for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Tentacle Rod. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. Three rod hits on the same turn force a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute the creature's speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, and it can't take reactions. On each of its turns it can take an action or a bonus action, but only one. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end all these effects.
Divine Flame (2/day). Place a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high column of fire within 120 ft. Each creature in it makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) fire plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half of each on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of these spells using Charisma (spell save DC 20). Material components are waived.
At will. Command, Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Thaumaturgy.
2/day each. Banishment, Blade Barrier, Cure Wounds, Hold Person, Plane Shift, Silence.
1/day each. Clairvoyance, Darkness, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Faerie Fire, Gate, Levitate (self only), Suggestion.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Lolth's Fickle Favor. Choose one ally she can see within 30 ft. The ally takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and gains advantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Summon Servant (1/day). Magically summon a Glabrezu or Yochlol to an unoccupied space within 60 ft. It fights as an ally and can't summon other demons. It stays for 10 minutes, until it or the matron mother dies, or until she spends an action to dismiss it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The matron mother has 3 legendary actions. She can use one option at the end of another creature's turn, paying its listed cost. Spent actions return at the start of her turn. She can't use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, she must finish her first turn before using them.
Compel Demon (1 action). An allied demon within 30 ft. uses its reaction to attack once against a target she chooses and can see.
Demon Staff (1 action). Make one Demon Staff attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
The matron mother's palace is her lair. A temple to Lolth also qualifies while she is inside, provided she still follows Lolth and no other matron mother is present. If two or more matron mothers gather in such a temple, none can use its lair actions.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, she can use one option in her lair. She must be able to act. If surprised, she can act on count 20 only after her first turn. She can't choose the same option in consecutive rounds.
Perceive Interlopers. Until initiative count 20 in the next round, hostile creatures in the lair can't become hidden from her and get no benefit from invisibility against her.
Spectral Web. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 60 ft. of it must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be restrained for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Telekinetic Throw. Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 19 Strength save, it flies 2d6 × 10 ft. through the air. If it strikes a solid object, it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. moved. Apply normal falling damage if released in midair.

gm.title: Mothers of Rebellion
lines: A matron mother who renounces Lolth can have any alignment and loses Lolth's Fickle Favor, Summon Servant, and Compel Demon.

lines: A cleric of Lolth in enchanted scale mail who can call giant spiders or risk summoning a yochlol.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The creature has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines: Charisma (spell save DC 15), with no material components. At will: Dancing Lights. 1/day each: Darkness, Faerie Fire, Levitate (self only).

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
10th-level cleric spellcaster. Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Prepared spells:
Cantrips at will: Guidance, Poison Spray, Resistance, Spare the Dying, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots): Animal Friendship, Cure Wounds, Detect Poison and Disease, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots): Lesser Restoration, Protection from Poison, Web.
3rd level (3 slots): Conjure Animals (2 Giant Spiders), Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots): Divination, Freedom of Movement.
5th level (2 slots): Insect Plague, Mass Cure Wounds.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two scourge attacks.
Scourge. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing plus 17 (5d6) poison damage.
Summon Demon (1/day). Magically attempt to summon a Yochlol with a 30 percent chance of success. On failure, the priestess takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage. On success, the following rules apply. The demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner and fights on the summoner’s side. It cannot summon demons. It stays for 10 minutes, until either of them dies, or until the summoner dismisses it as an action.

gm.title: Magic equipment
lines: An hour or more in sunlight strips the +3 bonus permanently. Afterward, use AC 16.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Source variant of Drow Priestess of Lolth. Check the variant rules for changes to actions and traits.

gm.title: Description
lines: An Underdark spy or assassin whose power over shadows comes from trapping the essence of a Shadow Demon.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness doesn't obstruct the drow's darkvision.
Fey Ancestry. The drow has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic can't put the drow to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Shadow Sword attacks. The shadowblade can replace one of them with a Hand Crossbow attack. It can also use Spellcasting to cast Darkness as part of this action.
Shadow Sword. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (7d6 + 5) necrotic damage.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 hour. On a failure by 5 or more it is also unconscious while this poison lasts. Damage or another creature spending an action to shake it awake ends the unconsciousness.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of these spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13). Material components are waived.
At will. Dancing Lights, Darkness.
1/day each. Faerie Fire, Levitate (self only).

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shadow Step. From dim light or darkness, teleport with worn or carried equipment up to 60 ft. to a visible unoccupied space in dim light or darkness. The shadowblade has advantage on its first melee attack before the turn ends.

gm.title: Optional action
lines: Summon Shadow Demon (1/day). Make a magical summoning attempt with a 50 percent chance of success. On a failure, the drow takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage. On a success, a Shadow Demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. It acts as an ally and can't summon other demons. It stays for 10 minutes, until it or the shadowblade dies, or until the shadowblade dismisses it as an action.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The drow has advantage on saves against being charmed and is immune to magical sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shadow Step. While in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the drow can see in dim light or darkness. The drow has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the turn ends.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Shadow Sword attacks. Once per turn, if either hits a target within 10 ft. of a cube of darkness the sword created on an earlier turn, the drow can dismiss the cube to deal an additional 21 (6d6) necrotic damage to the target.

Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or more also leaves the target unconscious while this poison lasts. Damage wakes it, as does another creature using an action to shake it awake.

gm.title: Variant rules
lines: Summon Shadow Demon (1/day). Some drow of this kind can attempt to summon a Shadow Demon as an action. The magical summon has a 50% chance to work. Failure deals 5 (1d10) psychic damage to the drow. On success, the demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the drow. It acts as the drow’s ally and cannot summon other demons. It departs after 10 minutes, if it or the drow dies, or if the drow uses an action to dismiss it.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines:
Charisma sets the innate spell save DC at 13. The spells require no material components.
At will. Dancing Lights.

lines: Three drownlings stage a drowning to lure strangers into stagnant water. One asks for help while the others make the scene convincing.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +4. AC components +4 Dex, +1 size. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 11. Base attack +1, grapple −4. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +1.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +1 melee (1d4 − 1).
Full attack. Two claws +1 melee (1d4 − 1 each).
Improved Grab (Ex). Hit a swimming target of Medium size or smaller with both claws to start a grapple. On a hold, try to pin the victim and drag them below the surface. The other drownlings use aid another to help maintain the pin until the victim drowns.
Spell-like abilities. Each 1/day at caster level 8th: charm person, confusion, dancing lights, detect magic, entangle. Save DC 12 + spell level.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

Water Dependency (Ex). Each hour on dry land deals 1d4 Strength damage. In its native waters the drownling recovers 1 point of lost Strength per minute.

lines: Bluff +10, Hide +15, Listen +6, Move Silently +7, Sense Motive +8, Spot +6. Feats: Alertness (bonus feat), Dodge.

lines: Aquatic and marsh terrain or anywhere near water, including underground. Covey (3). Covey members communicate telepathically and speak other languages. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure.

gm.title: Adventure encounter
lines: Drufi patrols with two other Frost Giants and two Winter Wolves. A DC 10 Wisdom (Survival) check recognizes that the oversized tracks and broken vegetation are foreign to the jungle. Success by 5 or more identifies frost giants. A Chultan guide has advantage but does not infer that frost giants made the trail. Drufi first asks what the group knows about Artus Cimber. A DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check picks up her interest in his magic item. She may attack if provoked or if she believes the party is withholding its whereabouts.

lines:

Ice Walk. No ability check is needed to cross or climb ice. Ice and snow cost him no extra movement as difficult terrain.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target loses reactions until the end of its next turn.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Numbing Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 42 (12d6) cold damage and leaves the creature Restrained until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Icy Grip. A creature Durixaviinox can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) cold damage and leaves it Restrained in ice. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint. A creature can spend an action to free itself or another creature it can reach, ending the restraint.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Withering Frost. When a creature within 5 ft. hits him with an attack, every creature within 5 ft. of him makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn, and at most one per round.
Raging Blizzard. Each creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, pushes the creature 60 ft. straight away from Durixaviinox and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids the push and knockdown.
Royal Defense. Summon a spectral guard using the Frost Giant Wind Sprinter stat block with its type changed to Undead. It acts immediately after Durixaviinox and follows his verbal commands. He has resistance to all damage while it is within 60 ft. of him. The guard is destroyed if he dies.
Frost Cataclysm. Each enemy in a 120-ft.-radius sphere centered on Durixaviinox makes a DC 18 Constitution save against 45 (10d8) cold damage, then a separate DC 18 Strength save against 45 (10d8) force damage. Each successful save halves its respective damage.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses just one. If it becomes Dazed on its turn, its turn ends. gm.title: Description
lines: This armored revenant tracks movement through stone and can retreat inside a wall.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level dwarf fighter. Initiative +6. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 28. BAB +5, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +11 melee (1d6 + 6 and 1d4 Strength drain to a living target), +1 dwarven waraxe +14 melee (1d10 + 9, ×3) or throwing axe +7 ranged (1d6 + 6).
Terror Gaze (Su). Standard action to target a creature it can see within 30 ft. The target need not see the vampire. DC 12 Will Fear save. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also prompts a Horror save at DC 7, the Fear DC minus 5. A further failed Fear save worsens shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to call 2d8 badgers, 2d6 wolverines, or 2d4 thoqquas. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 10/cold iron and magic, cold and electricity resistance 20, darkvision 60 ft., turn resistance +4, and undead traits. SR 12 cannot be lowered. A dwarven vampire must overcome its own SR to cast spells. Tremorsense pinpoints creatures touching stone within 60 ft.
Stonewalk (Su). At will as a standard action merge into solid stone and travel through it at 20 ft. Remain merged indefinitely. At 1 HP or more, fast healing is 1 aboveground or 5 underground. At 0 HP or less it retreats through stone to its coffin within 2 hours or is destroyed. After 1 hour in the coffin it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: A dwarf drained to Constitution 0 or less must be laid underground in a stone sarcophagus. The creator sprinkles the body with powdered metals. The victim rises 1d4 days later and remains controlled until its creator dies. At 4 HD or fewer it becomes spawn, otherwise a dwarven vampire. Dwarven spawn have DC 14 Fear Gaze, the same Strength Drain, Blood Drain and Stonewalk, and heal 2 HP per round only underground.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Mirrors and presented holy symbols repel it. An unbroken line of metal shavings blocks it even through stone. It can enter only structures built at least partly from stone and earth. In sunlight it can take only standard actions and turns to stone the next round unless it escapes. Stone to flesh reverses this. Mineral-spring water burns like holy water and immersion in a natural spring removes one-third of HP per round, destroying it after 3 rounds. Natural stone through the heart kills it while left in place. To make the death permanent, the book requires the heart to soak in oil for three days, then burn to ash in a dwarven forge.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Appraise +3, Bluff +8, Climb +14, Craft (weaponsmithing) +9, Hide +10, Intimidate +2, Listen +12, Move Silently +10, Ride +7, Search +9, Sense Motive +10, Spot +12. Alertness, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dwarven waraxe), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (dwarven waraxe).

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to a dwarf. Age DR always requires cold iron and magic. The two listed fast healing numbers are aboveground and underground.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dybbuk is an airborne demon with a jellyfish-like body. It uses intact corpses to move among the living and frighten witnesses.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Incorporeal Movement. The dybbuk can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Magic Resistance. The dybbuk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, reduce its hit point maximum by 3 (1d6) until it finishes a short or long rest. If the maximum falls to 0, the creature dies.
Possess Corpse (recharge 6). The dybbuk disappears into an intact corpse within 5 ft. that belonged to a Large or smaller Beast or Humanoid. The dybbuk gains 20 temporary hit points. It takes the corpse's size and cannot use Incorporeal Movement while inside, but its other statistics stay the same. The possession ends when it loses those temporary hit points or ends it as a bonus action. It then appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the corpse.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The dybbuk casts one spell as an action using Charisma, with spell save DC 12. It needs no material components.
At will. Dimension Door.
3/day. Phantasmal Force.

lines: Control Corpse. While possessing a corpse, the dybbuk makes it move or behave in an unnatural way. Each Beast or Humanoid that sees this makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of the dybbuk for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Any creature that succeeds on the save is immune to Control Corpse for 24 hours.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

False Appearance. If motionless at the start of combat, it rolls initiative with advantage. A creature that has never seen it move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it as animate. Dragons have disadvantage on the check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Barbed Proboscis attacks. The egg hunter can also use Torpor Spores if available.
Barbed Proboscis. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The egg hunter regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.
Torpor Spores (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft.-radius sphere centered on the egg hunter must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, the creature can take only one of an action or a bonus action on its turn. It cannot take reactions. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When it succeeds on the save or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this egg hunter’s Torpor Spores for 24 hours.

gm.title: Description
lines: An eidolon guards a sacred place and can animate a statue prepared to hold its spirit.

gm.title: Languages
lines: The languages it knew in life.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid, fire, lightning, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Incorporeal Movement. The eidolon can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object other than a Sacred Statue, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.
Sacred Animation (recharge 5–6). When the eidolon enters a Sacred Statue's space, it can disappear into the statue. The statue becomes a creature under its control, and the eidolon uses the Sacred Statue stat block while inside.
Turn Resistance. The eidolon has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
Unusual Nature. The eidolon needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Divine Dread. Each creature within 60 ft. that can see the eidolon makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is frightened of it for 1 minute. At the start of each turn while frightened this way, the creature must take the Dash action and move away by the safest available route. If it has nowhere to go, it is also stunned until it can move again. The creature repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. When it succeeds or the effect ends, it is immune to every eidolon's Divine Dread for 24 hours.

gm.title: Sacred Statue encounter
lines:
The Sacred Statue is an object until an eidolon enters it. The animated statue is a Large construct with the eidolon's alignment, AC 19 (natural armor), 95 HP (10d10 + 40), and speed 25 ft. It has Str 19, Dex 8, Con 19, Int 14, Wis 19, Cha 16, and a +8 Wisdom save. It has darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14, and the eidolon's languages. It resists acid, fire, and lightning, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. It is immune to cold, necrotic, and poison damage and to the charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
False Appearance. If motionless at the start of combat, the statue has advantage on initiative. A creature that has never seen the statue move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell it is a creature.
Ghostly Inhabitant. The eidolon leaves the statue if the statue reaches 0 HP, if the eidolon leaves as a bonus action, or if it is turned or forced out, such as by Dispel Evil and Good. It then appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the statue and uses its own stat block again.
Multiattack. The statue makes two Slam or Rock attacks in any combination.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 43 (6d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 37 (6d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: The mind flayer colony tends this immense brain in a pool of psionically charged brine. It coordinates the colony by telepathy and feeds on other creatures’ brains.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Large aberration (mind flayer), typically lawful evil

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon. It cannot speak. Telepathy 5 miles.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Creature Sense. Within 5 miles, the brain knows the distance, direction, and Intelligence score of every creature with Intelligence 4 or higher. This trait reveals no other information. Mind Blank, Nondetection, or similar magic shields the creature from this sense.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the brain fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The brain has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Telepathic Hub. Start and maintain telepathic conversations with up to ten creatures at once. The brain can let those creatures hear each other telepathically.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns while grappled this way. The brain can grapple up to four targets at once.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Choose any creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 18). No components are required.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
3/day. Modify Memory.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Psychic Link. Link with one incapacitated creature detected by Creature Sense. While linked, the brain perceives everything the target senses. When the target recovers from incapacitation, it notices the mental link. The target can use its action to make a DC 18 Charisma save, breaking the link and taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a success. The brain can end the link without an action at any time. It also ends when the two are more than 5 miles apart. The brain can maintain up to ten links at once.
Sense Thoughts. Choose a creature linked by Psychic Link. The brain learns its emotional state and most immediate thoughts, including its worries, loves, or hates.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The brain has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use these actions only when able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Break Concentration (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. End its concentration on a spell it cast and deal 2 (1d4) psychic damage per level of that spell.
Psychic Pulse (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. The target and the brain’s enemies within 30 ft. of the target take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Sever Psychic Link (1 action). End the link with one linked creature within 120 ft. That creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.
Tentacle (2 actions). Make one Tentacle attack.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
While in its lair, the brain can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using an option. It cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Force Wall. Cast Wall of Force.
Psionic Anchor. Choose a creature the brain can sense within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, its speed becomes 0 and it cannot teleport. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Psychic Inspiration. Choose a friendly creature the brain can sense within 120 ft. It gains advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw of its choice before the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Use one or more of these effects around the lair. They end as soon as the brain dies.
Paranoia. Creatures within 5 miles feel they are being followed.
Psychic Whispers. A linked creature hears faint, unintelligible fragments of the brain’s thoughts and those of its other linked creatures.
Telepathic Eavesdropping. The brain can overhear telepathic conversations within 5 miles. When contact begins, its initiator makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a success, the initiator notices the eavesdropping without learning who is listening.
