gm.title: Description
lines: A vampire’s chosen companion survives an interrupted Dark Kiss. The vorlog charms a replacement and drains their Wisdom to keep them devoted.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +6. AC components +2 Dex, +3 natural, +4 chain shirt. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 17. Base attack +6, grapple +10. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack and full attack as printed. Unarmed strike +10/+5 melee (1d3 + 4 nonlethal and Wisdom Drain), short sword +10/+5 melee (1d6 + 4, 19–20/×2), or masterwork mighty longbow +9 ranged (1d8 + 4, 19–20/×2).
Animal Rage (Su). At will, animals within 50 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or rage as the spell at caster level 12 and attack the nearest creature, even the vorlog.
Charm Person (Sp). At will at caster level 6, Will DC 12.
Wisdom Drain (Su). The unarmed hit deals 1d3 Wisdom damage to a living target. At Wisdom below 3 it becomes a lost one under the vorlog’s control. The vorlog keeps its surrogate at or below half their normal Wisdom.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/silver and magic. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, and paralysis. Fast Healing (Ex) restores 1 HP per hour while at 1 HP or more, or 1 HP per round if the surrogate is physically present. At 0 HP or less it becomes a puddle of tears, moves at speed 20 ft., can climb walls and pass through tiny cracks, and must reach a dark haven in 1d4 hours or evaporate. After resting 8 hours it resumes humanoid form. Direct sunlight deals 1d6 damage each round. It will not approach a good deity’s holy symbol presented with conviction. It needs food and Wisdom and dies after three months without a surrogate.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +16, Craft (bowmaking) +4, Diplomacy +3, Listen +4, Move Silently +13, Ride +4, Spot +4. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Dodge, Improved Critical (short sword), Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Point Blank Shot, Power Attack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land and underground. Solitary. Usually chaotic, always evil. Standard treasure. Gear includes 50 +1 arrows and a ring of climbing. It retains its former languages. A charmed victim who drinks the vorlog’s blood for three consecutive nights becomes its surrogate.

gm.title: Template for another encounter
lines: Apply to a humanoid or monstrous humanoid. Keep type, size, speed, attacks, damage, saves, and existing special abilities. Increase Hit Dice one die size to a maximum of d12. Add +3 natural armor, +4 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Cha, and a +8 racial bonus to Move Silently. Add Alertness and Improved Unarmed Strike if missing. Add the vorlog attacks, traits and weaknesses above. Animal Rage Will DC is 10 + half the vorlog’s HD + Cha modifier. Charm Person Will DC is 11 + Cha modifier. CR is base +1, level adjustment base +8, and advancement by class.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The sample prints iterative melee bonuses in both Attack and Full Attack and gives the longbow a 19–20/×2 critical. Listed values follow the printing. The sample’s level adjustment is +15.

gm.title: Description
lines: This fledgling was a human warrior. It puts victims into a fever sleep and can flee as a swarm.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level human warrior. Initiative +9. AC components +5 Dex, +5 natural, +1 deflection. Touch 16, flat-footed 16. Base attack +5, grapple +11. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +8, Will +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +11 melee for 1d4 + 6 and filth fever.
Full attack. Two of the listed claws.
Fever Sleep (Su). Standard action against one target within 30 ft. who meets its eyes. Will DC 12 or sleep as the spell at caster level 12 without a Hit Dice limit. Feeding does not awaken the target.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living creature in a grapple. Each round the pin is maintained, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP. A victim must also save against filth fever.
Filth fever (Ex). Any living victim damaged by a claw or blood drain makes a DC 12 Fortitude save. Incubation is 1d3 days. The disease deals 1d3 Dexterity and 1d3 Constitution damage.
Children of the Night (Su). Once per day as a standard action, call 6d10 HD of monstrous vermin. They arrive after 2d6 rounds and serve for up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 5/iron and magic in the sample’s stat line. Cold and electricity resistance 10, turn resistance +3, spider climb, and undead traits.
Disease (Ex). The strain carries one permanent disease. It also picks up injury- or contact-transmitted diseases when it feeds on an infected victim. Add its Cha modifier to the disease DC. Each secondary disease’s DC falls by 1 each day after acquisition. At DC 0 it loses that disease. A DC 15 Heal check identifies diseases it carries.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, use polymorph at caster level 12 to change into a dire rat, a rat swarm, or a swarm of Fine vermin until changing again or until sunrise. A swarm has as many 1-HP members as the vampire has total HP. Each member killed costs the vampire 1 HP. The swarm members still carry its diseases.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: A humanoid or monstrous humanoid killed by its disease rises as vampire spawn 1d4 days after burial. A victim drained to Constitution 0 returns as spawn if it had 4 or fewer HD or as a vrykolaka if it had 5 or more. A creator controls its spawn until it dies.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines:
Garlic, anise, a continuous line of aniseed, and a strongly brandished holy symbol keep it away. It cannot enter an immaculate room or cross running water unaided. Still or stagnant water does not trouble it.
Direct sunlight leaves it with a single move or attack action. It is destroyed in the next round if it cannot escape the light. Immersion in running water takes away one-third of its HP each round and destroys it at the end of round 3. A vampire strain whose base creature has a swim speed retains it and escapes the immersion weakness.
At 1 HP or more it heals 5 HP per round. At 0 HP or less it flees as a swarm. At least half the swarm must get to its coffin within 2 hours or it is destroyed. After 1 hour there it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.
An iron spike through its skull kills it while the spike remains. Burn the body completely to keep it from returning. A casting of remove disease forces a Fortitude save or bestows two negative levels. While it sleeps in its coffin or is incapacitated it automatically fails this save. Every age tier requires cold iron and magic to bypass damage reduction. Apply one age row only. The sample already incorporates its age. gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Arcane anomalies (Drakkenheim)
lines:
Printed source. Appendix D, p. 225. Roll 1d20 for the anomaly.
1. Gravity fails in a 100-ft. radius for 1 hour. Unattended objects drift. Creatures float and can move as if climbing by pushing or pulling against surfaces or fixed objects.
2. The nearest creature is subject to Hideous Laughter, save DC 15. It babbles instead of laughing.
3. Creatures within 60 ft. are Stunned for 1 round, with no save.
4. The nearest creature gains Blink for 1 minute and slips through time when it vanishes.
5. In a 20-ft. radius, creatures make a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 8d6 radiant damage and Blinds for 1 round. Wood turns into glass.
6. For 1 minute, attacks that hit within 60 ft. show a vision of the target dying from the hit.
7. Creatures within 30 ft. are subject to Irresistible Dance, save DC 15.
8. Part of the surroundings becomes a delerium elemental appropriate to its element.
9. The GM chooses or randomly determines an extraplanar creature. It stays for 1 hour and is friendly to whoever triggered the anomaly.
10. Humanoid corpses within 120 ft. rise as hostile Haze Husks.
11. The shadows of 1d6 random creatures come alive and attack their owners. Destroying a shadow leaves its owner without one for 24 hours.
12. Creatures within 60 ft. become Invisible for 1 minute, ending for each creature when it attacks or casts a spell.
13. The nearest creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save against 8d8 necrotic damage, halved on success. The next three nearest creatures within 60 ft. each heal the damage it took.
14. Hypnotic Pattern appears, save DC 15. Those Incapacitated by it weep.
15. Black Tentacles appears in the area for 1 hour, escape DC 15.
16. Objects within 60 ft. animate for 1 hour as under Animate Objects. They speak and remain nonhostile.
17. The nearest creature becomes an awakened shrub for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 HP, with no save.
18. Up to six random creatures within 120 ft. are subject to Slow for 1 minute, save DC 15.
19. One random creature within 60 ft. gains Haste for 1 minute.
20. A bowl of flowers and an aquatic mammal appear 100 ft. overhead.

lines: Ghost, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Replace Horrifying Visage with Psychic Wail and add Mutate Host. The inherited Possession remains available.

lines:

lines:

Etherealness. Move between the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal. The witch remains visible from the other plane but cannot affect anything there or be affected by it.
Psychic Wail (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Intelligence save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage and makes the target Incapacitated until the end of the witch’s next turn.
Possession (recharge 6). One visible humanoid within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure the witch vanishes and controls the target’s body. The target stays aware, is Incapacitated, and cannot control its body. The witch keeps its own alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Charmed and Frightened immunities. It otherwise uses the target’s statistics without its knowledge, proficiencies, or class features. Only effects that turn Undead can target it during possession. The effect also ends if the body falls to 0 HP, the witch ends it as a bonus action, or it is turned or expelled by a spell such as Dispel Evil and Good. On ending, the witch appears in a vacant space within 5 ft. A humanoid that succeeds or is freed is immune to this witch’s Possession for 24 hours.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Mutate Host. While possessing a creature, force it to make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure it gains one contamination level and automatically acquires a random mutation in place of the normal mutation check.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

Memory Drain (Su). A hit on its living counterpart calls for a DC 15 Will save. On failure, the victim takes one negative level in place of physical damage, and the golem gains the memories and abilities of the victim’s newest remaining level. gm.title: Appearance
lines: A willow with hanging branches that shed salty tears.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning and piercing. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
False Appearance. A motionless willow looks like an ordinary tree.
Flammable. Fire damage ignites it for 1 minute. It takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns while burning. Cold damage puts it out, or a creature can spend an action to extinguish it.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Frenzied Branch attacks.
Frenzied Branch. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 30-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning, plus 3 (1d6) fire if the willow is burning.
Tugging Roots. Choose a visible point on the ground within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft. sphere centered there makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure, it falls Prone and the roots pull it up to 30 ft. toward the willow. It takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning for every 10 ft. moved.
Willow’s Tears. Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes Charmed by the willow. Affected creatures cannot willingly move farther than 15 ft. from it and repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect. Taking damage ends the charm on that creature.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Tree Transformation. When a creature within 5 ft. deals slashing damage to the willow, that creature makes a DC 14 Constitution save. If it fails, its feet take root and it is Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success frees it. A failure makes it Petrified as a tree of its own size, with its face visible in the trunk. If the willow dies, the petrified creature returns to its original form. The Cure Ailment power or Lesser Restoration spell also ends the effect.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Place the willow beside a path where its branches can reach across the road. Pull targets into range of its tears and track which creatures have a Tree Transformation save due on their next turn.

gm.title: Lycanthrope encounter rules
lines:
Printed source. Lycanthrope, pp. 137 and 148.
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

gm.title: Player lycanthropy
lines:
A character keeps its own statistics except for the changes listed here. It gains the printed nonhumanoid speeds, damage immunities, traits, and actions that require no equipment, plus proficiency with the lycanthrope's natural attacks. Use the listed natural weapon damage. The character cannot speak in animal form.
Only a humanoid that is not already a lycanthrope saves against the curse when hit by a curse-bearing attack. The Constitution save DC is 8 + the attacking lycanthrope's proficiency bonus + its Constitution modifier. A character who resists the curse keeps their usual alignment and personality in humanoid form. The full moon forces them into animal or hybrid form until it wanes. A character who embraces the curse acquires the lycanthrope's alignment and can eventually learn to shift at will. The DM can take control of the character until the curse is removed. Remove Curse can end an acquired curse. A natural-born lycanthrope needs Wish.
Raise Strength to 19 if lower. Bear and hybrid forms gain +1 AC from natural armor. Use Strength for natural weapon attack and damage rolls.

gm.title: Nonhuman lycanthropes
lines: The printed blocks assume a human. For a lycanthrope of another ancestry, the DM can retain one or more traits from its humanoid form, such as Fey Ancestry for an elf.

lines: Speed · 30 ft. in humanoid or hybrid form. 40 ft. in boar form.

gm.title: Description
lines: A territorial brawler that charges with its tusks in boar or hybrid form and fights with a heavy maul when it has hands.

gm.title: Armor
lines: AC 10 in humanoid form. AC 11 from natural armor in boar and hybrid forms.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common. It cannot speak in boar form.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a boar, a boar-humanoid hybrid, or its true humanoid form. Use the listed armor class and movement for the chosen form. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Charge (boar or hybrid only). Move at least 15 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Tusks on the same turn to deal an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage. A creature hit this way makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.
Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest). If damage of 14 or less would drop it to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack (humanoid or hybrid only). Make two attacks, with at most one Tusks attack.
Maul (humanoid or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Tusks (boar or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A humanoid target that is not already a lycanthrope makes a DC 12 Constitution save or contracts wereboar lycanthropy.

gm.title: Player lycanthropy
lines:
A character keeps its own statistics except for the changes listed here. It gains the printed nonhumanoid speeds, damage immunities, traits, and actions that require no equipment, plus proficiency with the lycanthrope's natural attacks. Use the listed natural weapon damage. The character cannot speak in animal form.
Only a humanoid that is not already a lycanthrope saves against the curse when hit by a curse-bearing attack. The Constitution save DC is 8 + the attacking lycanthrope's proficiency bonus + its Constitution modifier. A character who resists the curse keeps their usual alignment and personality in humanoid form. The full moon forces them into animal or hybrid form until it wanes. A character who embraces the curse acquires the lycanthrope's alignment and can eventually learn to shift at will. The DM can take control of the character until the curse is removed. Remove Curse can end an acquired curse. A natural-born lycanthrope needs Wish.
Raise Strength to 17 if lower. Boar and hybrid forms gain +1 AC from natural armor. Use Strength for Tusks attack and damage rolls. The Charge save DC is 8 + the character’s proficiency bonus + its Strength modifier.

gm.title: Nonhuman lycanthropes
lines: The printed blocks assume a human. For a lycanthrope of another ancestry, the DM can retain one or more traits from its humanoid form, such as Fey Ancestry for an elf.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 206–207 and 209. The player sidebar erratum clarifies curse eligibility. The profiles apply that limit to the curse-bearing attacks. Immunity wording follows the global errata.

gm.title: Lycanthrope encounter rules
lines:
Printed source. Lycanthrope, pp. 137 and 148.
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

gm.title: Lycanthrope encounter rules
lines:
Printed source. Lycanthrope, pp. 137 and 148.
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

gm.title: Player lycanthropy
lines:
A character keeps its own statistics except for the changes listed here. It gains the printed nonhumanoid speeds, damage immunities, traits, and actions that require no equipment, plus proficiency with the lycanthrope's natural attacks. Use the listed natural weapon damage. The character cannot speak in animal form.
Only a humanoid that is not already a lycanthrope saves against the curse when hit by a curse-bearing attack. The Constitution save DC is 8 + the attacking lycanthrope's proficiency bonus + its Constitution modifier. A character who resists the curse keeps their usual alignment and personality in humanoid form. The full moon forces them into animal or hybrid form until it wanes. A character who embraces the curse acquires the lycanthrope's alignment and can eventually learn to shift at will. The DM can take control of the character until the curse is removed. Remove Curse can end an acquired curse. A natural-born lycanthrope needs Wish.
Raise Strength to 17 if lower. Use Strength for natural weapon attack and damage rolls. The Pounce save DC is 8 + the character’s proficiency bonus + its Strength modifier.

gm.title: Nonhuman lycanthropes
lines: The printed blocks assume a human. For a lycanthrope of another ancestry, the DM can retain one or more traits from its humanoid form, such as Fey Ancestry for an elf.

lines: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 206–207 and 210. The player sidebar erratum clarifies curse eligibility. The profiles apply that limit to the curse-bearing attacks. Immunity wording follows the global errata.

gm.title: Description
lines: White abishais are reckless shock troops in Tiamat's armies.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not interfere with the abishai's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Reckless. At the start of its turn, it can give itself advantage on melee weapon attack rolls for that turn. If it does, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, and one Longsword attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) force damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage when wielded with two hands.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Vicious Reprisal. When the abishai takes damage, it makes one Bite attack against a randomly selected creature within 5 ft. If nobody is within reach, it moves up to half its speed toward an enemy it can see. That movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

lines: This white dragon's hoard sustains it, and its breath and mythic flare both deal cold damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Chromatic Awakening (recharges after a short or long rest). When the creature would drop to 0 HP, set its current HP to 425, recharge Breath Weapon, and restore all spent uses of Legendary Resistance. The creature can take mythic actions for the following hour. Award 105,000 extra XP if defeated after this trait activates (210,000 XP total).
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Unusual Nature. The greatwyrm needs no food or drink.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 20) and restrained until the grapple ends. The greatwyrm can hold only one creature with this attack at a time.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 26 Strength save or fall prone.
Breath Weapon (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 26 Dexterity save, taking 78 (12d12) cold damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has 3 legendary actions. It can take one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw or Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity save or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.
Arcane Spear (3 actions). Create four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature the greatwyrm chooses and can see within 120 ft., dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage before disappearing.

gm.title: Mythic actions
lines:
For 1 hour after Chromatic Awakening activates, the greatwyrm can spend legendary actions on these options.
Bite (1 action). Make one Bite attack.
Chromatic Flare (2 actions). Each creature in a 60-ft.-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity save or take 22 (5d8) cold damage.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dancing light that reaches Cerilia just ahead of an opening Shadow World portal. It draws vitality from the living before the portal pulls it back.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Tiny to Small floating creature. Chaotic neutral.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Rare in Cerilia and the Shadow World. Solitary, appearing 1d3. Active at night in Cerilia or any time in the Shadow World. Feeds on Cerilian life energy. High intelligence 13–14. Treasure Q. Size 1–4 ft. across. Morale 15–16. No bloodline, blood abilities, or Perception. Seeming lesser.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Life drain. One touch for 2d8 damage to a Cerilian creature. It feeds on that loss without adding the damage to its own HP. A non-Cerilian takes a 1d8 burn instead and provides no nourishment.

gm.title: Feeding near the portal
lines: When Cerilian characters are within a quarter mile, there is a 50% chance the creature feeds on their life energy rather than the surroundings. Affected Cerilians save vs. poison or take 2d6 damage. When Cerilians are on the Shadow World side of a portal about to open and a will o’Shadow is present, make that save with a 1-point penalty. It is normally invisible on that side of the portal.

gm.title: Defenses and tactics
lines: Mundane weapon blows deal normal damage. Detect invisibility and shadow magic are the only magic specifically noted as effective. Magical light makes the creature invisible until the light goes out. Its lesser Seeming can camouflage it with blur, color spray, dancing lights, or hypnotic pattern. It usually avoids direct combat, attacks to replace lost energy when provoked, and tries to flee at 5 HP or fewer.

gm.title: Portal clues
lines: One to three lights can precede a portal by 1 minute to 3 hours. A larger light means it is closer to opening. Nearby vegetation may stay wilted for 1d4 days per round the portal was open. The lights communicate with one another through their movement.

gm.title: Description
lines: The lights above Hither’s wells are drowned spirits. They will help travelers who promise to oppose Bavlorna, whose flood killed them.

gm.title: Languages
lines: The languages it knew in life.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid, cold, fire, necrotic, and thunder. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Ephemeral. It cannot carry or wear anything.
Incorporeal Movement. It moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Ending its turn in an object deals it 5 (1d10) force damage.
Variable Illumination. Choose a radius from 5 to 20 ft. It sheds bright light within that radius and dim light for the same distance beyond it. It can change the radius as a bonus action.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Shock. Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Invisibility. The spirit and its light become invisible until it attacks, uses Consume Life, or stops concentrating as if on a spell.
Magic Boon (recharges after a long rest). Grant a boon to one visible creature within 5 ft. that is not undead. Once within the next 24 hours, the recipient can roll a d4 and add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. A creature can hold only one such boon at a time.

lines: The entrance seals 1 round after the coffin is opened if the illusory sunlight strikes its plaque. Dispel Magic on the light prevents the trigger. Apply underwater combat with 5 ft. of visibility. Water breathing gives no protection against drowning in wine. The block rises and the wine drains after 10 minutes.

lines:

lines: Kraul. Understands Common but cannot speak it.

lines:

gm.title: Description
lines: This flying lion is one of the usual mounts of a Theran archon. Stories tell of the archon and its lion moving as if they share a mind.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Pounce. When the lion moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature, then hits it with Claw on the same turn, the target must pass a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the lion can Bite it once as a bonus action.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

gm.title: Archon riders
lines: Archon of Falling Stars and Ashen Rider are two Theran archons that can ride a winged lion.

gm.title: Description
lines: A small flying construct used as an Orzhov messenger and spy. It often imitates the mannerisms of its master.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Construct Nature. The thrull needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Self-Sacrifice. After an attack hits a creature within 5 ft. of the thrull, it swaps places with that creature and takes the hit instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: Winter eladrin embody sorrow. Their tears freeze on their faces, and the cold around them reflects their grief.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Sorrowful Presence. A non-eladrin creature starting its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure it is charmed by the eladrin for 1 minute, with disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws while charmed this way. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever this eladrin damages it, ending the effect on a success. When the creature succeeds or the effect ends, it gains immunity to any eladrin's Sorrowful Presence for 24 hours.

gm.title: Changeable Natures mechanics
lines: After finishing a long rest, an eladrin that is not incapacitated can adopt another season's stat block. Carry over its damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Longbow. The eladrin can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) slashing damage, or 5 (1d10) slashing damage with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and 13 (3d8) cold damage.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Sleet Storm.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). The eladrin teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see, bringing any gear it wears or carries.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Frigid Rebuke. When a creature the eladrin can see within 60 ft. damages it, force that creature to make a DC 16 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 11 (2d10) cold damage.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 117.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). The wolf exhales a blast of freezing wind in a 15-foot cone. lines: Carnival workers wear artificial butterfly wings with their working clothes or stage costumes.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Small or Medium Humanoid, any alignment

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Skills Sleight Of Hand +6. Passive Perception 11. Languages: Common plus any one language.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Secret Expertise. Choose one extra skill for the hand from Acrobatics +6, Animal Handling +5, Arcana +5, Athletics +4, Medicine +5, or Performance +5.

gm.title: Size and hit points
lines: A Medium hand has 9 HP (2d8). A Small hand has 7 HP (2d6). Both have a speed of 30 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Pixie Dust (1/day). The hand sprinkles dust on itself or another visible creature within 5 ft. The recipient gains a fly speed of 30 ft. for 1 minute. If still airborne when it ends, the recipient drops safely and lands on its feet.

gm.title: Encounters
lines: The carnival's hands run stalls, repair equipment, and tend animals. Staff wear imitation butterfly wings on duty. If guests are caught fighting or stealing, 1d6 chaotic good hands escort them out and the carnival's mood drops by one step.

lines: Once an Omuan engineer called Gorra, Withers now maintains Acererak’s tomb. He questions trespassers about the outside world before trying to kill them.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Any languages he knew in life.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, roll attacks and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks with disadvantage.
Special Equipment. He wears the Amulet of the Black Skull. It holds 6 charges and regains 1d6 at dawn. As an action, spend a charge to teleport himself and his gear to a familiar spot within 100 ft. on the same plane, even through the tomb’s normal restrictions. Withers is Undead, so he does not roll the item’s transformation save.
Undead Nature. It does not require air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks. One may be replaced with Life Drain.
Life Drain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, reduce the target’s hit point maximum by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if the reduction leaves it with a maximum of 0. A Humanoid killed by this attack rises as a Zombie under the attacker’s control 24 hours later unless restored to life or its body is destroyed. Up to twelve Zombies can be controlled at a time.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) if wielded in two hands.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
9th-level wizard. Intelligence, spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks.
At will: Acid Splash, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots): Detect Magic, Expeditious Retreat, Feather Fall, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots): Darkness, Hold Person, Rope Trick.
3rd level (3 slots): Dispel Magic, Lightning Bolt.
4th level (3 slots): Blight, Wall of Fire.
5th level (1 slot): Telekinesis.

gm.title: Office encounter
lines: Seven Crawling Claws follow his commands in area 28. When pressed, he uses magic to retreat and Wall of Fire to cut off pursuit. His journals record the arrival of the Atropal and the building of the Soulmonger.

gm.title: Base stat block
lines: The adventure uses the 2014 Wight. Withers gains the printed Intelligence, CR, amulet, and Spellcasting changes and does not carry a longbow.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: An Abyssal archer with dark segmented skin and an organic recurve bow fused to one limb.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium Fiend (Demon, Category 4), typically chaotic evil

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Dex +10, Wis +8, Cha +8. Deception +8, Intimidation +8, Perception +8. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 18. Abyssal and Common. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Despair Bolt attacks.
Despair Bolt. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 150/600 ft., one creature. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The wobalas can spend 1 soul to leave the target Frightened of it for 1 minute. If the target is immune to Frightened, the wobalas gets that soul back.
Banishing Touch. Melee spell attack +8, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 22 (4d10) psychic damage and teleport the target up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the wobalas can see.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Flee, Mortal (1 soul). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On failure, if it has a reaction available, it uses it to move its speed directly away from the wobalas, taking the shortest route regardless of danger. A creature that cannot become Frightened succeeds automatically.

gm.title: MCDM demon soul rules
lines:
Soul count. Use the printed starting total or roll the listed dice. Souls spent on a feature are deducted from the total. A demon can accumulate souls without a maximum.
Soul Devourer. When the demon drops a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, the demon consumes its soul, adds 1 to its soul count, and the creature dies. Only Wish can restore it to life.
Lethe. At 0 souls, the demon has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on saving throws, and its Intelligence is 3. On each turn it must use its movement to get as close as possible to the nearest creature it senses with Soulsight. If able, it must then use its action to attack that creature and attempt to kill it. It can pursue no other goal until its soul count rises.
Soulsight. Within the creature’s listed radius, it perceives creatures other than Constructs and Undead. This counts as seeing them for its features. Physical objects, total cover, and supernatural effects do not block this sense unless a rule says they do.

gm.title: Description
lines: A wolfwere masquerades as a traveler or minstrel. Its song slows victims before it takes hybrid form and attacks.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +5. AC components +1 Dex and +6 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 16. Base attack +3, grapple +5. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +5. Statistics are for the hybrid form.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack and full attack as printed. Bite +5 melee (1d6 + 3) and longsword +3 melee (1d8 + 1), or composite shortbow +4 ranged (1d6).
Song of Weariness (Su). Creatures within 90 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or are slowed for 1d4 + 4 rounds as slow at caster level 6. Success gives one day of protection from the same wolfwere’s song. The song is sonic and mind-affecting.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 10/cold iron, darkvision 60 ft., SR 13. Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, assume dire wolf or Small or Medium humanoid form indefinitely as polymorph. It retains supernatural abilities in humanoid form. It speaks Sylvan and the local domain language.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +6, Diplomacy +6, Disguise +6, Hide +5, Listen +5, Move Silently +5, Perform (string instruments) +6, Spot +5. Combat Reflexes, Combat Expertise, Improved Initiative, Multiattack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land and underground. Solitary, pair, or troupe of 2–5 wolfweres and 2d8 wolves. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure. Advancement by class. Level adjustment +4.

gm.title: Greater wolfwere
lines:
CR 7. Large Animal (Augmented Animal, Shapechanger). 60 HP and 8d8 + 10 as printed. Initiative +4, speed 50 ft., AC 18 (−1 size, +9 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 18. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +9, Ref +6, Will +8. Str 23, Dex 10, Con 17, Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 16. The printed table omits base attack and grapple. For play, +6/+16 derives from 8 animal HD, size, and Strength.
Attack and full attack as printed. Bite +11 melee (1d8 + 6) and two claws +9 melee (1d6 + 3), or composite shortbow +5 ranged (1d6). In wolf-man form the prose instead pairs the bite with a melee weapon and gives the weapon the claws’ stated +3 attack bonus.
Song of Weariness. Will DC 17 within 90 ft. or slowed 1d6 + 4 rounds at caster level 8. Success gives immunity to the same singer for one day. Lupine Allies (Su). Once per day as a standard action, howl to call 4d6 wolves or 2d6 dire wolves. They arrive in 2d6 rounds, serve for up to 1 hour, and gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls.
Alternate Form as above. DR 10/cold iron, darkvision 60 ft., SR 21, regeneration 10. Fire and acid deal normal damage. Lost limbs do not regrow.
Bluff +7, Diplomacy +7, Disguise +6, Handle Animal +6, Hide −2, Intimidate +7, Listen +7, Move Silently +3, Perform (wind instruments) +7, Spot +7. Alertness, Combat Expertise, Improved Initiative, Multiattack, Power Attack. Temperate forest. Solitary, pair, gang of 3–5, or troupe with one greater wolfwere, 2d4 wolfweres, 1d6 dire wolves, and 3d6 wolves. Always neutral evil. Standard treasure, advancement by class, level adjustment +11.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The greater wolfwere’s listed 60 HP and 8d8 + 10 are retained even though its listed Constitution would usually modify the dice differently. Its written weapon routine is separate from the printed bite-and-claw routine.

lines: A wood woad houses a mortal soul in a body of bark and protects the place or people entrusted to it. After the rite binds its soul to a tree, it sprouts from the tree's roots on the third day.

Tree Stride. Once on each of its turns, the woad can spend 10 ft. of movement to enter a living tree magically within 5 ft. It appears in an empty space within 5 ft. of a second living tree it can see within 60 ft. of itself. Both trees must be Large or larger.

gm.title: Description
lines: This massive worm gathers secrets and hires bodyguards to enforce its bargains. In a fight it can roll over opponents and crush their equipment.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Very rare in hot climates. Omnivore. Exceptional intelligence (15–16). Treasure A, D. Fanatic morale (17–18). Length 30–45 feet. One wurmling per encounter, with at least 1d4 trusted guards and sometimes up to 4d10. Its wider organization usually has 100–200 retainers.

gm.title: Hit Dice, THAC0 and XP
lines:
10 HD: THAC0 11.
11–12 HD: THAC0 9.
13–14 HD: THAC0 7.
15 HD: THAC0 5.
Start at 5,000 XP for 10 HD, then add 1,000 XP per additional HD.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite and tail. Bite for 2d8 and lash with the tail for 1d8. Treat its Strength as 20 when grabbing or holding something.
Roll over. With enough room, it can roll onto up to three human-sized or smaller targets. Save vs. paralysis to avoid it. On failure, take 1d4 damage per wurmling Hit Die. It can remain on top for the same damage each subsequent round. On a failed initial save, each of the victim’s possessions must save vs. crushing blow or be destroyed.

gm.title: Defenses
lines: Magic resistance 2% per HD. Immune to scarlet pimpernel hallucinations and mood-altering abilities or proficiencies such as fast talk, intimidation, and bardic charm. Add +3 to saves against mind-altering spells and mind-affecting Legacies.

gm.title: Skills and Red Curse
lines: As a thief of level equal to its HD, it can open locks, find and remove traps, move silently, hear noise, and read languages. It knows one spoken language per 2 HD. It has legend lore and local history, plus information-related nonweapon proficiencies as a thief of the same level. Gain Legacies as an Inheritor of level equal to HD. A 10 HD specimen has five Legacies, a 12 HD specimen has six, and a 15 HD specimen has seven. The first needs no crimson essence. Later Legacies need crimson essence to activate at acquisition and stay permanently. It needs cinnabryl to maintain them. Typical choices are Anti-Poison, Crimson Fire, Digging, Farsight, Red Shield, Shape Stone, and Temperature, or choices suited to Eusdria.

gm.title: Mystic connection
lines: Acid-Enhanced. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can spend a bonus action once per long rest to exude acid from their hands for 1 minute. Their melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d8 acid damage during this time.

gm.title: MCDM companion rules
lines:
Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.
Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.
Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

lines:

Failure deals 16 (3d10) thunder damage and prevents casting until the end of the creature's turn. It keeps its spell slot and action.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Voice of Reverence. Choose creatures within 60 ft. Each falls Prone on a failed DC 20 Wisdom save and takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage if it stands before the end of Xaantikorijek's next turn.
2. Fulguration. Until the end of his next turn, he turns into lightning. During this time he resists all damage, fits through 1-inch gaps without squeezing, can move through creatures' spaces, and provokes no opportunity attacks. The first time he enters a creature's space each turn, that creature takes 16 (3d10) lightning damage.
3. Voice of the Ages. Enemies within 60 ft. who hear him make DC 20 Wisdom saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) psychic damage, knocks the target Prone, and prevents it from standing for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the other effects.

gm.title: Description
lines: This living storm is the second form of Goxomoc. Defeating it returns the titan to his resting place.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Saving throws Int +15, Wis +17. Arcana +15, History +15, Perception +17. Immune to lightning, poison, and thunder, to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks, and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Paralyzed, Petrified, Restrained, and Stunned. Truesight 300 ft., passive Perception 27. Understands all languages but cannot speak. Telepathy 150 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. Pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
Discorporation. At 0 HP or death, end all conditions and other effects on him. He teleports to his resting place, returns to his Goxomoc form at full HP, and falls Unconscious.
Disruptive Resistance (3/day). Turn his failed save into a success. Lightning Aura shuts off until the end of his next turn.
Lightning Aura. A creature starting its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage or half on a success.
Power of the Storm. His lightning and thunder damage ignores resistance.
Siege Monster. He deals double damage to objects and structures.
Supernatural Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Strike attacks.
Lightning Strike. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +19 to hit, 15-ft. reach or 600-ft. range, one target. Hit 29 (3d12 + 10) lightning damage. A second target within 30 ft. of the first takes the same damage on a failed DC 27 Dexterity save.
Energy Flow. Move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. He can pass through creature spaces without treating them as difficult terrain. Each creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage the first time he crosses its space during this move.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make DC 27 Dexterity saves. On a failure, take 71 (11d12) lightning damage and lose reactions until the end of their next turn. On a success, take half damage only.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Gone in a Flash. Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space he sees, bringing anyone inside him. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space he left makes a DC 25 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage or half on a success.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shock Cage. When a creature he sees within 30 ft. hits him with an attack, that creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Thunderstruck. Creatures within 120 ft. that hear him make DC 25 Wisdom saves. Those who fail are Dazed for 1 minute and repeat the save at the end of their turns.
2. Into the Storm. Enemies he sees within 30 ft. make DC 25 Strength saves. On a success, they take 16 (3d10) lightning damage. On a failure, they are pulled inside him. There, they are Restrained, move with him, and have total cover from outside attacks and other effects. At the start of each of their turns they take 16 (3d10) lightning plus 16 (3d10) thunder damage. Each can escape into an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. by using an action to pass a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If he takes at least 60 damage in a single turn or falls to 0 HP, all trapped creatures are expelled to unoccupied spaces of their choice within 5 ft.
3. Behold True Power. Enemies within 120 ft. make DC 25 Strength saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) lightning damage and moves them up to 60 ft. in any direction. A success halves the damage and keeps the target in place.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

gm.title: Flanked (MCDM)
lines: If using flanking rules, creatures cannot flank this creature.

gm.title: Mundane Attacks (MCDM)
lines: A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: The Tyract is an armored vaurath with a massive central eye and eight detached psionic eyes.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +9. Arcana +9, Deception +9, Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 17. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Painful Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Xorannox can succeed by destroying one of his eight floating eyes, chosen randomly with a d8. He grows a new eye to replace it 24 hours later.
Eyes Always Shielded. The eyes retain their psionic shields even after using Eye Psionics.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Psionics. Use three different effects from the floating eyes. No effect can be used twice on the same turn. Except where an effect specifies otherwise, each targets one creature Xorannox can see within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. DC 17 Wisdom save or Charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour. The charm ends if he harms the target or one of the target’s allies.
Compulsion Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save or the target uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed toward its closest visible ally and make a weapon attack against that ally. Creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.
Memory Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save. On a failure, the target expends an available spell slot of its highest remaining level with no effect. A target with no slots left loses proficiency with one weapon it holds or carries for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end that loss early.
Toxic Vapors. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. All creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end the effect early.
Telekinetic Field. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy within 10 ft. of it makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, Xorannox moves the enemy up to 30 ft. in any direction and deals 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of that movement. He can also move an object in the area up to 30 ft. in any direction if it weighs 300 pounds or less and is neither worn nor carried. He can manipulate the object precisely.
Lightning Bolt. Creatures in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Explosion. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Necrosis Beam. DC 17 Constitution save or the target takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage immediately and loses 7 (2d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. A target reduced to 0 HP by this effect dies. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or loses sight of the target. He cannot use the beam again while that effect lasts.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). Xorannox projects a 150-ft. cone. For Xorannox and each creature in the cone affected by a spell, that spell’s effects end immediately for that creature.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Cower! When an attacker hits Xorannox, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Frightened of him for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each option is available once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
Disruption Beams. Choose three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage whenever it makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell of 1st level or higher. The effect lasts 1 minute, and each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end it early.
Disappearing Act. Xorannox becomes Invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.
Megabeam. In a 120-ft. line, 20 ft. wide, each creature saves against two random Eye Psionics effects from Xorannox’s remaining eyes. Reroll duplicates for each creature. Effects that normally cover an area affect only that individual creature.

lines:

Slime Shower. One enemy within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it becomes vulnerable to fire and lightning damage until it takes either type of damage or initiative count 20 ends next round, whichever comes first.
Telekinetic Hold. Choose three enemies within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the enemy’s speed becomes 0 and it rises straight up 20 ft. It falls at the end of initiative count 20 next round.

gm.title: Description
lines: Yagnoloths negotiate contracts for other yugoloths. They sign contracts with their smaller arm and use the other to fight.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Magic Resistance. The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Electrified Touch attack and one Massive Arm attack, or make one Massive Arm attack and use either Battlefield Cunning (if available) or Teleport.
Electrified Touch. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage.
Massive Arm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d12 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or be stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.
Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4–6). Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 ft. that can hear the yagnoloth can each use a reaction for one melee attack.
Life Leech. Touch one incapacitated creature within 15 ft. It takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. On a failed DC 16 Constitution save, the target's hit point maximum falls by half the necrotic damage it took. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. A creature whose maximum falls to 0 dies.
Teleport. The yagnoloth and any equipment it wears or carries teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
3/day. Lightning Bolt.

gm.title: Description
lines: The demon lord known as the Beast of Butchery carries the Butcher, a three-headed flail he can summon to his hand. His lair, the Death Dells, is a hunting ground in the Abyss.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Yeenoghu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (2d12 + 9) force damage. On his turn, Yeenoghu can add one effect to a hit. He can use each effect only once per turn.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) acid damage.

gm.title: Flail effects mechanics
lines:
Confusion. On a failed DC 17 Wisdom save, the target is affected by Confusion until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
Force. The target takes 13 (2d12) extra force damage.
Paralysis. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save, the target is paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 17). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Invisibility.
1/day. Teleport.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Rampage. When Yeenoghu reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, he can move up to half his speed and make one Bite attack.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Yeenoghu has 3 legendary actions. Use one option, paying its listed cost, at the end of another creature's turn. He regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn. He cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using them.
Charge (1 action). Move up to his speed.
Swat Away (1 action). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, the target must pass a DC 24 Strength save or be pushed up to 15 ft. straight away from Yeenoghu. If it fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone.
Savage (2 actions). Make a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 ft.

gm.title: Lair
lines: When encountered in his lair in the Death Dells, Yeenoghu is CR 25 (75,000 XP).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied on that count, Yeenoghu can choose one option. He cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row.
Incite the Pack. Until the next initiative count 20, gnolls and hyenas in the lair have advantage on melee weapon attack rolls, and attack rolls against them have advantage.
Iron Spike. An iron spike 5 ft. tall and 1 inch wide erupts from a point on the ground Yeenoghu can see within 100 ft. A creature in that space makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is restrained on the spike. A creature can use its action to free itself or another creature within reach, ending the restraint.
Pack Rush. Each gnoll or hyena Yeenoghu can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or both effects around Yeenoghu’s lair.
Savage Predators. Predatory Beasts within 6 miles of the lair kill far more prey than they need and leave the carcasses to rot.
Spiky Terrain. Large iron spikes grow from the ground and stone surfaces within 1 mile of the lair. Yeenoghu mounts the bodies of his victims on them.
If Yeenoghu dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.

lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 270.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Gnoll Lord hunts captives across the Death Dells with gnolls and hyenas. He calls his three-headed flail the Butcher and can summon it into his hand at will.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Yeenoghu uses Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Invisibility.
1/day. Teleport.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Yeenoghu can choose to succeed on a failed saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Rampage. After reducing a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on his turn, Yeenoghu can use a bonus action to move up to half his speed and make one Bite attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks. After each hit, Yeenoghu may choose or roll for one extra effect below. Each effect can apply only once per Multiattack.
1. Deal another 13 (2d12) bludgeoning damage.
2. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it is paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
3. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it suffers the effects of Confusion until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (1d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Yeenoghu has 3 legendary actions. He can use one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of his turn.
Charge (1 action). Move up to his speed.
Swat Away (1 action). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, the target makes a DC 24 Strength save. On a failure, it is pushed 15 ft. directly away from Yeenoghu. If the save fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone.
Savage (2 actions). Make a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 ft.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one effect. Yeenoghu cannot repeat the same effect in consecutive rounds.
Iron Spike. A spike 5 ft. tall and 1 inch wide rises from a point on the ground Yeenoghu can see within 100 ft. Each creature in that space makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is restrained by the spike. A creature can use an action to pull itself or a creature it can reach off the spike, ending the restraint.
Pack Rush. Every gnoll or hyena Yeenoghu can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.
Enrage the Pack. Until the next initiative count 20, all gnolls and hyenas in the lair have advantage on melee weapon attack rolls. Attack rolls against them also have advantage.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
Iron spikes grow from ground and stone within 1 mile. Yeenoghu uses them to display bodies.
Predatory beasts within 6 miles kill far more than they need to eat and leave the carcasses to rot.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or roll on the Madness of Yeenoghu table. A successful save grants 24 hours of immunity to this effect.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Yeenoghu dies.

gm.title: Madness of Yeenoghu
lines:
Roll d100 when a creature goes mad in the lair or in Yeenoghu's line of sight. The resulting flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. Feeds on others' anger and tries to whip up a mob.
21–40. Craves the flesh of other intelligent creatures.
41–60. Rejects laws and customs in favor of a more primitive way of life.
61–80. Starts fights in the hope that someone will die.
81–100. Makes ornaments from trophies taken from the dead.

gm.title: Source notes
lines: Page 155 lists Constitution 23 with a +8 modifier and Intelligence 15 with a +3 modifier. Under the standard ability rules the scores yield +6 and +2. The printed scores, listed saving throws, and hit points are preserved here.

lines:

Unless the bulb is destroyed, the corpse becomes a Yellow Musk Zombie 24 hours after death. Raising the humanoid, casting Remove Curse on the corpse, or using similar magic destroys the bulb if done before it animates.
Yellow Musk (3/day). All humanoids within 30 ft. make a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure they are charmed for 1 minute and spend their turns moving as close to the creeper as they can, doing nothing else. They can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect.

gm.title: Hosts

gm.title: Wilderness encounter
lines: Place the creeper deep in a ruin and give it 3d6 Yellow Musk Zombies, scattered or clustered to suit the terrain. At camp, the zombies emerge from a nearby ruin and try to knock the characters unconscious and drag them to the plant.
