lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human and Incarnum subtypes. No racial ability score adjustments. Base land speed 30 ft. The Human subtype makes Azurins count as human for applicable effects. The Incarnum subtype supplies no shared abilities or defenses.

The racial essentia pool increases permanently by 1. This creates a pool of 1 if the character has no other source. An essentia pool supplies points to invest in eligible feats, soulmelds, and abilities.

Normal capacity per investment is 1 at levels 1–5, 2 at 6–11, 3 at 12–17, and 4 at 18–20. Soulmeld investments can be reallocated as a swift action. Incarnum feat investments are normally set once per day and locked for 24 hours.

lines: Twelve-level monster class. Starts with +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Goblin, Infernal, and Worg. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Barghest.

Minor Change Shape (Su) is an at-will full-round action that physically alters the Changeling’s body, including facial features, skin color and texture, and size within the limits of disguise self. Clothing and possessions keep their appearance.

Within the disguise self limits, height can vary by up to 1 ft. and build can vary while keeping the same basic body plan. The new appearance retains the Changeling’s game traits. Wizards’ 3.5 FAQ gives the appearance of a Warforged as an example.
Minor Change Shape grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to create a disguise. The form lasts until another change. True seeing reveals the natural form, and death restores it.
In this printing, Changelings can copy a dragonmark’s appearance. Their ancestry does not develop dragonmarks or confer their powers.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Constitution +1 and darkvision 60 ft. Choose a heritage for size, speed and added traits.

Imperfect Undeath. Humanoid affected by effects that specifically target undead. Normal healing works. Ordinary resurrection returns a Darakhul. True Resurrection or Wish can return the original living form.

Hunger for Flesh. Eat 1 lb. of raw meat every 24 hours or gain one exhaustion level. While hunger exhaustion remains, healing and recovery from exhaustion are blocked until spending at least an hour eating 10 lb. of raw meat.

Powerful Jaw. Bite unarmed strike for 1d4 + Strength modifier piercing. Sunlight Sensitivity gives disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception if the character, target or subject is in direct sunlight.

Undead Resilience gives necrotic and poison resistance, disease immunity and advantage on saves against charm or poison. A short rest removes one exhaustion level if at least 1 lb. of raw meat was eaten within 24 hours, subject to Hunger for Flesh.
Undead Vitality. No breathing. Six hours of semiconscious dormancy give the sleep benefit of eight human hours. Perception checks during dormancy have disadvantage.

Common heritage rules grant Darakhul, Umbral and the heritage language. Bearfolk Heritage adds Strength +2 and Common for a mortal-land origin or Umbral for a Shadow Realm origin. Medium, speed 30 ft. Jaws of Death raises bite damage to 1d6 + Strength. Undead Fortitude lets a survivor of a drop to 0 HP drop to 1 instead once per long rest.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid (Darfellan). +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity. Land speed 20 ft., swim speed 40 ft. LA +0 and advancement by character class.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.

Hold Breath (Ex) allows 8 × Constitution score rounds. A standard action uses one extra round of that budget. When it runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and rising by 1 per previous check. A failed check starts drowning. Darfellans breathe air.

Natural bite deals 1d6. When the bite is the sole primary natural weapon, add 1½ times the Strength bonus. An armed full attack can add one secondary bite at −5 to the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage. Extra attacks from base attack bonus apply only to the primary weapon.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.
Darfellan is automatic. Aquan and Common are bonus languages. Favored class Barbarian.
Page 144 adds a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks with marine mammals in its combat text. The p. 37 and p. 144 player trait lists omit this bonus.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Apply Elf; add +1 Charisma and expand darkvision to 120 feet.
Sunlight sensitivity affects attacks and sight-based Perception. Gain rapier, shortsword, and hand crossbow proficiency.
Dancing lights at will; faerie fire at level 3 and darkness at level 5, each once per long rest. Spellcasting uses Charisma.

lines: Medium human subrace. +2 Intelligence and −2 Dexterity. Land speed 30 ft. No racial Hit Dice or positive level adjustment listed.
Low-light vision doubles human sight distance in poor illumination and preserves color and detail.

Spell Clutch (Su). Once per day, use a standard action to prepare again one 1st-level spell you previously prepared and cast. Cast the spell separately when needed. The supernatural activation does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Common and Roushoum are automatic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Terran, and Undercommon, or by region. The Deep Imaskar region lists Abyssal, Aquan, Celestial, Draconic, Terran, and Undercommon. Favored class Wizard.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +6 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, Will +3, and one feat. Maximize the first racial die and roll later dice, including the first class die.
Racial skill points are five times (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1). Racial class skills are Climb, Intimidate, Jump, Listen, Sense Motive, and Spot.

Primary horn deals 1d6 plus Strength and has a ×3 critical. Two secondary claws deal 1d4 plus half the Strength bonus each and take −5 to hit. A weapon full attack can add one secondary horn or one secondary claw.
Goblin, Undercommon, and Common are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 6 before class levels.
This is the March 2003 player profile. The later 3.5 conversion of the encounter monster lists Humanoid (Goblinoid), LA +3, and an alternate attack routine.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Monstrous Humanoid. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. from the creature type. +2 natural armor.
+4 Dexterity and +2 Constitution, derived from the Monster Manual’s sample ability scores. Apply the Wisdom and Charisma adjustments from Madness separately.

Madness (Ex) gives −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma, uses Charisma in place of Wisdom on Will saves, and grants immunity to confusion and insanity effects. Miracle or wish can restore sanity, reversing those ability adjustments and ending the trait.
Vulnerability to Sunlight (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage per hour in sunlight. Constitution 0 is fatal. Recover 1 point per 24 hours spent underground or otherwise sheltered from sunlight.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Racial spell-like abilities, CL 3. At will, darkness and ghost sound. Once per day each, daze and sound burst. Save DCs use Charisma.
Racial Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits under the Rogue rules. Poison Use (Ex) protects the derro from accidentally poisoning itself while handling poison.
Three racial Hit Dice (3d8) grant BAB +3, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +3, and two feats. Favored class Sorcerer.

Underdark lists LA +1 and ECL 4. Its adventurer section includes derro with Madness, which this profile retains. The Monster Manual lists LA +2 specifically for a sane derro, giving ECL 5 before class levels under that rule.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider with the Native and Chaotic subtypes. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and no racial ability score adjustments. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice. LA +1.
Gain +2 racial on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects. The Chaotic subtype counts for alignment-dependent effects, and attacks overcome damage reduction as chaotic-aligned.
Gain +2 racial on Intimidate against animals and humanoids. Take −2 on Diplomacy, Handle Animal, Perform, and Sense Motive.
Weapon Familiarity treats the trident as a simple weapon.

The tail is a secondary natural attack at −5, with 1d4 base damage. Its injury poison takes a Fortitude save at DC 10 + half total HD, rounded down, + Constitution modifier. The initial effect is sickened for 2d4 rounds. There is no secondary damage. The Compendium gives 3 + Constitution modifier doses per day.
A sickened creature takes −2 on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.

Automatic languages are Diabolan and Diaboli tail code. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Common, Draconic, and Infernal. The visual code takes about twice as long as speech. A viewer can recognize the use of a code with a DC 10 Intelligence check. Anyone can learn it, and only a tailed speaker can produce it.
Favored class Sorcerer. Bare, common, and hirsute Diaboli share the same rules.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +2 Constitution, −2 Dexterity, −2 Intelligence. Base land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Carapace gives +4 natural armor. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not affect Diopsids.
Bioluminescence can be lit or doused at will as a free action. It sheds light in a 10-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for 20 ft. beyond that.
Wings can be unfurled as an immediate action to descend at 60 ft. per round without falling damage. They grant no flight. A paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated Diopsid cannot use them.

Two strong primary arms and two weaker supporting arms. With the lower arms available for support, wield a weapon up to one size category larger without the normal size penalty. A Large longsword can be held by one primary arm and steadied by its matching lower arm.

Using all four hands, wield two two-handed weapons as a pair. Each gets full two-handed damage, including 1½ times a positive Strength modifier. Use the ordinary two-weapon attack penalties for a non-light off-hand weapon.

When a primary hand carries an item, an extra weapon used in a lower arm adds only half a positive Strength modifier. Each extra light weapon imposes −4 on all attacks, or −8 if the extra weapon is one-handed. The lower arms alone cannot wield a two-handed weapon. A lower-arm shield applies its armor check penalty to attacks and skill checks even if proficient.
Limb Symmetry waives the Dexterity prerequisite for feats with “two-weapon” in their name. Other prerequisites still apply. One free hand is enough for somatic components.

Light armor has no additional racial penalty. Medium armor imposes −2 Dexterity and heavy armor imposes −4 Dexterity. All armor must be custom-made and priced as one size larger. Diopsids do not need sleep and are immune to sleep effects.

Common and Diopsid are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarf (Dwarven), Orc, Terran, and Undercommon. The native language uses light signals, including darkvision-only flashes. Spot detects the exchange in place of Listen. Those without bioluminescence can learn to understand and translate it.
Favored class Barbarian. LA +1. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice.

player.title: Species traits
lines: +2 Intelligence and +1 Dexterity. Choose the appearance and size of the humanoid you were before the accident. You weigh one-quarter of your former weight and have a 30-ft. walking speed. The origin grants no other traits.

Fade Away. As an action, enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute. You can move, hear, and see in grayscale. The Material Plane and anything on it cannot affect you and you cannot affect them. End the effect early as a bonus action. On return, use the nearest unoccupied space to the point where you disappeared. Recharges on a long rest.
Planar Outcast. Cast feather fall on yourself once per day. At level 3, cast blur once per day. At level 5, cast blink once per day. Intelligence governs these spells.
Arcane Origins grants Arcana proficiency. Speak, read, and write two languages of your choice.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Thirteen-level monster class. Begins with +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, land speed 20 ft., perfect flight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and telepathy to 100 ft. with creatures that have a language. Speaks Auran, Celestial, Common, and Ignan. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Djinni.

Acid resistance starts at 5 at level 2, rising to 10 at 5th, 15 at 8th, 20 at 11th, and immunity at 13th. Air Mastery applies a −1 circumstance penalty to airborne foes' attack and damage rolls. Self-only invisibility is at will from level 3.
At level 4 gains a 1d4 slam that adds 1½ times the Strength bonus and uses iterative BAB attacks, plus whirlwind 1/day. Whirlwind rises to 3/day at level 8 and at will at level 12.

Plane shift begins at level 5 with two solo trips per day. Passenger capacity grows to one at level 7, three at level 10, and six at level 12 when plane shift becomes at will. Other daily spell-like powers arrive at 6th and 9th level. Their caster level is Hit Dice from class levels +13.
Flight reaches 60 ft. (perfect) at level 7. Large size with 10-ft. reach starts at level 9. Finishes at ECL 13, CR 5, 7d8 Hit Dice, BAB +7/+2, and base saves +5/+5/+5.

gm.title: Original NPC · Vessa Hallow

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium. +2 Intelligence and +2 Charisma. Speed 6 squares, normal vision, Common. Racial skill bonuses are +2 Bluff and +2 Insight.

Change Shape is an at-will Polymorph minor action. Assume the appearance of a Medium humanoid, including an individual you have seen. Your statistics and equipment stay the same. The form lasts until you change it or die. Someone challenging your impersonation of an individual rolls Insight against your Bluff with a +20 bonus to your roll.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Languages are Common and Draconic.
Use the 2014 dragonborn traits. This variant replaces the base ability increases and removes its ancestry damage resistance.
Ability scores increase by 2 Intelligence and 1 Charisma.
Forceful Presence. Take advantage on one Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check. It recharges on a short or long rest.
Choose an ancestry. For Dexterity saves, use a line for black, blue, brass, bronze and copper, or a cone for gold and red. Green, silver and white use a cone with a Constitution save.

Black and copper deal acid, blue and bronze deal lightning, brass, gold and red deal fire, green deals poison, and silver and white deal cold. The line is 5 ft. wide and 30 ft. long. The cone extends 15 ft.
Breath Weapon. Spend an action and use the area and save for your ancestry. The DC is 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus.
Damage is 2d6 at level 1, 3d6 at level 6, 4d6 at level 11 and 5d6 at level 16. A successful save halves it. Recharge on a short or long rest.

player.title: Species traits
lines: For the Rite of Rebirth, Bahamut calls a willing, non-evil subject of Intelligence 3 or higher. The rite takes 24 hours of fasting and meditation followed by 24 hours of sleep in a symbolic egg. The egg costs 100 gp and requires metallic dragon scales. An interruption restarts the rite.

Retain original type, subtypes, racial Hit Dice, racial ability adjustments, size, powerful build if present, base speed and other movement modes, languages already known, favored classes, and level adjustment. Add Dragonblood under the subtype rules, +2 Constitution, −2 Dexterity, Draconic, and favored class Fighter. Continue to count as the original race and as a dragon for race-related effects.

Other former racial traits go away, including racial bonus feats, extra racial skill points, and special movement perks such as a dwarf’s full armored speed. Remove lost bonus points from ranks. Recheck feat and prestige-class prerequisites. The rite permits one eligible feat swap for a first-level-only Dragonblood feat. Dragonborn Paladins may multiclass and later resume Paladin.

The dragonborn emerges as an adult and loses former age adjustments. The new middle, old, and venerable ages are 200, 300, and 400 years. Add 2d% to 400 years for maximum age. Gain +2 dodge AC against creatures of the Dragon type and immunity to dragons’ frightful presence. Choose one permanent aspect: Heart, Mind, or Wings.

Heart grants a line 5 ft. per Hit Die (maximum 100 ft.), usable once every 1d4 rounds. Damage is 1d8 plus 1d8 per three Hit Dice. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire each time. Reflex DC 10 + half Hit Dice, rounded down, + Constitution modifier halves damage.

Mind grants immunity to paralysis and magic sleep, low-light vision, darkvision 30 ft., and +2 racial to Listen, Search, and Spot. Darkvision reaches 60 ft. at 6 HD, 90 ft. at 9 HD, and 120 ft. at 12 HD. Low-light range rises to three times human at 9 HD and four times at 12 HD. Blindsense 30 ft. starts at 15 HD.

Wings grants +10 racial to Jump and gliding at 30 ft. with average maneuverability. Glide 20 ft. forward per 5 ft. descended and take no falling damage while gliding. No hovering or gliding with a medium or heavy load. If helpless or unconscious in midair, the wings cause a slow descent and reduce falling damage to 1d6.

Wings flight starts at 6 HD, 30 ft. with average maneuverability. Flight requires a light load and no fatigue or exhaustion. Fly safely for Constitution modifier rounds in a row (minimum 1). Extend a flight up to twice that safe duration and become fatigued at the end. More than 10 minutes of powered flight in a day also causes fatigue. Gliding can separate powered flights. Powered flight stops causing that fatigue at 12 HD.

While flying, a dive attack functions as a charge with at least 30 ft. of travel and 10 ft. of descent. The dive requires a piercing weapon and deals double damage on a hit. Running in flight requires a straight line.

lines: Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution and −2 Dexterity. Base land speed 20 ft., retained in medium or heavy armor and under a medium or heavy load.

Stonecunning gives +2 racial on Search checks for unusual stonework, including material disguised as stone. A Dream Dwarf who comes within 10 ft. of unusual stonework can make a Search check as if actively looking.
Stonecunning also lets the dwarf Search for stonework traps as a rogue can and estimate approximate depth underground.
Weapon Familiarity treats dwarven waraxes and dwarven urgroshes as martial weapons.

lines: A Small Monstrous Humanoid with the Psionic subtype. Charisma +2, Strength −2, Wisdom −2. Base land speed 20 ft. and darkvision 60 ft. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person do not apply.

Racial Energy Ray is a psi-like ability usable once per day. It matches the caste’s energy resistance. Manifester level equals half the character’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum 1. It costs no power points and automatically augments to that manifester level.

Scent reaches 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double that distance and overpowering odors triple it. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., scent pinpoints the source.

lines: Medium Fey with the Incarnum subtype. +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence. Base land speed 30 ft. Low-light vision doubles human range with color and detail.

The Incarnum subtype marks eligibility for targeted effects. The permanent racial essentia pool increases by 1, or starts at 1 if the character has no other source.

Each invested point gives a +10-ft. enhancement bonus to base land speed with up to medium armor and a medium load. Each point also gives +2 insight on initiative checks, regardless of armor or load. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.

The optional d10 Barbarian substitutions at 7th and 11th level grant Incarnum Defense and Incarnum Rage respectively. Defense replaces Barbarian damage reduction and gives DR 1/— plus resistance 1 to each energy type per point. Incarnum Rage replaces Greater Rage and grants 2 essentia during rage. player.title: Species traits
lines: A Dvati character has two identical bodies sharing one soul. Each is a Medium Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and darkvision 60 ft. The species has no racial ability adjustments or racial Hit Dice. LA +1 applies to the one character.

Both twins use the same level, classes, feats, skill ranks, and XP total. The pair counts as one PC for XP. The two bodies move and act separately, within the restrictions on their shared abilities and spellcasting.

Roll each Hit Die once. Each twin adds half the die result and the full Constitution modifier to their own hit points. Track damage and healing on each body. Both save and take damage separately when caught in an ordinary area effect.

Class uses and spell slots are one shared pool. Both twins normally take the casting actions together, with one providing materials. One twin can cast alone if the other takes no actions during the casting. Even a free action by the other twin ruins the attempt and loses the spell.

Personal spells affect both twins when they share a plane, or only the caster when on different planes. Ordinary touch spells affect the twin touched. Spell Conductor can shift an ongoing harmless touch spell to the other twin on the same plane as a move action. The pair can transfer a spell it casts as part of casting, and the text disallows transferring spells used by others.

Most effects stay with the body affected. A mind-affecting spell or ability affecting one twin affects both. If a single such effect targets both at once, use one save. Negative levels and levels lost through return to life apply to both. Use one save to remove a negative level.

Pair telepathy works across any distance and across planes. The twins do not share senses. A full-round action reveals the other twin’s current hit points and mental state, plus their direction and distance when on the same plane.

If a twin dies, each elapsed day deals 1d4 Constitution and Wisdom damage to the survivor and adds a cumulative −1 to attacks, skill checks, and saves. This damage and penalty cannot be removed while the survivor lives and their twin is dead. Both vanish immediately upon the missing twin’s return to life.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Common and Dvati are automatic. Any bonus language is eligible. Speaking Dvati takes two simultaneous speakers. Favored class Bard.

Against a shield, weapon, or metallic creature it instead deals 4d6, bypassing hardness or damage reduction. player.title: Species traits
lines: Winged elves from Aeryl who speak Aeryla, an Elvish dialect. Ability adjustments are +2 Dexterity and −2 Constitution. Infravision extends 60 feet and daylight vision can distinguish details over a mile away. Starting characters gain no initial Legacy.

Fly 18 at maneuverability B while carrying up to half body weight, or C with a load up to body weight. Leather, studded leather and glassteel elven chain are compatible with flight. Ee’aar never use shields. Check Constitution hourly during flight, with a −1 for carrying more than half body weight, +4 while gliding in favorable wind and −1 per 5,000 feet above the first 5,000. Ceiling 20,000 feet. Failure requires half an hour of rest per two hours of prior flight.

Wing AC is 9 improved by Dexterity. Back attacks target the wings. A flank miss can hit if it beats wing AC, and a frontal attack can target the wings if the attacker is taller. At 50% HP lost only gliding is possible. At 75% lost gliding also ends. A standing jump reaches 10 feet. A qualifying fire hit or failed save ignites the wings unless extinguished in 1d4 rounds. Burned wings cause 2d6 additional damage and ground the character for one month.

Gain +1 to attack with a shortsword, bolas or lasso, and 30% resistance to sleep and charm spells. An adult carries a chest light that can be switched on, off or made to flicker at will. Enclosed confinement calls for a daily Wisdom check. Failures cause distress until open air. Five failures in one confinement require heal or cure disease.

Class limits are fighter 14, wizard 15, priest 12, thief 8, bard 10 and optional psionicist 7. Allowed combinations pair two of fighter, wizard and priest. The PC rules forbid longbows and make medium or large slashing weapons ineffective.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Bull-headed, feather-winged folk of Eshu who speak Nimmurian. Most stand 6–7 feet tall. Those over 7 feet count as Large. Ability adjustments are +2 Strength and −2 Dexterity. Daylight vision can distinguish details up to half a mile away.

Natural AC 6. Most light armor gives AC 5. The horns deal 1d4+1 damage. At 1st level an Enduk takes a mace or club proficiency. Proficiency with other piercing or slashing melee arms waits until level 3, with a flight-lance exception. Both longbows and shortbows are forbidden, and medium or large slashing weapons are unwieldy.

Fly 12 at maneuverability C with a load up to body weight, or D up to twice body weight. Flight requires bronze plate or lighter and has a 10,000-foot ceiling. After three turns of flight, check Constitution each turn. Failure requires one turn of rest per three turns already flown.

Gliding replaces flight after losing at least half normal HP, and ends at 75% HP loss. Fire exposure calls for immediate extinguishing for 1d4 rounds. If feathers burn, take 2d6 additional damage and lose flight for one month. Enclosed spaces cause no special hindrance.

Class limits are fighter 14, wizard 12, unlimited priest, thief 8, bard 9 and optional psionicist 8. Fighter/priest, fighter/psionicist and priest/psionicist are available, with twice the ordinary chance of a wild talent when psionics are in play.
Enduk thieves apply −5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise, −20 Climb Walls and +10 Read Languages. These are percentage-point adjustments.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and 60-ft. black-and-white darkvision. Full ancestry gives +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma.
Full ancestry gives +2 natural armor. Cold resistance 5 applies to both mundane and magical cold damage.

Two racial Hit Dice give 2d8, BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, and Will +3. One racial feat and 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier) skill points. Racial class skills are Climb, Hide, Jump, Listen, Search, Spot, and Survival.
Racial proficiency covers simple weapons. Armor and shield proficiency come from other sources, such as class.
The full ancestry has two claws dealing 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each. In a full attack with a manufactured weapon, a free claw can be used as a secondary attack.

Powerful Build counts size as one category larger when advantageous on opposed checks with size modifiers and against size-dependent special attacks. It enables weapons one size larger and preserves actual space and reach. It stacks with size changes that preserve the trait.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
The language entry gives Gol-Kaa. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +2 gives ECL 4 with the two racial Hit Dice before adding class levels.
The optional four-level Feral Gargun monster class starts with +2 Strength, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma, 30-ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., Cold resistance 5, Goliath Blood, and Mountain Movement.
Monster-class level 1 gives 1d8, BAB +1, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +2 and Will +2, one feat, and two 1d4 claws. Level 2 adds +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +1 natural armor, and Acclimated.

Monster-class level 3 adds the second 1d8, BAB +2 total, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3 and Will +3, Powerful Build, and 1d6 claws. Level 4 adds +2 Constitution and +2 Dexterity and brings natural armor to +2 total.

Skill points for the progression are (2 + Intelligence modifier) × 4 at 1st level and (2 + Intelligence modifier) at 3rd. The four levels incorporate level adjustment. Complete the progression before multiclassing. Table 4–4 lists CR 1, 1, 2, and 2.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider (Native). +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, −2 Constitution. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
+2 racial bonus on Bluff, Hide, Listen, Search, and Spot.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.

The original 2003 player rules for D&D 3.0 use at-will alter self (Sp) for an indefinite humanoid form. This 3.5 adaptation uses Change Shape from the 2004 conversion of the earlier monster. True seeing reveals the natural form, and Change Shape cannot assume a templated form.

Choose four Demonic Abilities total. Options are charm person, clairaudience/clairvoyance, darkness, detect thoughts, dimension door, enervation, suggestion, DR 10/magic, fire resistance 10, +2 racial on saves against electricity, or +2 racial on saves against poison.
Each selected spell-like ability is usable once per day, with caster level equal to character level and Charisma-based save DCs.
Choose at most one of DR 10/magic, dimension door, and enervation. Taking one raises LA from +2 to +3. The original 2003 DR option was 10/+1. The player entry has no racial Hit Dice.
Common, Elven, and Abyssal are the languages named in the book. The language section also describes learning Gnoll, Goblin, Sylvan, and Draconic. Favored class Sorcerer.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.

Communal. Add twice your proficiency bonus to History checks about your people, culture, or community. Gain simple weapon proficiency and proficiency in brewer’s supplies, carpenter’s tools, or smith’s tools.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.
Bright Gallus. Charisma +1 and Insight proficiency. Spend an action encouraging an ally who can see and hear you. That ally adds 1d4 to their next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.
Huden Gallus. Dexterity +1 and Nature proficiency. Use speech and touch to exchange simple ideas with living plants. Plants report sensations such as touch, temperature, or vibrations.

lines: Humanoid in a constructed body. Choose a chassis modeled on another lineage at character creation and use its size and height. Base walking speed 30 ft. A maintained chassis has no known lifespan limit.
Hybrid Humanoid grants disease immunity, poison damage resistance, and advantage on saves against the paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

Constructed Vitality removes the need to eat, drink, or breathe. Spend six hours semiconscious and dormant in place of sleep, with disadvantage on Perception checks during dormancy. That rest gives the benefit of eight hours of sleep.
Speak and understand Machine Speech, the mechanical language of gearforged and mechadrons.

Choose one Upgrade. Always Armed integrates a suitable melee weapon in each arm, up to two total. Two-Handed weapons are excluded. Weapons using ammunition still require ammunition. Integrating or replacing a weapon takes ten minutes.

With Always Armed, drawing or sheathing the weapon folds it out of or back into the arm. A drawn weapon occupies the hand. A sheathed weapon passes concealment checks automatically. You cannot willingly let it be disarmed. Deliberate removal takes an action.
Bulk Up uses a bonus action to become Large for PB rounds if you have space. Weapon attacks deal another 1d4, and STR checks and saves have advantage. Once per long rest.
Quick Fix uses a bonus action while below half your maximum HP to gain temporary HP equal to twice PB. Once per short or long rest.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium elemental humanoid. +2 Strength and +2 Intelligence. Speed 6 squares, normal vision. Common and Primordial. +2 Endurance and Nature. Elemental Origin applies to effects keyed to creature origin.
Choose one active elemental manifestation. Extra Manifestation can add another option and lets you change your manifestation.

Earthsoul gives +1 Fortitude, +1 to saving throws, and Earthshock. Encounter minor, close burst 1 against grounded enemies. Chosen Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity +2 vs. Fortitude knocks a hit target prone. The racial attack bonus becomes +4 at level 11 and +6 at level 21.

Firesoul gives +1 Reflex, fire resistance 5, and Firepulse. Encounter immediate reaction after a melee hit from an enemy within 1 square. Chosen Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity +2 vs. Reflex deals 1d6 + the same modifier fire damage. At levels 11 and 21 the racial attack bonus increases to +4 and +6 and the dice to 2d6 and 3d6. Fire resistance rises to 10 and 15.

Stormsoul gives +1 Fortitude, lightning resistance 5, and Promise of Storm. Encounter minor, personal. Until the end of your next turn, a hit with a lightning or thunder attack deals an extra 1d8 damage under the August 2012 rules update. Resistance and damage dice rise to 10 and 2d8 at level 11, then 15 and 3d8 at level 21.

Watersoul breathes underwater and gains +2 to saving throws against ongoing damage. Swiftcurrent is an encounter move that shifts up to speed on land or liquid. You can cross enemy spaces and ignore squeezing, difficult terrain, and damage from the traversed surface.
Windsoul gives cold resistance 5 and Windwalker. Encounter move, fly 8 squares and drift safely down if you end above the ground. Cold resistance rises to 10 at level 11 and 15 at level 21.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium monstrous humanoid at entry, +2 Dexterity, −4 Intelligence, +2 Charisma. Base land speed 20 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Common. Favored class Harpy.

Proficient with simple weapons. The class begins with +1 natural armor and two claws dealing 1d3 each plus half the Strength bonus. Gain another +2 Dexterity at level 2 and a 40-ft. fly speed (average) at level 3.

Curl Up. As an action, curl into a ball. Base AC becomes 19 without a Dexterity bonus, and a usable shield still applies. While curled, you cannot move, attack, or cast spells that have a somatic component. A creature that misses you with a melee attack takes 2d4 piercing. If a creature hits you, you fall prone at the end of the turn. You may uncurl during your turn.

player.title: Species traits
lines: A playable shapechanger with three forms: human, animal, and bipedal hybrid. Choose one animal kind. A character keeps that animal kind and its corresponding hybrid throughout play.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full-round action and provokes attacks of opportunity. It follows the D&D 3.0 Polymorph Other spell with the exceptions below.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.

Badger animal form. Tiny, walk 30 ft., burrow 10 ft., AC 15. Str 8, Dex 17, Con 15. Natural attack damage: two claws 1d2−1 and bite 1d3−1.

Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Weasel animal form. Tiny, walk 20 ft., climb 20 ft., AC 14. Str 3, Dex 15, Con 10. Natural attack damage: bite 1d3−4.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. The entry lists no ability adjustments, racial Hit Dice, or level adjustment.
Luminous Sigils (Su) orbit the head and give candlelight. Douse them as a standard action to suspend power sigil bonuses and word abilities. Restore them as a free action.
Sigils are insubstantial and disappear into matter they touch. A change of form keeps the sigils if the new form preserves the Illumian’s supernatural abilities.

Glyphic Resonance (Ex) applies when a spell’s name includes glyph, rune, sigil, or symbol. If the Illumian’s character level is below the spell’s caster level, take a −4 racial penalty on its saves. At or above that caster level, gain immunity to the spell.

Power Sigils (Su) grant one choice at 1st level for a +1 bonus. Page 54 gives a second distinct sigil at 2nd level in any class, raising both bonuses to +2. On p. 87, Bloodwing Zhaolei is a Bard 1/Fighter 1 with two +2 sigils and the Vaulaesh word. Spot DC 10 distinguishes a power sigil and Knowledge (arcana) DC 15 identifies it.

Aesh adds to Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks. Hoon adds to Constitution and Wisdom checks and skills based on either ability. Naen adds to Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks.

Uur adds to Dexterity checks and Dexterity-based skill checks. Vaul adds to Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks. Krau adds to caster level for spells and spell-like abilities, capped at character level.
Illumian Words (Su) come from combining two power sigils. When a word calls for an unprepared spell slot, a slot that holds a prepared spell is ineligible.
Aeshkrau and Uurkrau allow Strength and Dexterity respectively to determine bonus spells for a high ability score in any or all of the Illumian’s spellcasting classes.
Aeshoon spends a turn or rebuke attempt as a swift action, twice per day, to add the Wisdom bonus to damage with Weapon Focus weapons until the next turn begins.
Aeshuur grants a +2 dodge bonus to AC against a target damaged by the Illumian’s sneak attack or critical hit, until the Illumian’s next turn begins.

Hoonkrau uses a swift action and a turn attempt to add 1d8 healing to cure spells, or a rebuke attempt to add 1d8 damage to inflict spells. The effect lasts through the end of the next turn. Use twice per day.
Hoonvaul spends a spell slot as a swift action, twice per day, to add its level to turning checks and turning damage and to a smite attack’s attack and damage rolls until the next turn begins.
Naenaesh can leave up to two slots empty during preparation. Until the next preparation, those slots stay empty and other spells prepared at their levels can be cast with Still Spell.

Naenhoon uses a swift action, twice per day, to apply a metamagic feat the Illumian has. Spend turn or rebuke attempts equal to the feat’s level adjustment. Casting time, spell slot, and effective spell level stay the same. Heighten Spell changes the effective level and costs one turn attempt per level added, up to spell level 9.

Naenkrau can leave up to two slots empty during preparation, at different levels if choosing two. Other spells of those levels gain +1 to their save DC, including spells from other classes. The slots stay empty and the bonus lasts until next preparation.

Uurhoon spends a slot as a swift action, twice per day. For one minute per slot level, apply the Wisdom bonus as an insight bonus to Reflex saves and the Dexterity bonus as an insight bonus to caster level checks against spell resistance.

Uurnaen can leave one 1st- or 2nd-level slot empty during preparation. Until next preparation, the slot stays empty and its level gives an insight bonus on attack rolls for unarmed strikes and sneak attacks.
Vaulaesh spends a slot as a swift action, twice per day. Its level is an insight bonus to AC and to Weapon Focus weapon damage until the Illumian’s next turn begins.
Vaulkrau spends a slot as an immediate action, twice per day. Its level is an insight bonus on the next save made before the Illumian’s next turn begins.
Vaulnaen uses an available slot twice per day to cast any prepared spell of the same level spontaneously, at the caster level of the class that prepared it.
Vauluur spends a slot as a swift action, twice per day, to add 1d6 per slot level to unarmed strike damage and sneak attack damage until the Illumian’s next turn begins.
Final Utterance (Ex) releases audible Illumian syllables at death for 1 round per Hit Die, even if the body is destroyed. Anyone within earshot can hear it.
+2 racial bonus on saves against spells with the shadow descriptor.
Superior Literacy means every Illumian is literate and Speak Language is always a class skill. Common and Illumian are automatic. Any nonsecret language may be taken as a bonus language.
Favored class Any. Exclude the highest class when figuring multiclass XP penalties. An Illumian monk or paladin can return to that class after multiclassing.

lines: Medium Humanoid with a 30-ft. base land speed and no racial ability adjustments. The Expanded Psionics Handbook gives the Psionic subtype to creatures with racial psi-like abilities.
+2 racial on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and abilities and against possession.
+2 racial on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks. +2 racial on Disguise when impersonating a human.
Kalashtar sleep. They are immune to dream, nightmare, and other effects that rely on their ability to dream.
Naturally Psionic adds 1 extra power point per character level to the character’s reserve, even without taking a psionic class.

Racial Mindlink (Ps) 1/day is separate from the power point reserve. Resolve it as a Wilder of half the Kalashtar’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum manifester level 1. It grants no general manifester levels.

With the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use its Mindlink rules. At manifester level 1, use a standard action to link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 25 ft. for 10 minutes. The willing target gets no saving throw. Power resistance applies as harmless. Treat it as mind-affecting.

With psionics rules, initial range is 25 ft. + 5 ft. per two manifester levels, and duration is 10 minutes per manifester level. Resolve psi-like augmentation as if power points equal to its effective manifester level were spent, without deducting from the reserve. Mindlink costs 1 point before augmentation. One extra point adds a target within 15 ft. of another target. Four extra points allow a link with an unwilling target (Will negates, DC 11 + the Kalashtar’s Charisma modifier for racial Mindlink).

Without the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use the setting book’s fallback. Link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 30 ft. for 1 round per character level. There is no saving throw or spell resistance. The ability is mind-affecting.
Once formed, either link carries telepathic communication across any distance on the same plane without requiring a shared language. The bond conveys no influence or control.

Common and Quor are automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic and Riedran. Favored class Psion. The setting entry lists no racial Hit Dice or level adjustment. Its original setting rules give Kalashtar no dragonmarks.

lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, −2 Wisdom. Darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor, and +4 racial Hide. Space and reach 5 ft.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, dog-headed humanoid with base AC 10, infravision 60 feet, and keen hearing and scent. Strength and Constitution +1, Intelligence and Wisdom −1. Raw Strength and Constitution must be at least 8.

Automatically gain Blind-fighting. Tracking uses half Wisdom rounded up, full Wisdom if learned through slots, or Wisdom +6 as a ranger. Detect Noise begins at 35%, adding 2 percentage points per level after 1st. Thieves can invest skill points in it.

A save at +4 can detect the presence of an invisible or ethereal being. Check as soon as one approaches to within 10 feet, then each round it stays that close. The save alone gives neither exact position nor a way to affect an ethereal creature.

Recognize werewolves in any form 99% of the time and other lupins in unusual forms 15% of the time. Identify a familiar species by scent automatically or a familiar individual with an Intelligence check. Masking odors can impose −1 to −4.

Take −2 on saves against sound or odor attacks. Swallowed wolfsbane acts as Type J poison, fatal on failure and inflicting 20 HP on a successful save. Injected wolfsbane acts as Type P, halving ability scores for 1d3 days on a failed save. Natural bite deals 1d4, speed 3, with a proficiency slot needed to avoid the nonproficiency penalty.

Class limits through fighter 13, unlimited ranger, wizard 12, cleric 15, druid 13, thief 13, and bard 9. No paladin. Lupin or Renardois is the native-language choice. Common is suggested as an additional starting language.

Maenad drydock shipwright, Expert 1 · Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1. · Medium Humanoid (Maenad, Psionic)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Maenad and Psionic subtypes. Base land speed 30 ft. No racial ability-score adjustments.
Naturally Psionic grants 2 bonus power points at 1st level. Manifesting powers requires a separate source, such as a psionic class.
Racial Energy Ray is a sonic-only psi-like ability, usable once per day and accompanied by a scream. Manifester level is half the Maenad’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum 1. It costs no power points.

The ray takes a standard action and hits with a ranged touch attack. Range is 25 ft. plus 5 ft. per two manifester levels. It allows no saving throw. Power resistance applies. Roll one d6 per manifester level and subtract 1 per die. The sonic ray ignores object hardness.

Outburst (Ex) is usable once per day for up to 4 rounds. Add +2 Strength and apply −2 Intelligence and Wisdom while it lasts. The entry leaves the activation action unstated. The example NPCs use a standard action, following the original 3.5 default for activated extraordinary abilities.
Automatic languages Common and Maenad. Bonus languages Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Goblin. Favored class Wilder. Level adjustment +0.

gm.title: Original NPC · Tamar of Um-Shedu
lines: Motive. Account for everyone sheltering behind the gate before dusk.
Hook. Tamar’s gate ledger has one more name than the people inside. The signature is still wet.
Um-Shedu threshold guard, Fighter 1 (Defender) · Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round. · Large Humanoid (scorpion-bodied)
AC 7 · HP 10 · Speed 12 ground. Cannot swim.

player.title: Printed source
lines: Character Creation / Nimmur and the Manscorpions / Manscorpions as PCs

player.title: Species traits
lines: The standard PC is an Um-Shedu manscorpion whose sunlight curse was lifted after aiding the Enduks. The DM can allow a redemption-seeking character who still bears the curse.

Ability adjustments are +1 Strength and Constitution and −1 Intelligence and Wisdom. Um-Shedu adjust effective Charisma by −1 with other humanoids and −4 with demihumans or humans. Nimmurian is the usual language.

Natural AC 7 and infravision. Body armor rated 7 or worse gives AC 6. For armor rated 6 or better, improve its AC by 1. Shields and Dexterity modify normally. They cannot swim. Choose bonus Artistic Ability or Charioteering. Astronomy and Astrology are unavailable at character creation.

The Um-Shedu sting uses sleep venom. A target failing a poison save is woozy for one round, then sleeps for 2d8 rounds. Neutralize poison can awaken the target early. The save penalty is −1 per three character levels, capped at −4. Um-Shedu are immune to other manscorpions’ venom and gain +2 on other poison saves.

Class limits are fighter 12, wizard 12, priest 12, thief 7, bard 10 and optional psionicist 7. Fighter/thief, fighter/priest and fighter/psionicist are available. Starting priests serve Idu or Ilsundal. Wizard specialization is unavailable.
Manscorpion thieves apply +5 Open Locks, −20 Move Silently, −5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise and −25 Climb Walls. These are percentage-point adjustments.

gm.title: Original NPC · Kestrel Pinshank
lines: Motive. Restart the lift before its last passengers run out of drinking water.
Hook. Kestrel can brace the stalled pulley with a temporary tool, but needs someone to keep the cargo platform steady.
Pulley repairer, Life Cleric 2 · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter. · Medium Humanoid
AC 16 · HP 17 (2d8+4) · Speed 30 ft. walk, 20 ft. climb

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium raccoonlike humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft., climb speed 20 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Wisdom +2, Constitution +1.
Resilience. Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. Skulker grants advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

Scroungecraft. Gain tinker’s tools proficiency. With suitable material, spend 10 minutes to improvise a tool or piece of adventuring gear worth up to 30 gp. Tools and expendable items are useful for one use. Other items generally last 1 hour.

With proper materials, start before the temporary item fails and spend 8 hours to make it permanent. Scroungecraft can also repair equipment, with available materials and repair durability at the GM’s discretion.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk and Mapach.

gm.title: Original NPC · Basalt Wren

Maug ramp engineer, Fighter 1 · Provisional CR 4. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3). · Large Construct (Extraplanar)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Large Construct native to Acheron, 10-ft. space and reach. Speed 40 ft., cannot run. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision under revised Construct traits. No Constitution score. Racial adjustments derived from the printed base scores are +10 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and +2 Charisma.

Two racial construct Hit Dice, 2d10 plus 30 HP for Large size, BAB +1, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +0. +7 natural armor and one slam for 1d8 before Strength. Applies standard Large attack, AC, Hide, and grapple modifiers.

Construct defenses include immunity to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, disease, magical death effects, necromancy, and Fortitude effects that cannot affect objects. Immune to critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, ability drain, and energy drain. Destroyed at 0 HP.

Pulverize (Su), 3/day as a standard action. Remove an object’s hardness for 1d4 rounds, Fortitude DC 18 negates. Affect up to a 10-ft. cube of its volume. Unattended nonmagical objects get no save. An object held, worn, or carried by a creature requires a melee touch attack that does not provoke.

Rapid Repair (Ex) restores 1 HP per full hour of rest while at 1 HP or more. An assistant with a DC 15 Craft (stonemasonry) check raises that rate to 2 HP an hour. Rapid Repair cannot regrow or reattach body parts.

Spell resistance 14 + class levels. Uses outsider skill points for its construct Hit Dice, for five times (8 + Intelligence modifier) racial skill points. +4 racial bonus to Craft (stonemasonry) and Knowledge (architecture and engineering), and Alertness as a bonus feat.
Common, Draconic, and Giant. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +3 and ECL 5 before class levels. Optional stone or metal grafts follow the separate rules in Appendix 2.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium monstrous humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and 60-ft. darkvision. Starts with +2 Dexterity and +2 Charisma. Speaks Common.
The 10-level monster class grants proficiency with simple weapons and the shortbow. It grants no armor or shield proficiency. Natural armor begins at class level 2.

Snake hair attacks one creature as a unit. It starts at 1d4 + half Strength modifier and carries poison. The Fortitude save DC is 10 + half the medusa’s class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier. The class table gives the primary and secondary Strength damage at each tier.

Petrifying Gaze starts at level 6 as one deliberate use per day against one target within 10 ft. At level 8 it becomes three daily uses within 30 ft. The mature 30-ft. gaze comes at level 10. The Fortitude save DC is 10 + half the medusa’s class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Humanoid with −2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma, and a 30-ft. land speed. A Mephling gains the Extraplanar subtype away from its own ancestral Elemental Plane. It has no elemental subtype.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of the normal lifting and carrying limits for its Strength. It uses Small weapons.

Breath Weapon. A 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 damage to each target, Reflex half (DC 10 + half the Mephling’s Hit Dice + its Constitution modifier). One use per day, plus one per four levels attained. With multiple daily uses, wait 1d4 rounds between uses. The core breath weapon rules supply a standard action and no attack roll.

A Mephling casts spells with its ancestry’s matching elemental descriptor at +1 caster level. Common and its matching elemental language are automatic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.
Air. +2 Dexterity, fly 10 ft. (perfect), dust-and-grit breath deals piercing damage. Automatic Auran. Favored class Bard.
Earth. +2 Strength and −2 Dexterity, burrow 10 ft., rock-shard breath deals bludgeoning damage. Automatic Terran. Favored class Druid.
Fire. +2 Dexterity, no additional movement mode, flame breath deals fire damage. Automatic Ignan. Favored class Sorcerer.
Water. +2 Constitution, swim 30 ft., caustic breath deals acid damage. Automatic Aquan. Favored class Monk. The traits give no water breathing.
LA +1, no racial Hit Dice. The sidebar mentions reduced fast healing but supplies no rate or conditions, and the playable traits give no fast healing ability.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Aberration. +2 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +8 Intelligence, +6 Wisdom, +6 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +3 natural armor.
Four primary tentacle attacks deal 1d4 bludgeoning each before Strength.

Mind Blast (Sp) affects creatures in a 60-ft. cone. A failed Will save stuns for 3d4 rounds. The Charisma-based DC is 14 + Charisma modifier, reflecting a 4th-level equivalent. The entry gives no use limit.
Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.

Eight racial Hit Dice (8d8) grant BAB +6, base Fortitude +2, Reflex +2, Will +6, and three feats. Racial skill points are 11 × (2 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Bluff, Concentration, Hide, Intimidate, Knowledge (any), Listen, Move Silently, and Spot.
Common and Undercommon are automatic. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Infernal, and Terran.
LA +7. ECL 15 before class levels and ECL 16 with one class level. Favored class Wizard.
Uses the Monster Manual’s innate spell-like abilities. The Expanded Psionics Handbook presents a separate power-point variant.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Strength +2 and choose Constitution +2 or Wisdom +2. Speak Common and one other language. Nature and Perception each gain a +2 racial bonus.

Vitality grants one extra healing surge. Ferocity gives a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt when you drop to 0 HP or fewer. Heedless Charge grants +2 racial AC against opportunity attacks provoked while charging.

Goring Charge is an encounter standard action. Charge and use a horn strike in place of the usual basic attack. Pick Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity. Add 4 to that ability modifier to attack AC, rising to 6 at level 11 and 8 at level 21. On a hit, deal 1d6 plus the selected ability modifier and knock the target prone. The damage dice rise to 2d6 at level 11 and 3d6 at level 21.

lines: Playtest option. Strength +1, plus +1 to Strength, Intelligence, or Wisdom.

Natural horns deal 1d10 piercing, grant advantage to shove, and support a bonus-action gore after taking the Dash action or a bonus-action shove after a melee attack; the latter cannot knock the target prone.
Advantage on checks to navigate or retrace a route. Proficiency with navigator tools and water vehicles.

Mongrelfolk ferry bellkeeper, Expert 1 · Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1. · Medium Humanoid (Human)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype and a 30-ft. base land speed. +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, −4 Charisma. Level adjustment +0.
Low-light vision extends to twice human distance in dim light and retains color and detail.

Emulate Race (Ex) automatically satisfies the racial requirement of a magic item for any humanoid race. A Mongrelfolk trained in Use Magic Device gets a +4 racial bonus on checks to emulate a nonhumanoid race.
Sound Imitation (Ex) reproduces any voice or sound the Mongrelfolk has heard. A listener detects the imitation with a DC 16 Will save.
Diffuse Blood gives +2 racial on saves against spells that target or exclude a particular race when the race named by the spell is human, halfling, dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc.
Immune to sleep spells and similar magical effects. +1 racial on saves against enchantment spells and effects, illusion spells and effects, and poison.
+1 racial on Appraise, Climb, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. +4 racial on Hide and Sleight of Hand.
Common is automatic. Any bonus language may be chosen. Favored class Rogue.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Apply Dwarf; add +2 Strength and proficiency with light and medium armor.

gm.title: Original NPC · Daro Stonehand
lines: Motive. Hold a choke point while the caravan gets its animals clear.

Mul caravan shield, Fighter 1 · 4e level 1, PC-style · Medium Humanoid
AC 19 · HP 31 · Speed 5 squares in scale, base 6

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium humanoid. +2 Constitution and +2 Strength or Wisdom. Speed 6 squares, normal vision. Common and Dwarven. +2 Endurance and Streetwise.
Born of Two Races. Choose human or dwarf feat prerequisites and meet all other requirements. Mul Vitality adds one healing surge.
Tireless needs only 6 hours of sleep per 72 hours to take an extended rest.
Incredible Toughness is an encounter power at the start of your turn and costs no action. End any ongoing damage or dazed, slowed, stunned, or weakened condition currently affecting you.

gm.title: Original NPC · Nerin Alderfold
lines: Motive. Find a route around a flooded section of tunnel before the overnight market lets out.
Hook. Nerin recognizes fresh morel tracks beyond a blocked side passage. They need help moving a waterlogged beam to follow them.
Morel Mushroomfolk tunnel guide, Rogue 2 · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR · Small Humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Humanoid. Wisdom +2, walk 30 ft., and darkvision to 60 ft. Choose Acid Cap, Favored, or Morel to determine size and additional traits.
Fungoid Form grants advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease. Hardy Survivor grants proficiency in Survival.
Speak, read, and write Mushroomfolk and either Common or Undercommon.

Acid Cap is Medium, adds Strength +1, and grants acid resistance and Athletics proficiency. When a melee weapon attack hits you from within 5 ft., you can react to deal acid damage equal to half your level rounded up to the attacker. Uses equal your Constitution modifier, minimum one, per long rest.

Favored is Medium, adds Charisma +1, and grants Persuasion proficiency. You know Spare the Dying and can cast Bless from level 3 once per long rest. Both use Charisma. Restful Spores add your proficiency bonus to HP recovered with Hit Dice at the end of a short rest by you and friendly creatures within 30 ft. Each beneficiary can receive that bonus once per long rest.

Morel is Small, adds Dexterity +1, walks 35 ft., and gains Stealth proficiency. After adjusting coloration for at least a minute in a setting rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid (Human). +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, −2 Dexterity, and −2 Intelligence. Land speed 30 ft. LA +0.

Primitive Weapon Mastery (Ex) gives +1 racial on attacks with bolas, club, dart, greatclub, goad, harpoon, iuak, javelin, longspear, quarterstaff, ritiik, shortbow, shortspear, sling, spear, sugliin, throwing axe, and tigerskull club. It grants no proficiency or damage bonus.
+2 racial on Listen, Spot, and Survival.

Climate Tolerant (Ex) waives environmental Fortitude saves between −20°F and 140°F. It gives no protection from fire or cold damage and counts as Cold Endurance only for feat and prestige-class prerequisites.
Human Blood treats the Neanderthal as human for race-based effects and human-only items. The profile gives no human bonus feat or skill points.
Illiteracy. A Neanderthal can spend 2 skill points to read and write all spoken languages. Taking a nonbarbarian class preserves illiteracy unless the class is Wizard.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarven, Giant, and Orc. Favored class Barbarian.

gm.title: Original NPC · Teo Spent River
lines: Motive. Get a replacement lamp across the ramp before the night crew arrives.
Hook. Teo can cover the exposed ramp while the party checks the loose rail.
Neraph lamp ramp outrider, Ranger 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1. · Medium Outsider (Extraplanar)

gm.title: Original NPC · Mai the Houseless
lines: Motive. Get the watch a message before the shift changes.
Hook. Mai can cross the ledge with the message while the party checks the marked footholds.
Neraph split ledge courier, Rogue 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1. · Medium Outsider (Extraplanar)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider from Limbo. The species entry gives the Extraplanar subtype when away from Limbo. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., no racial ability adjustments. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and dominate person cannot target a Neraph.

Neraph Camouflage is an extraordinary ability. Declare it on one charge attack or thrown-weapon attack per enemy per encounter. Those options share the one use against that enemy. The target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against that attack, with ordinary consequences such as eligibility for sneak attack.
Leap gives +5 racial on Jump. Chitinous skin gives +2 natural armor. Gain +2 racial on Spot and Search.

Weapon Familiarity treats the annulat as a martial weapon. Neraphim are proficient with it through the Outsider type. A proficient thrower reduces a target’s existing cover bonus to AC by 2. Total cover still prevents the attack. The annulat has a 30-ft. range increment, 1d6 slashing at Medium or 1d4 at Small, and critical 19–20/×2. A Medium annulat costs 30 gp and weighs ½ lb.
Automatic languages are Neraph and Slaad. Bonus languages are Common, Celestial, and Abyssal. Favored class Ranger. LA +0. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice.
Neraphim are distinct from slaadi. They have coarse red skin, a broad toadlike head, and chitinlike patches. The optional Neraph Charge and Neraph Throw feats are separate from the racial ability.

gm.title: Original NPC · Sive
lines: Motive. Find a missing apprentice before their mirror route closes.
Hook. Sive appears in the standing mirror and asks who last saw the apprentice.
Varoot Nerra threshold guide, Rogue 2 · Provisional CR 3. ECL 5 (2 class HD, LA +3). · Medium Outsider (Extraplanar)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Varoot playable profile. Medium Outsider native to the Plane of Mirrors. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor. Adjustments derived from the Varoot stat block are +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +4 Wisdom, and +6 Charisma.

Resistance 5 to cold, electricity, and fire. Takes 50% extra sonic damage. Reflective spell resistance equals 12 + class levels. Targeted spells stopped by this resistance reflect to their caster. Immune to gaze attacks, which likewise reflect to their source.

Mirror Jump (Su), at will. As a standard action, touch a mirror and exit through another mirror up to 1 mile away. A suitable highly reflective surface that is not a mirror has a 30% chance to work for entry only. If there is no mirror in range, travel on the Plane of Mirrors and emerge at a random mirror portal.
At caster level 12, disguise self 3/day (printed as change self), and mirror image 1/day. Gains bonus Exotic Weapon Proficiency with the shard dagger and shard longsword.

Speaks Common and its own language of mirror sounds. Favored class Rogue. Replace the Varoot’s single racial Hit Die with its first class level. Level adjustment +3, ECL 4 at first class level. Kalareem and Sillit have different player adjustments.

gm.title: Original NPC · Tesk Reedmark
lines: Motive. Keep the refuge supplied after travelers stop trusting the road markers.
Hook. Tesk saw who moved the flood markers and will take the party to the washed-out trail if someone stays to warn incoming travelers.
Nezumi trail scout, Warrior 1 · Provisional CR 1/2 · Medium Humanoid (Nezumi)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Ratlike humanoid with a long muzzle, prominent incisors, rough fur, and a mostly bare tail. The printed setting describes Nezumi in Rokugan and the Shadowlands.
Medium. Base land speed 40 ft. Constitution +2, Charisma −2.
Low-light vision extends useful vision to twice the human distance in dim conditions while retaining color and detail.
Racial +2 to Hide and Move Silently. Racial +2 on saves against poison and disease.
Immune to acquiring a Shadowlands Taint score and to ill effects of direct Shadowlands exposure. Cloud of Taint and special attacks from Shadowlands creatures can still harm a Nezumi.
Claw or bite deals 1d4 normal damage as an unarmed strike. Choose one of these unarmed attacks per round.
Keen Scent permits the optional Scent feat at Wisdom 11 or higher. It does not grant that feat automatically.

With Scent, detect a presence as a free action within 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double these ranges and overpowering odors triple them. Finding direction costs a move-equivalent action. Pinpoint within 5 ft.

With Scent, follow a trail using Wisdom. A fresh trail is usually DC 10 and the DC rises by 2 per hour. Scent and group size can modify it. Surface and visibility penalties do not apply. A Nezumi can recognize familiar odors. Water can erase a trail. Strong masking odors hamper detection and identification and raise the base tracking DC to 20. Other tracking rules follow the Track feat.
Automatic languages Rokugani and Nezumi. Bonus languages Bakemono and Shadowlands. Favored class Rogue.

gm.title: Original NPC · Tivin Reed
lines: Ford negotiator who can guide travelers beneath the current.
Motive. Stop a ferryman’s new anchor from tearing an eggbed loose.

lines: Small furred humanoid with a grasping ringed tail and gliding membranes. No infravision. Natural AC 9, improved by a racial 2-point bonus before Dexterity. +2 on all saving throws.

lines: Medium feline humanoid with natural AC 10 and infravision 60 feet. Dexterity +2 and Wisdom −2. Raw Strength must be at least 9 and Dexterity at least 8.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Raptoran subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. The playable entry gives no racial ability-score adjustment or level adjustment.
Wing-Aided Movement gives +10 racial bonus to Jump checks. +2 racial bonus to Climb and Spot. Low-light vision reaches twice human distance in dim light and retains color and detail.

Gliding (Ex) uses 40-ft. speed and average maneuverability. Descend 5 ft. per 20 ft. traveled forward. Gliding prevents falling damage and never allows hovering. A medium or heavy load prevents gliding.
If unconscious or helpless in midair, the wings stiffen and unfold. The Raptoran descends in a corkscrew and takes only 1d6 falling damage regardless of distance.
At 5 Hit Dice, Flight (Ex) grants a 40-ft. fly speed with average maneuverability. A medium or heavy load, fatigue, or exhaustion prevents powered flight.

At 5–9 Hit Dice, fly safely for a number of consecutive rounds equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1. You can fly for up to twice that many rounds, becoming fatigued at the end of the flight. You also become fatigued after more than 10 minutes total powered flight in a day. Glide before, after, or between rounds of powered flight.

At 10 Hit Dice, keep the 40-ft. average fly speed and fly with no more exertion than walking or running. The playable text leaves the daily cutoff implicit, while several 10+ HD sample NPCs still list fatigue after 10 minutes.

Once powered flight is available at 5 Hit Dice, it permits a straight-line run and a diving charge with a piercing weapon. The dive must move at least 30 ft. and descend at least 10 ft. A hit deals double damage.
Pact with Wind Lords gives +1 caster level when casting air-descriptor spells. Unerring Direction senses north even underground on the Material Plane.

A footbow is a martial weapon for a Raptoran, with a 110-ft. range increment. Grip it with the feet and draw with one hand for the usual Strength bonus, or draw with both hands to apply 1½ times the bonus. The bow’s Strength rating caps the bonus before the multiplier. On the ground, fire from a prone position at −4 to the attack roll.

Black and copper deal acid, blue and bronze deal lightning, brass, gold and red deal fire, green deals poison, and silver and white deal cold. The line is 5 ft. wide and 30 ft. long. The cone extends 15 ft.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Reptilian subtype. +2 Dexterity, −2 Strength. Base land speed 30 ft. The racial traits grant no essentia pool. Gaining an essentia pool from a class or feat adds the Incarnum subtype.

The Rogue 3 substitution grants bardic knowledge and a bonus feat. It replaces trap sense and prevents gaining it from later rogue levels. Use rogue level plus Intelligence modifier for bardic knowledge, and apply Racial Knowledge. The feat choices are Deceitful, Diligent, Investigator, Negotiator, and Persuasive.

Rogue 10 can replace that level’s special ability with Fortunate Reflexes. Reroll a failed Reflex save unless the original die was a natural 1, and keep the new result. Taking this option gives up improved evasion from rogue levels.

Each claw attacks at most once per round. In the first printing, using a claw as a light off-hand weapon with a manufactured primary weapon applies −2 to all attacks that round.

Wildhunt scent detects a creature at 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Double those ranges for strong odors and triple them for overpowering odors. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., pinpoint the source.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Reptilian subtype. +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity. Base land speed 30 ft. The racial traits grant no essentia pool. Gaining a pool from a class or feat adds the Incarnum subtype.

Natural Weapon: One arm-spine attack per round under the base racial rule. It deals 1d6 piercing. An off-hand spine attack takes the ordinary off-hand penalties and adds only half a positive Strength modifier to damage.
An arm cannot attack with both its spines and a weapon it wields in the same round. Attacking with spines on an arm carrying a shield removes that shield’s AC bonus until the start of your next turn.
Binding a soulmeld to the arms chakra makes spine attacks count as lawful for overcoming damage reduction.

+2 racial bonus to Intimidate and Climb. Common is automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic, Elf (Elven), Celestial, Abyssal, and Infernal. Favored class Incarnate. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.
Skarn are solidly built and humanlike, with rows of spines on their forearms, calves, and upper back. The spines can lie flush against the body and do not retract.

Monk 1 replaces the unarmed strike class feature with Spine Strike. Treat arm spines as unarmed strikes for Monk class features such as flurry of blows and ki strike. Medium Monk damage with spines rises to 1d8 at Monk 4 and 1d10 at Monk 8.

Monk 5 grants one essentia and Defensive Insight, replacing the standard level-based Monk AC bonus. Gain +1 insight AC per invested point. It applies to touch AC and while flat-footed, immobilized, or helpless, and works with armor, shield, or heavy load. The normal Wisdom-to-AC rules still apply separately.

Monk 10 replaces ki strike (lawful) with one daily soulmeld from the Soulborn list if Constitution is at least 11, plus the ability to bind a soulmeld to the arms chakra. Meldshaper level is half Monk level. Save DC is 10 + invested essentia + Wisdom modifier.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Dragonblood subtype. +2 Charisma, −2 Constitution. Base land speed 30 ft. Low-light vision preserves color and detail in dim light at twice human range.

A Spellscale counts as a dragon for racial effects. The subtype also affects eligibility for dragon-specific abilities, feats, and items, and makes the Spellscale subject to harmful dragon-targeted effects. The creature type remains Humanoid.
Common and Draconic are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Halfling. Favored class Sorcerer. No racial Hit Dice or level adjustment are added.

Blood Quickening takes one hour and grants the benefits of one chosen dragon deity for 24 hours. Choose at most one meditation per day. A check bonus is racial and equals half character level, rounded down. Borrowed feats cannot meet prerequisites and still use the normal feat rules.

Aasterinian grants a Disguise bonus and three uses of Improved Counterspell. Astilabor grants an Appraise bonus and Eschew Materials all day. Chronepsis grants a Listen bonus and Silent Spell for the day.
Bahamut adds 2d6 damage to one evil creature targeted by or in the area of the spell, up to three times. Tiamat works the same way against a good creature.
Falazure treats inflict spells as on your spell list for spell completion and spell trigger items. Tamara does the same for cure spells. These meditations allow item use and grant no spells known.

Garyx grants two uses of Widen Spell. Hlal provides a Perform (storytelling) bonus and three uses of Heighten Spell. Io gives a Spellcraft bonus and three uses of Empower Spell. Lendys gives a Concentration bonus and Still Spell for the day.

The optional Rite of Spellscale Assumption converts a willing nondraconic Humanoid. Over seven consecutive days the officiating Spellscale must be able to cast polymorph and have 10 ranks in Knowledge (arcana). Materials cost 2,000 gp. The rite replaces racial traits and removes former racial Hit Dice and level adjustment. Existing languages and favored classes are retained, with Draconic and Sorcerer added.

lines: Medium Outsider with the Earth subtype. The printed profile lists Extraplanar. Apply that subtype when away from the native plane. Base land speed 30 ft. Darkvision sees in black and white out to 60 ft.
Full ancestry gives +8 Strength, +8 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma, and +4 natural armor.

Full ancestry has 2d8 racial Hit Dice, BAB +2, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +3 each. It grants one feat plus Blind-Fight as a bonus feat. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 6 before any class levels.

Racial skill points are 5 × (8 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Appraise, Climb, Craft (stoneworking), Intimidate, Knowledge (history), Knowledge (the planes), Listen, Search, Spot, and Survival.
