Full ancestry can use Magic Stone (Sp) three times per day at caster level 3.

Each use of Magic Stone (Sp) enchants up to three touched pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. The printed spell lists 1d6+1 damage on a hit, or 2d6+2 against undead. Use a normal ranged attack with a +1 enhancement bonus, at a 20-ft. increment if thrown or 50 ft. if slung.
Common and Terran are automatic. Bonus languages are Celestial, Dwarven, and Ignan. Favored class Fighter.

The optional six-level Stonechild monster class starts before the full ancestry is available. Its starting adjustments are +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma. It starts Medium with 30-ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., acid and poison immunity, and the listed proficiencies.

At monster-class level 1, gain 1d8 racial Hit Die, BAB +1, base saves +2, one feat, and (8 + Intelligence modifier) × 4 skill points. At level 2 add +2 Strength and +2 Constitution and reach +1 natural armor.

At level 3 add another +2 Strength and +2 Constitution. Natural armor rises to +2 and Magic Stone becomes available 1/day at caster level 3. At level 4 gain the second 1d8 racial Hit Die, BAB +2 total, base saves +3, (8 + Intelligence modifier) skill points and bonus Blind-Fight.

At level 5 add +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, reach +3 natural armor, and use Magic Stone 2/day. At level 6 add +2 Strength, reach +4 natural armor, and use Magic Stone 3/day. Its caster level stays 3.

The monster class incorporates the four points of level adjustment and ends with the same two racial Hit Dice and full traits. Complete it before multiclassing. Table 4–5 lists CR 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, and 3 for its six levels.

Small size gives +1 AC and attack, +4 Hide, Small weapon sizes, and three quarters of Medium carrying capacity. Humanoid-only spells such as charm person do not affect Tibbits. Class levels supply their Hit Dice, with no added level adjustment.

Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.

player.title: Species traits
lines: The playable Tosculi are Hiveless. Small, walking speed 30 ft. Increase one physical score and one mental score by 2 each. Reduce any score by 2, including either score just increased. Most reach adulthood at 13 and few live past 40.
Natural Armor sets a minimum AC of 11 + Dexterity modifier even while wearing armor. Natural Attacks grants proficiency with claws that deal 1d4 slashing damage.
Gliding Wings prevents falling damage and grants a 40 ft. fly speed without hovering. Finish each round of flight at least one-quarter of the distance traveled below the starting elevation or fall.
Stalker grants proficiency in Perception and Stealth. Speak, read, and write Tosculi and one other language, commonly Southern.

Binding Spittle replaces Stalker. As an Attack action, make a proficient ranged attack against a Medium or smaller target within 60 ft. On a hit the target is restrained. The target or an adjacent creature can use an action for a Strength check to free it, DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier. Breaking the spittle also frees the target (AC 10, bludgeoning damage equal to half your level plus Constitution modifier). One use per short or long rest.
Bite replaces Stalker. Use a 1d6 slashing bite as an unarmed strike. After a hit, you can try to grapple the target as a bonus action. The bite die becomes 2d6 at level 11.
Latent Hive Mind replaces Gliding Wings. Learn a psionic, component-free message that works in magical silence. At level 3, you can also cast component-free detect thoughts once per long rest.
Hardened Carapace replaces both Gliding Wings and Natural Armor and raises the minimum AC to 11 + Constitution modifier + Dexterity modifier.

lines: Medium Humanoid (Reptilian). −2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 90 ft. and +6 natural armor.

Stench (Ex). Anger or fear triggers the musk. Living creatures within 30 ft. other than troglodytes make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 10 rounds. The DC is 10 + half the racial Hit Dice + the Constitution modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that individual troglodyte’s stench for 24 hours.
Poison immunity prevents the effect. Apply normal bonuses against poison to the save. Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the sickness.
Sickened creatures take −2 on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.
Color-changing skin gives +4 on Hide checks, rising to +8 in rocky or underground surroundings.

Two claw attacks deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage each and the bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. Bonus Multiattack reduces the secondary attack penalty from −5 to −2.

Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +1, base Fortitude +3, Reflex +0, Will +0, and one feat. Racial skill points are five times (2 + Intelligence modifier), with a minimum of 1 point per Hit Die before the first-Hit-Die multiplier. Hide and Listen are racial class skills.
Draconic is automatic. Bonus languages are Common, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. LA +2, so ECL 4 before class levels. Favored class Cleric.

lines: Small Fey with −2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and +2 Wisdom. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. LA +1.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of the ordinary carrying and lifting limits. Uldras use Small weapons.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Racial spell-like abilities are ray of frost 3/day, speak with animals 1/day, and touch of fatigue 1/day. Caster level equals Hit Dice. Save DCs use Wisdom.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. All languages are available as bonus languages, and Speak Language is always a class skill. Favored class Druid.

player.title: Species traits
lines: A 14-level aberration monster class. Starts Medium with 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and −2 Intelligence. Speaks Umber Hulk and is proficient with simple weapons.
Starts with two claws, a bite, and +3 natural armor. Claws add full Strength and the secondary bite adds half. Natural armor rises to +5 at 4th level and +7 at 7th.
Gains tremorsense at 4th level (10 ft.) and burrow 20 ft. at 5th. By the end of the progression, tremorsense locates creatures or objects touching the ground within 60 ft.

Confusing Gaze starts with a 5-ft. radius at 7th level, rising to 30 ft. at 13th. It applies confusion at caster level 8 on a failed Will save. DC equals 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier.
Becomes Large with 10-ft. reach at 9th level. At 14th level the class has 8d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 7.

lines: Small Humanoid (Goblinoid). +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Sonic resistance 5.
Small size gives +1 AC and attacks, +4 Hide, −4 grapple, and three-quarters the carrying capacity of a Medium creature under the core size rule.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or daylight, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attacks, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Vulnerability to Poison (Ex). Take −4 on Fortitude saves against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom.

Skinshift (Ex). As a move action, choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing and gain damage reduction 5 against that damage type for 3 + Constitution modifier rounds. One use per day, plus one more at 4th level and every four levels thereafter.

Shriek (Ex). Once per day as a standard action, emit a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on the vril or a 30-ft. cone. Creatures in the area take sonic damage. Reflex halves at DC 10 + half character level (round down) + Constitution modifier. Vril barbarians can use Shriek while raging.
Shriek deals 1d6 at levels 1–2, 2d6 at 3–5, 3d6 at 6–8, and 4d6 from level 9. This follows the errata’s written rule and its Warrior 3 stat block, which deals 2d6.
The errata also gives conflicting examples of 2d6 at level 6 and 3d6 at level 9, with a stated cap of 4d6 at level 12.
+4 racial on Climb and +2 racial on Balance and Jump.

Bewitching Guile. Cast charm person at first level, ambush prey at third level as a 2nd-level spell, and fear at fifth level. Each racial spell has its own use per long rest. These spells use Intelligence.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Slender, mottled humanoid with natural AC 9 and no infravision. Strength −1. Dexterity +1 for most characters, or Wisdom +1 for a Mendoo. No initial Legacy in Wallara.
Vanish as a full action on a successful Intelligence check. The jump works like dimension door out to 120 feet and cannot place the wallara inside a solid object. It can be attempted every round.

From 3rd level, blending makes the wallara effectively invisible to other peoples while completely silent and immobile. It can be used at will for up to one hour per level at a time. Other wallaras can see through it. Armor disables both vanish and blending.

Bonus Tracking with a −3 adjustment in place of the normal −6, plus Ancient History and Local History. Can find the way home within 10 miles. Speak Risil. Apply a Charisma penalty of 1 with other humanoids or 2 with humans and demihumans.

Class table lists fighter 12, ranger 15, wizard 10, priest 10, thief 11, bard 10, and optional psionicist 9. The character prose omits bard. Wizards are limited to diviner, abjurer, or necromancer. Wallaras use their cultural kits and cannot multiclass.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Construct with the Living Construct subtype and a Constitution score. Base land speed 30 ft. +2 Constitution, −2 Wisdom, and −2 Charisma. Class determines Hit Dice, BAB, saves, and skill points. The playable entry lists no level adjustment.

Use ordinary vision and normal saves against mind-affecting spells and abilities. Living Constructs are subject to critical hits, nonlethal damage, stunning, ability damage and drain, death effects, and necromancy.
Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, effects causing sickened, and energy drain.

The official errata allows natural recovery of nonlethal damage and bars natural healing of lethal damage. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural healing of HP or ability damage work at half effect. Repair light damage works at full effect.
Effects that target living creatures or constructs can affect a Warforged. Raise dead and resurrection can restore one to life.

The p. 46 Craft repair procedure takes 8 hours and restores 1 HP per point the check exceeds 15. The procedure requires ranks, as clarified in the errata. Use Craft (armorsmithing, blacksmithing, gemcutting, or sculpting), including for self-repair. Taking 10 is allowed. Taking 20 is barred.

Heat metal, chill metal, and repel metal or stone affect Warforged as if they wore metal armor. Repel wood also applies. Rusting grasp deals 2d6 damage, Reflex half at DC 14 + caster ability modifier. A rust monster’s touch deals 2d6, Reflex DC 17 half.

At 0 HP, a Warforged is disabled and gets one move or standard action per round without losing HP for strenuous actions. At −1 through −9 HP it is inert, unconscious and helpless, and loses HP only if damaged again.
Warforged function without food, sleep, or air. A Warforged can benefit from consumables. Spell preparation and infusions retain their class rest requirements.

Composite Plating gives a +2 armor bonus to AC. It occupies the armor and magic robe slot and can be enchanted as armor. The plating prevents wearing other armor or magic robes and does not stack with other armor bonuses. It imposes 5% arcane spell failure unless a class feature waives failure in light armor.
Light Fortification gives a 25% chance to negate the extra effects of a critical hit or sneak attack and roll damage normally.
One natural slam deals 1d4 base damage. Common is automatic, with no racial bonus languages. Favored class Fighter.

Adamantine Body is an optional 1st-level feat. It sets the plating armor bonus to +8, grants DR 2/adamantine, reduces base speed to 20 ft., and counts as heavy armor. Maximum Dexterity bonus +1, armor check penalty −5, and arcane spell failure 35%.

Wemic ford guard, Barbarian 1 · Provisional CR 4. ECL 9 (5 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3). · Large Monstrous Humanoid
AC 19 · HP 51 (5d8+1d12+18) · Speed 50 ft. with fast movement; base 40 ft.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Large Monstrous Humanoid. +8 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Land speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Proficient with all simple weapons and shields.

Five racial Hit Dice (5d8) grant BAB +5, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +4, and two feats. Racial skill points are eight times (2 + Intelligence modifier), minimum 1 point per Hit Die before the first-Hit-Die multiplier. Racial class skills are Hide, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and Survival.
A wemic can select Spirited Charge or Trample without meeting the normal prerequisites and apply the feat to its own melee attacks, as the player entry describes.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Barbarian. LA +3 gives ECL 8 before class levels.
This 3.5 adaptation uses the original 2003 D&D 3.0 player traits and the 2004 conversion’s space and reach. The earlier monster entry has a different weapon-and-claw routine.

gm.title: Original NPC · Nella Sedgefold
lines: Motive. Deliver a ledger slip before the postern closes and find out why its intended recipient missed the lantern signal.

gm.title: Original NPC · Tovin Larkwell
lines: Motive. Weigh the cracked clapper before the crew recasts it.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Humanoid (Gnome) with 30-ft. base land speed. +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, −2 Strength, −2 Charisma.
Small size gives +1 to AC and attacks, +4 size on Hide, and uses Small weapons. Lifting and carrying capacity is three-quarters of Medium.
Low-light vision doubles normal human range and preserves color and detail. Darkvision sees in black and white out to 60 ft.
Weapon Familiarity treats the gnome hooked hammer as a martial weapon.
+1 racial on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids. +4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently, and +2 racial on Listen and Spot. The size and racial Hide bonuses total +8 before ranks and other modifiers.

Racial silence 1/day at caster level 1, regardless of Charisma. Center it on the Whisper Gnome’s body. The 20-ft.-radius emanation moves with the gnome and lasts 1 minute, dismissible. It blocks sound and verbal spell components and protects against sonic and language-based attacks.
Charisma 10 or higher also grants ghost sound, mage hand, and message once per day each. Caster level 1. Save DC where applicable is 10 + Charisma modifier + spell level.
The language description lists Gnome and says most also speak Terran. The printed traits give no separate bonus language list or level adjustment. Favored class Rogue.

The optional Extra Silence feat sets daily silence uses to 3 + Charisma bonus. Each further selection adds three uses. Silencing Strike requires sneak attack. Declare it and spend a daily silence use before rolling a melee attack. On a hit that deals sneak attack damage, silence centers on the target for 1 round per character level with no save. Dismiss the field as a standard action.

gm.title: Original NPC · Briar Reedfoot
lines: Motive. Keep the newly cleared trail open without drawing visitors through a nesting ground.
Hook. Briar moves a snapped bough aside and asks which footprints the party followed.
Wilden crossing guardian, Warden 1 · Level 1 Warden NPC. Uses 4e character math. · Medium Fey humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Wisdom +2 and choose Constitution +2 or Dexterity +2. Speak Common and Elven. Nature and Stealth each gain a +2 racial bonus.
Fey Origin counts as fey for origin effects. For Hardy Form choose a +1 racial bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, or Will.
Nature’s Aspect chooses one aspect each time you finish an extended rest. Each aspect gives access to its own encounter power.

Voyage of the Ancients is a free action after you hit an enemy with an area or close attack. Teleport 3 squares. You and a visible ally gain combat advantage against one enemy hit until the end of your next turn.

Wrath of the Destroyer is an immediate reaction when a bloodied enemy attacks you or an adjacent ally. Make a melee basic attack against that enemy or charge it. A hit also dazes the enemy until the end of your next turn.

Pursuit of the Hunter is an immediate reaction when an enemy within 2 squares moves on its turn. Shift 3 squares. Through the end of your next turn, hits against that enemy deal 1d6 extra damage and you ignore its normal −2 cover or concealment penalty.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider native to the Beastlands. It gains the Extraplanar subtype away from the Beastlands. Racial adjustments are +4 Constitution, −2 Dexterity, and −2 Charisma.
Land speed 20 ft. even in medium or heavy armor or with a medium or heavy load. Burrow speed 10 ft. In soil or loose dirt, a Wildren can dig a warren for one Medium creature in one hour.
Darkvision 60 ft. and scent. Each of its two primary natural claws deals 1d4 + Strength bonus. A claw-only full attack can use both claws.

Fury (Ex), 1/day. After taking at least 1 point of damage, the Wildren can activate Fury at the start of its next turn. For one round, it gains +4 Strength and takes −2 AC. It cannot end Fury voluntarily. Fury stacks with barbarian rage.
Stability (Ex) grants +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground. It does not apply while climbing, flying, riding, or otherwise off firm footing.

Common and Dwarven are automatic. Wildren can communicate with badgers as if using speak with animals limited to badgers. Bonus languages are Sylvan, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Terran. Favored class Barbarian. LA +1. The profile specifies no racial Hit Dice.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Psionic and Xeph subtypes. Dexterity +2, Strength −2, base land speed 30 ft., and darkvision 60 ft.
+1 racial bonus on saving throws against powers, spells, and spell-like effects.
Naturally Psionic grants 1 bonus power point at 1st level. Manifesting powers requires a separate source, such as a psionic class.
Racial Burst (Su) is usable three times per day and lasts 3 rounds. It grants a competence bonus to base speed of +10 ft. at character levels 1–4, +20 ft. at 5–8, and +30 ft. at 9 and higher.

Racial Burst uses the core standard-action default for supernatural abilities. It spends no power points. Apply the new speed to ordinary movement rules. At base speed 40 ft. with Burst, the standard Jump speed adjustment is +4.
Automatic languages Common and Xeph. Bonus languages Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Goblin, Halfling, Sylvan. Favored class Soulknife. Level adjustment +0.
